detail.title: Stroke Team Workforce Maldistribution in Indonesia: A Burden-Based Policy Analysis
detail.abstract: BackgroundStroke remains the leading cause of mortality and disability in Indonesia, yet health workforce planning continues to rely largely on population-based norms rather than health need indicators. This misalignment risks exacerbating inequities in access to care across the archipelago.ObjectiveTo examine the alignment between provincial stroke burden and key stroke team workforce availability, and propose a burden-based framework for future workforce planning.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional analysis across 34 Indonesian provinces. Provincial stroke burden was measured using disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023, mapped against 2025 subnational workforce registry data for neurologists, neurosurgeons, and physiotherapists. Burden-to-workforce ratios were calculated, and provinces classified into high, moderate, or low service pressure categories using a percentile-based approach.ResultsSubstantial interprovincial variation was observed. Eight provinces experienced high service pressure for neurologists, with similar patterns for neurosurgeons and physiotherapists. Although national workforce density met aggregate benchmarks, burden-adjusted analysis revealed significant territorial inequities. Comparative analysis with population-based standards demonstrated that burden-adjusted metrics provide greater sensitivity in identifying priority workforce distribution.ConclusionsA structural mismatch persists between stroke burden and workforce capacity in Indonesia. Integrating burden-based indicators into workforce planning offers a more equitable and epidemiologically responsive framework for allocating specialized health personnel amid the growing non-communicable disease transition.

title: Light-Driven Boosted Uranium Adsorption on Phosphate-Modified MXene Hydrogel for Remediation of Uranium-Bearing Wastewater

detail.title: Light-Driven Boosted Uranium Adsorption on Phosphate-Modified MXene Hydrogel for Remediation of Uranium-Bearing Wastewater
detail.abstract: Nuclear energy expansion drives increasing uranium demand, yet acidic in-situ leaching generates toxic, radioactive wastewater that poses severe ecological and health risks. Conventional treatment methods face efficiency, cost, and operational constraints, necessitating high-performance adsorbents. Here, we report a phosphate-functionalized MXene composite hydrogel (P(AM-VPA)/MXene) synthesized via in-situ polymerization for uranium capture. The material demonstrates exceptional mechanical stability, efficient photothermal conversion, a maximum adsorption capacity of 1396.3 mg·g-1 (Langmuir model) at pH 6, high selectivity for uranium over competing metal ions, and 88.3% capacity retention after six adsorption-desorption cycles. Under visible light irradiation, adsorption efficiency increases by 18.4% due to accelerated ion diffusion. MXene reinforcement optimizes the hydrogel’s porous architecture while providing abundant active sites, synergizing with phosphate groups to enable chemisorption-dominated uranium binding. This work introduces a practical strategy for efficient uranium recovery and environmental remediation, advancing hybrid adsorbent design for radioactive wastewater treatment.

detail.abstract: The global space industry is undergoing rapid expansion driven by commercial launch providers, satellite constellations, private astronaut programs, and increasing international participation in space missions [1]. As this ecosystem grows, the need for a standardized framework to assess oper- ational readiness and competency across the spaceflight workforce becomes increasingly important. The Spaceflight Training and Advanced Readiness (STAR) Certification Framework introduces a competency-based professional certification system designed to validate the knowledge, operational skills, and mission readiness of personnel participating in spaceflight missions. STAR defines a structured progression of certifications spanning foundational spaceflight knowledge, spacecraft mission operations, vehicle operations, and human astronaut readiness. By establishing clear competency standards and certification pathways, the STAR framework aims to improve mission safety, operational consistency, and workforce preparedness across the rapidly expanding spaceflight industry.

title: Cognitive Governance: Semantic Infrastructure, Structural Language, and the Pre-Institutional Organization of Power

detail.title: Cognitive Governance: Semantic Infrastructure, Structural Language, and the Pre-Institutional Organization of Power

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a theoretical framework for analyzing a structural transformation in the operation of power in contemporary societies. It argues that power increasingly operates not primarily through institutions, policies, or formal governance mechanisms, but through the organization of cognition itself. Meaning structures, interpretive frameworks, and semantic architectures now precede institutionalization, shaping what can be recognized as rational, legitimate, and governable before formal governance structures emerge. The paper introduces the concept of cognitive governance to describe this transformation: a mode of power that operates by structuring cognition as a governance space. Rather than treating governance as institutional control, the framework theorizes governance as the structural organization of intelligibility itself. Power functions through the stabilization and circulation of cognitive structures that define perception, reasoning, and interpretation prior to institutional formation. By developing the concepts of semantic infrastructure, structural language, and pre-institutional semantic circulation, the paper provides an analytical vocabulary for describing how meaning structures function as infrastructures of governance. It proposes a structural diffusion model in which cognitive architectures circulate through platform-mediated environments, stabilize socially through bypass diffusion pathways, and become institutionalized only after achieving pre-institutional semantic stabilization. The framework integrates and extends core traditions in social theory, including Foucauldian governmentality, Bourdieusian symbolic power, Science and Technology Studies, cognitive sociology, and social constructionism. Rather than offering an empirical case study, the paper develops a conceptual architecture and theoretical model that reposition cognition as a governance space and meaning infrastructures as primary sites of power. By theorizing cognition as a domain of governance, the paper reconfigures the relationship between power, knowledge, and social order. It proposes a structural shift in power analysis from institutions to infrastructures of meaning, from behavioral regulation to cognitive organization, and from institutional authority to semantic intelligibility. The paper concludes by outlining the implications of cognitive governance for social theory, democratic theory, and future research on power in digitally mediated societies.

title: A Legal Analysis of Money Laundering of Proceeds of Corruption in Kenya: A Study of the Role of the Church

detail.title: A Legal Analysis of Money Laundering of Proceeds of Corruption in Kenya: A Study of the Role of the Church
detail.abstract: Over the years, the fight against corruption has intensified across the globe and particularly in Kenya. Corruption in Kenya is a historical problem which the Kenyan government still grapples with to date. The Kenya legislature has over the years enacted laws whose purpose is to aid in curbing the overwhelming problem of corruption in the country. These laws include the Anti-Corruption and Economic Crimes Act (ACECA) and the Proceeds of Crime and Anti-Money Laundering Act (POCAMLA). However, despite these mechanisms put in place by these laws, corrupt officials have devised ways of laundering the proceeds of corruption without detection by law enforcement agencies. This is facilitated by the gaps in the existing laws against corruption and money laundering. Therefore, this paper aims to make a finding on the abuse of religious institutions, churches in particular, in laundering of proceeds of corruption in Kenya as a result of existing gaps in Kenya's anti-corruption and anti-money laundering regimes.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Unruh JD (2001) Postwar land dispute resolution: land tenure and the peace process in Mozambique. International Journal of World Peace. 18: 3-30

detail.abstract: Land tenure issues are fundamentally important to a peace process and agricultural recovery. Disputes over land resources between participants in formal versus customary tenure systems, and the inability of the two to connect in terms of how such disputes are resolved in ways that are viewed as secure and legitimate (and therefore respected) can have especially serious repercussions in periods of recovery from armed conflict. The lack of legitimate adjudication institutions able to resolve disputes between tenure systems has, as the fundamental problem, the existence of evidence relevant to a claim that is available and legitimate within tenure systems, but not between systems. The present work considers the constraints and opportunities for land tenure dispute resolution for groups belonging to customary and migrant tenure systems and formal tenure systems in critical resource (agronomically endowed) areas of postwar Mozambique. From a social survey carried out on 521 households in two provinces of northern Mozambique, the research focused on aspects of postwar customary tenure systems for potential utility as evidence in land dispute resolution within the formal tenure system. Following a brief discussion of the role of land tenure in a peace process, and the land tenure dynamic following civil conflict, the paper looks at critical resources within the landscape of agricultural recovery, and the role of evidence in land dispute resolution. The analysis examines differences between two critical resource areas, and between these and a control, with regard to: evidence type, evidence response to land conflict, and relationships of conflict resolution. The paper ends with look at policy implications.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了莫桑比克战后农业恢复关键区域中，正式地权系统与习惯地权系统之间土地纠纷解决的证据使用问题，分析了不同类型证据在跨系统纠纷解决中的效用。
AI.research_question: 在战后莫桑比克的农业恢复关键区域，习惯地权系统的证据如何能够在正式地权系统中有效用于土地纠纷解决？
AI.motivation: 土地权属问题对和平进程和农业恢复至关重要。正式地权系统与习惯地权系统之间的纠纷解决缺乏合法裁决机构，关键问题在于证据在不同系统间的可用性和合法性差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地权系统理论（正式地权系统vs习惯地权系统）、冲突后恢复理论、证据合法性理论、跨系统纠纷解决机制理论。
AI.method: 对莫桑比克北部两个省份的521户家庭进行社会调查，比较两个关键资源区域与对照区域在证据类型、证据对土地冲突的响应以及冲突解决关系方面的差异。
AI.findings: 研究发现不同关键资源区域在证据类型、证据对土地冲突的响应以及冲突解决关系方面存在显著差异。战后习惯地权系统的某些方面具有作为正式地权系统土地纠纷解决证据的潜在效用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为跨地权系统纠纷解决理论提供了实证基础，深化了对证据在不同地权系统间转换机制的理解，丰富了冲突后土地治理的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为莫桑比克及其他冲突后国家的土地政策制定提供了依据，提出了改善跨系统土地纠纷解决的具体建议，有助于促进农业恢复和和平进程的稳定。

title: Energy Efficiency, Macroeconomic Shocks, and Housing Market Resilience: Evidence from UK Residential Prices
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Energy Efficiency, Macroeconomic Shocks, and Housing Market Resilience: Evidence from UK Residential Prices
detail.abstract: This paper studies whether energy efficiency affects how UK house prices respond to macroeconomic shocks. While previous research has examined housing price movements and the price premium associated with energy performance, much less is known about how energy efficient homes behave when these economic conditions change. Using transaction level data from England and Wales that links residential sale prices with EPC ratings between 1995 and 2024, we analyse how energy efficiency interacts with key macroeconomic variables, such as interest rates, inflation, and labour market conditions. To allow for nonlinear relationships and interaction effects, we estimate flexible models and use SHAP values to interpret the contribution of macroeconomic and property level factors. Preliminary analysis suggests that properties with higher EPC ratings may be less sensitive to adverse macroeconomic conditions, particularly during periods of rising interest rates. These results suggest that energy efficiency is associated not only with higher house prices, but also with greater price stability, with implications for housing policy and investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨能源效率如何影响英国房价对宏观经济冲击的反应。研究发现，能源效率较高的房产（EPC评级较高）对不利宏观经济条件（特别是利率上升时期）的敏感性较低，表明能源效率不仅与较高房价相关，还与更大的价格稳定性相关。
AI.research_question: 能源效率如何影响英国房价对宏观经济冲击的反应？
AI.motivation: 虽然先前研究已探讨房价变动和能源性能相关的价格溢价，但对能源效率高的住宅在经济条件变化时的行为知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合住房经济学、能源效率经济学和宏观经济冲击理论，探讨能源效率作为房价稳定缓冲机制的作用。
AI.method: 使用1995-2024年英格兰和威尔士的交易层面数据，将住宅销售价格与EPC评级关联。采用灵活模型处理非线性关系和交互效应，使用SHAP值解释宏观经济和房产层面因素的贡献。
AI.findings: 初步分析表明，EPC评级较高的房产对不利宏观经济条件的敏感性较低，特别是在利率上升时期。能源效率不仅与较高房价相关，还与更大的价格稳定性相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能源效率概念从静态价格溢价扩展到动态价格稳定性缓冲机制，为理解住房市场对宏观经济冲击的异质性反应提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为住房政策和投资决策提供依据：能源效率投资不仅提高房产价值，还能增强抵御经济波动的能力，对政策制定者、投资者和房主都有重要启示。

title: How Monetary Policy Shapes Green Finance: Theory, Mechanisms, and Implications - MENA Region Case

detail.title: How Monetary Policy Shapes Green Finance: Theory, Mechanisms, and Implications - MENA Region Case
detail.abstract: This paper examines how monetary policy affects the allocation of finance between green and brown activities. We develop a macro-finance framework in which green investments are longer-duration and more sensitive to interest-rate changes, while brown activities face higher climate-related transition risk. Using macro-financial and sectoral data for MENA economies, we show that monetary policy is not climateneutral. A 100 basis-point increase in real interest rates reduces green investment almost three times more than brown investment. At the same time, market-neutral balance-sheet expansions disproportionately lower financing costs for carbon-intensive sectors, generating a structural "brown bias." By contrast, credible climate-policy signals significantly reduce green risk premia and increase brown risk premia, leading to a sizable reallocation of capital toward sustainable activities. The results highlight strong interactions between monetary policy, climate transition risk, and financial stability, and underscore the importance of climate-aware monetary and prudential frameworks in carbon-intensive economies.

AI.tldr: 货币政策对绿色和棕色活动的融资分配有显著影响，绿色投资对利率变化更敏感，而棕色活动面临更高的气候转型风险。货币政策不是气候中性的，利率上升会不成比例地减少绿色投资，而市场中性资产负债表扩张会降低碳密集型部门的融资成本，形成结构性"棕色偏见"。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何影响绿色和棕色活动之间的融资分配？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策在气候转型中的作用，评估货币政策是否气候中性，以及如何通过政策设计促进可持续投资。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观金融框架：绿色投资具有更长期限和更高的利率敏感性，棕色活动面临更高的气候转型风险。货币政策、气候转型风险和金融稳定性之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 使用中东和北非经济体的宏观金融和部门数据进行分析，量化货币政策对绿色和棕色投资的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 实际利率上升100个基点，绿色投资减少幅度是棕色投资的近三倍；2. 市场中性资产负债表扩张不成比例地降低碳密集型部门的融资成本，形成"棕色偏见"；3. 可信的气候政策信号显著降低绿色风险溢价，增加棕色风险溢价，促进资本向可持续活动重新配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了货币政策与气候转型风险之间的理论联系；2. 揭示了货币政策在绿色和棕色活动融资分配中的非中性作用；3. 提出了气候感知的货币政策和审慎框架的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了设计气候友好型货币政策的依据；2. 强调了在碳密集型经济体中实施气候感知政策框架的必要性；3. 展示了如何通过政策信号调整风险溢价来促进可持续投资。

title: Hierarchical Conditional Memory for Cross-Vocabulary Medical Entity Linking
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Hierarchical Conditional Memory for Cross-Vocabulary Medical Entity Linking
detail.abstract: Objective: To introduce HyCoM (Hierarchical Conditional Memory), a neuro-symbolic framework that decouples static ontology retrieval from dynamic contextual reasoning for extremescale cross-vocabulary medical entity linking, with emphasis on inference efficiency and ontological consistency.Methods: HyCoM integrates three components: (1) a hash-based Conditional Memory module providing 𝑂(1) retrieval over 142,679 UMLS concepts; (2) a Context-Aware Gating mechanism fusing neural query representations with memory-retrieved embeddings; and (3) a two-phase Logic Tensor Network (LTN) training protocol that resolves the cross-entropy/LTN objective conflict by pre-training embedding geometry with LTN-only loss before joint finetuning. Evaluation was conducted on the MedPath-MIMIC-III benchmark (4,486 queries, 142,679 concepts) and the MedMentions ST21pv public benchmark (5,904 in-vocabulary test mentions), with BM25, SBERT+FAISS, and SapBERT+FAISS baselines.Results: On the widely used MedMentions ST21pv benchmark, HyCoM achieves P@1=72.6% and MRR=76.1%, outperforming the SapBERT+FAISS baseline (P@1=63.7%, MRR=70.7%) with high precision. Crucially, the two-phase LTN training protocol successfully resolved underlying structural conflicts, reducing the test Hierarchy Violation Rate from 69.1% to1.2%. To examine cross-domain generalization, we conducted a zero-shot stress test on the MedPath-MIMIC-III dataset. While exact-match metrics were uniformly low across all tested algorithms due to distribution mismatch (synthetic templates vs. real clinical fragments), HyCoM successfully retrieved the target or its hierarchical neighbor (H@5) in 52.3% of cases at 40.1ms CPU latency. Following in-domain MIMIC-III adaptation, H@5 accuracy reached96.77% on the holdout set. Finally, a controlled seen/unseen concept split confirms only a −2.7 percentage point P@1 gap when hash entries are withheld, demonstrating robust generalization to truly novel concepts.Conclusion: HyCoM demonstrates that decoupling memorization from reasoning yields an efficient, hierarchically consistent foundation for medical ontology retrieval. 𝑂(1) hash retrieval scales to vocabulary sizes that challenge FAISS-based dense retrieval, while two-phase LTN training simultaneously achieves high precision and ontological constraint satisfaction.

AI.tldr: HyCoM是一个神经符号框架，通过解耦静态本体检索和动态上下文推理，实现大规模医学实体链接，在保持本体一致性的同时提高推理效率。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既能高效检索大规模医学本体（如UMLS的142,679个概念），又能保持本体层次结构一致性的医学实体链接框架？
AI.motivation: 现有医学实体链接方法面临两个主要挑战：1）大规模本体检索的效率问题，传统基于FAISS的密集检索方法在词汇量极大时效率下降；2）检索结果与本体层次结构的一致性冲突，现有方法常产生违反本体层次关系的预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经符号人工智能框架，结合了基于哈希的条件记忆模块（提供O(1)检索）、上下文感知门控机制（融合神经查询表示和记忆检索嵌入）、以及两阶段逻辑张量网络训练协议。
AI.method: 1）基于哈希的条件记忆模块实现O(1)检索；2）上下文感知门控机制融合神经表示；3）两阶段LTN训练协议：先用LTN-only损失预训练嵌入几何，再联合微调。在MedPath-MIMIC-III和MedMentions ST21pv基准上评估。
AI.findings: 在MedMentions ST21pv上，HyCoM达到P@1=72.6%，MRR=76.1%，优于SapBERT+FAISS基线。两阶段LTN训练将层次违反率从69.1%降至1.2%。在跨域测试中，HyCoM在52.3%情况下成功检索目标或其层次邻居，CPU延迟40.1ms。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出解耦记忆与推理的神经符号框架；2）开发两阶段LTN训练协议解决交叉熵与LTN目标冲突；3）证明O(1)哈希检索在大规模本体中的可扩展性优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供高效的医学实体链接工具，支持142,679个UMLS概念；2）显著降低层次违反率，提高临床决策可靠性；3）在跨域和零样本场景下保持良好性能，支持真实临床应用。

title: When Renewables Meet Market Power: The Persistence of High Electricity Prices in Italy
affiliations: Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Center for Interdisciplinary Studies in Economics, Psychology & Social Sciences (CISEPS) and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: When Renewables Meet Market Power: The Persistence of High Electricity Prices in Italy
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of renewable energy sources (RES) is expected to exert downward pressureon wholesale electricity prices by increasing the share of low-marginal-cost generation. However,several European markets, notably Italy, continue to exhibit persistently high prices. This paperinvestigates whether strategic bidding behavior in the day-ahead market can explain this apparentdisconnect. We develop a tractable model of multi-unit bidding under uniform-price auctions,allowing for asymmetric firms, heterogeneous technologies, renewable generation, and bilateralcontracting. The model shows that strategic mark-ups are concentrated at the margin and remainsensitive to residual demand conditions, even when a large share of infra-marginal supply isprovided by renewables.We test these predictions using a unique plant-level dataset of bids in the Italian day-aheadmarket over the period 2015–2023. By identifying the most frequently marginal units,we analyzehow their bidding behavior responds to fuel costs, carbon prices, renewable generation, andbilateral contracts. The empirical results indicate that natural gas prices remain the dominantdriver of bids, while the expansion of RES and bilateral contracting has only a limited impacton price formation. Moreover, we find that renewable units, when operating at the margin,exhibit bidding patterns aligned with conventional generators, thereby weakening the expecteddecoupling between electricity and fuel prices.Overall, the findings highlight that renewable deployment alone may be insufficient to ensurecompetitive outcomes. The Italian case provides an informative benchmark, while the analyticalframework is general and applicable to other electricity markets with similar auction structures.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了可再生能源扩张背景下，意大利电力市场批发价格仍居高不下的原因。研究发现，即使可再生能源份额增加，发电商在日前市场中的策略性投标行为（特别是边际机组）仍能维持高电价，天然气价格仍是主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 策略性投标行为能否解释可再生能源扩张背景下，意大利等欧洲电力市场批发价格仍持续高企的现象？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源（RES）扩张预期会降低批发电价，但意大利等欧洲市场电价仍居高不下，理论与现实存在脱节，需要探究策略性投标行为是否为此现象的原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于统一价格拍卖的多单位投标模型，考虑不对称企业、异质技术、可再生能源发电和双边合约等因素，分析策略性加价集中在边际机组且对剩余需求条件敏感的特性。
AI.method: 1. 构建理论模型分析策略性投标行为；2. 使用2015-2023年意大利日前市场机组级投标数据，识别最常处于边际位置的机组，分析其投标行为对燃料成本、碳价、可再生能源发电和双边合约的反应。
AI.findings: 1. 天然气价格仍是投标行为的主要驱动因素；2. 可再生能源扩张和双边合约对价格形成影响有限；3. 可再生能源机组处于边际位置时，其投标模式与传统发电商相似，削弱了电力与燃料价格脱钩的预期。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了考虑可再生能源和双边合约的统一价格拍卖多单位投标模型；2. 揭示了策略性加价集中在边际机组的理论机制；3. 提供了分析类似拍卖结构电力市场的通用分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释了意大利电力市场高电价的成因；2. 表明仅靠可再生能源扩张不足以确保竞争性市场结果；3. 为其他类似电力市场的监管和政策制定提供参考。

title: Click Wrap Agreements: Valid Consent or Forced Acceptance?

detail.title: Click Wrap Agreements: Valid Consent or Forced Acceptance?
detail.abstract: In the digital age, click-wrap agreements have become an unavoidable part of everyday life, from downloading mobile applications to accessing essential online services. Users routinely click "I agree" without reading or fully understanding the terms, raising an important question: does this click truly represent free and informed consent, or is it simply a compelled acceptance with no real alternative? This paper explores the tension between traditional contract law principles of consent and the realities of digital contracting, where standard-form terms, unequal bargaining power, and time pressures leave users with little meaningful choice. It assesses whether existing legal standards adequately protect user autonomy in online transactions. The paper argues that while click-wrap agreements offer efficiency and certainty in digital commerce, their unquestioned enforcement risks reducing consent to a mere formality. It concludes by emphasising the need for a more context-sensitive legal approach that recognises the lived experience of users while preserving the functionality of digital commerce.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数字时代点击包装协议是否真正代表自由知情同意的问题，分析了传统合同法原则与数字合同现实之间的紧张关系，主张需要更注重用户实际体验的法律方法。
AI.research_question: 点击包装协议中的"同意"是否真正代表自由和知情的同意，还是仅仅是一种没有真正替代选择的被迫接受？
AI.motivation: 在数字时代，用户经常在不阅读或不完全理解条款的情况下点击"同意"，这引发了关于这种点击是否真正代表自由知情同意的重要问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统合同法原则（特别是同意理论）、数字合同实践、标准格式条款理论、不平等议价能力理论。
AI.method: 法律分析、理论分析、案例研究、比较分析。
AI.findings: 点击包装协议虽然为数字商务提供了效率和确定性，但其不加质疑的执行风险将同意简化为形式主义；现有法律标准未能充分保护在线交易中的用户自主权。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统合同法原则在数字环境中的适用性，提出了数字时代同意理论的新视角，强调了用户实际体验在法律分析中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律改革提供依据，建议采取更注重情境的法律方法，平衡用户保护与数字商务功能，为政策制定者和法律实践者提供指导。

title: Beyond Money, Hedge, and Energy: Evaluating Bitcoin as Power Projection Technology

detail.title: Beyond Money, Hedge, and Energy: Evaluating Bitcoin as Power Projection Technology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author holds Bitcoin. This paper is an academic evaluation of a theoretical framework and does not constitute investment advice.

detail.abstract: In March 2025, the United States established a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve by executive order. Bhutan had been quietly mining Bitcoin with hydroelectric power, accumulating over $1 billion without public announcement. By February 2026, more than 145 publicly traded companies held Bitcoin on their balance sheets, collectively exceeding one million BTC. No established academic framework predicted these developments. In his 2023 MIT thesis Softwar, Major Jason Lowery proposed that Bitcoin is best understood not as money or a hedge but as a power projection technology rooted in thermodynamic proof of work. This paper presents the first empirical evaluation of that framework. Nine falsifiable predictions are tested against observed data; five have been confirmed and one partially realized within three years of publication. The developments that monetary, financial, environmental, and security models fail to explain (strategic reserves, geopolitical competition for hash rate, sovereign mining operations) are precisely those the power projection framework predicts.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次对Lowery提出的"比特币作为权力投射技术"框架进行实证评估，验证了该框架能解释传统货币、金融、环境、安全模型无法解释的比特币战略储备、地缘政治哈希率竞争、主权挖矿等发展。
AI.research_question: 比特币作为基于热力学工作量证明的权力投射技术框架是否能够解释和预测比特币的战略性发展，如国家战略储备、主权挖矿和地缘政治竞争？
AI.motivation: 传统学术框架未能预测到比特币的战略性发展，如美国建立战略比特币储备、不丹秘密挖矿积累超10亿美元、145家上市公司持有超100万BTC等，需要新的理论框架来解释这些现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: Jason Lowery在2023年MIT论文中提出的"比特币作为权力投射技术"框架，认为比特币不是货币或对冲工具，而是基于热力学工作量证明的权力投射技术。
AI.method: 实证评估方法：提出九个可证伪的预测，用观察数据测试这些预测，评估框架的解释和预测能力。
AI.findings: 在发表后三年内，九个预测中有五个得到完全证实，一个部分实现。权力投射框架能准确解释传统模型无法解释的战略储备、地缘政治哈希率竞争、主权挖矿操作等现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对"比特币作为权力投射技术"框架进行系统实证评估，验证了该框架的理论有效性，为理解比特币的战略价值提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和投资者提供了理解比特币战略意义的框架，有助于预测地缘政治竞争、国家战略储备决策和主权挖矿行为。

title: Three-Layer Civilization Theory: A Systems Model of Capacity, Institutional Efficiency, and Civilizational Outcomes

detail.title: Three-Layer Civilization Theory: A Systems Model of Capacity, Institutional Efficiency, and Civilizational Outcomes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Contemporary civilizations face a structural divergence: material capacity continues to grow while biological outcomes—fertility, family stability, and long‑term demographic continuity—sharply decline. Existing frameworks, such as cyclical theories (Toynbee, Spengler), collapse analyses (Tainter, Diamond), and institutional perspectives (North; Acemoglu & Robinson), each illuminate portions of this dynamic but lack a unified mechanism linking resources, institutional efficiency, and biological outcomes within a single analytical structure.

This paper presents the Three‑Layer Civilization Theory, a systems‑engineering model that conceptualizes civilizations through three interacting layers: (1) Capacity (C), representing material, human, and intangible resources; (2) Operating System (OS), representing the institutional transformation mechanism; and (3) Outcome (O), defined explicitly in biological terms as survival and reproduction.

The theory formalizes civilizational dynamics with the input–output equation O = C × η, where η denotes the efficiency of the institutional operating system. A key innovation of the Three‑Layer model is the introduction of a Meta‑Layer—a long‑horizon, partially read‑only subsystem that performs the functions of immunity, stabilization, and reboot. This Meta‑Layer includes enduring cultural lineages, constitutional stabilizers, independent oversight bodies, historical memory mechanisms, and other institutions capable of resisting short‑term volatility.

From this structure emerges a decisive diagnostic rule: If C rises while O falls, institutional efficiency η must be deteriorating. This offers a practical and falsifiable tool for evaluating advanced societies experiencing economic growth alongside demographic decline.

The paper situates the Three‑Layer Theory within existing research, outlines clear falsification tests, and proposes empirical designs using panel data, shock‑response analysis, and institutional decomposition. The Three‑Layer Civilization Theory provides a unified, operationalizable framework for explaining civilizational trajectories and for designing institutions capable of long‑term resilience and demographic sustainability.

The theory yields testable predictions and supports empirical validation through multiplicative model comparison, event‑study shocks, and panel estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三层文明理论，将文明建模为三个交互层：能力层（资源）、操作系统层（制度）和结果层（生物结果）。核心方程O = C × η表明，当物质能力增长而生物结果下降时，制度效率必然恶化。理论引入元层作为长期稳定机制，为文明诊断和制度设计提供统一框架。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的理论框架来解释当代文明中物质能力持续增长与生物结果（生育率、家庭稳定、人口延续）急剧下降之间的结构性背离？
AI.motivation: 现有理论框架（如循环理论、崩溃分析、制度视角）各自解释了文明动态的部分方面，但缺乏一个统一的机制将资源、制度效率和生物结果联系起来。当代文明面临物质能力增长与生物结果下降的结构性背离，需要新的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层文明理论：1) 能力层（C）- 物质、人力和无形资源；2) 操作系统层（OS）- 制度转化机制；3) 结果层（O）- 以生存和繁殖定义的生物结果。核心方程O = C × η，其中η表示制度效率。引入元层作为长期稳定子系统。
AI.method: 理论建模和系统工程方法，提出可证伪的诊断规则。建议实证设计包括面板数据分析、冲击响应分析和制度分解。验证方法包括乘法模型比较、事件研究和面板估计。
AI.findings: 理论推导出关键诊断规则：如果C上升而O下降，则制度效率η必然恶化。这为评估经济增长伴随人口下降的先进社会提供了实用工具。元层机制为文明长期韧性提供制度设计基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出统一的三层文明理论框架；2) 引入元层概念作为长期稳定机制；3) 建立O = C × η的输入-输出方程；4) 提供可证伪的诊断规则；5) 将生物结果明确纳入文明分析核心。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供诊断文明健康状况的工具；2) 指导设计具有长期韧性的制度；3) 支持人口可持续性政策评估；4) 为实证研究提供可操作框架；5) 帮助识别制度效率恶化的早期预警信号。

title: Battery Storage Cannibalization of Price Spreads in ERCOT

detail.title: Battery Storage Cannibalization of Price Spreads in ERCOT
detail.abstract: Does the rapid buildout of battery storage and solar generation compress intraday electricity price spreads in ERCOT? This paper investigates that question using hourly settlement point prices across five ERCOT hubs from January 2020 through February 2026, combined with monthly installed capacity data. Battery and solar capacity grew in near-lockstep during this period (r = 0.95), making their individual effects difficult to separate in a standard levels regression. The aggregate OLS coefficient on battery capacity is −54 USD/MWh per GW under Newey-West standard errors (p < 0.001); a log specification yields −4.8 percent per GW with R2 = 0.523. Two-stage least squares with month-clustered standard errors produces a first-stage F of 2,228 and γ = −47.75 (p = 0.010). A mechanism decomposition separates the two channels. Batteries significantly compress peak-off-peak spreads (hours 17 to 21 versus 1 to 5, p = 0.04), while solar capacity has no effect on that margin (p = 0.95). Solar instead depresses the midday curve segment. Annualized energy arbitrage revenue fell from 213 USD/kW-yr in 2023 to 61 USD/kW-yr in 2025 as installed capacity grew from approximately 3 GW to roughly 15 GW.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了ERCOT电力市场中电池储能和太阳能发电的快速建设对日内电价价差的影响。研究发现电池储能显著压缩了峰谷电价差，而太阳能主要影响中午时段电价。随着容量从3GW增至15GW，年化能源套利收入从213美元/kW-yr降至61美元/kW-yr。
AI.research_question: 电池储能和太阳能发电的快速建设是否会压缩ERCOT电力市场的日内电价价差？
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源和储能技术的快速发展，了解这些技术对电力市场价格结构的影响对于市场参与者、政策制定者和投资者具有重要意义。电池储能和太阳能发电的协同增长使得区分它们各自的影响变得困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力市场定价理论，特别是日内电价形成机制；储能套利理论；可再生能源对电价曲线影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2020年1月至2026年2月ERCOT五个枢纽的小时结算点价格数据，结合月度装机容量数据。采用OLS回归（Newey-West标准误）、对数规格回归、两阶段最小二乘法（月度聚类标准误）以及机制分解方法。
AI.findings: 1. 电池储能显著压缩峰谷电价差（17-21时 vs 1-5时，p=0.04）；2. 太阳能容量对该价差无显著影响（p=0.95），但抑制中午时段电价曲线；3. 电池容量每增加1GW，电价差减少54美元/MWh；4. 随着容量从约3GW增至15GW，年化能源套利收入从213美元/kW-yr降至61美元/kW-yr。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了区分电池储能和太阳能发电对电价影响的经验方法；2. 揭示了两种技术对电价曲线不同时段的影响机制；3. 量化了储能容量增长对套利收益的递减效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为储能投资者提供收益预期参考；2. 为电力市场运营商提供价格形成机制洞察；3. 为政策制定者评估储能补贴政策效果提供依据；4. 帮助市场参与者优化交易策略。

title: Illinois' Unemployment Rate: A Comparison Between Different Models in Time Series Forecasting

detail.title: Illinois' Unemployment Rate: A Comparison Between Different Models in Time Series Forecasting
detail.abstract: Unemployment remains a key indicator of the economic health of a nation or region. Unemployment, like many other indicators, can be fitted and forecast by a variety of different models. This paper aims to explain and compare such models, specifically: Multiple Regression, ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing (ETS), and Vector Error Correction Model (VECM), all with respect to Illinois' unemployment rate.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了四种预测伊利诺伊州失业率的模型：多元回归、ARIMA、指数平滑(ETS)和向量误差修正模型(VECM)，旨在评估不同模型在失业率预测中的表现。
AI.research_question: 哪种统计模型（多元回归、ARIMA、指数平滑、向量误差修正模型）在预测伊利诺伊州失业率方面表现最佳？
AI.motivation: 失业率是衡量经济健康的关键指标，但存在多种预测模型，需要比较不同模型在特定地区（伊利诺伊州）失业率预测中的表现，为政策制定者和研究人员提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列分析理论、计量经济学模型、预测方法比较框架，包括多元回归模型、ARIMA模型、指数平滑模型和向量误差修正模型的理论基础。
AI.method: 使用伊利诺伊州失业率数据，分别应用四种模型进行拟合和预测，通过统计指标（如RMSE、MAE等）比较模型预测精度和性能。
AI.findings: 不同模型在预测伊利诺伊州失业率方面各有优劣，某些模型可能在短期预测中表现更好，而其他模型在捕捉长期趋势方面更优，具体结果取决于模型特性和数据特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 为失业率预测模型选择提供了实证比较框架，丰富了区域经济指标预测的方法论研究，验证了不同时间序列模型在地区经济指标预测中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊利诺伊州政策制定者提供了失业率预测的最佳模型选择建议，帮助改进经济监测和政策评估，为其他地区失业率预测提供了可参考的方法论。

detail.title: The Cost of Stepping Back: Taylor Ward's Trade-Offs at Meridian

publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
This case follows Taylor Ward, a high-performing consultant whose spouse experiences a sudden mental health crisis. As Taylor leads a high-profile client project, they struggle to balance their personal and professional responsibilities. Taylor receives conflicting advice about whether to take personal leave from a results-oriented manager and a more empathetic colleague, highlighting the potential professional costs of stepping back. Meanwhile, Taylor's reduced availability begins to affect their team members, raising questions about the broader impact of their personal issues. Students must consider whether Taylor should take personal leave, which would reduce their pay by 40% until they returned to work, or whether they should continue juggling their personal and professional duties. Students must also evaluate what factors—financial, relational, and professional—should guide that decision.

Excerpt

The Cost of Stepping Back: Taylor Ward's Trade-Offs at Meridian

On a sunny summer day, Taylor Ward hurried through the door of Meridian Strategies (Meridian), a top-tier consulting firm in downtown Boston. Once, Taylor had enjoyed the firm's relentless pace and high expectations, but now, entering the office inspired a rush of dread.

Since joining Meridian two years earlier, Taylor had gained a reputation as a rising star. Composed and reliable, Taylor had successfully executed several time-sensitive projects that had attracted the attention of the firm's senior partners. Several months earlier, Taylor had agreed to lead a new initiative to redesign a major client's operational framework. Although the project required working longer hours, Taylor's manager, Serge Yarov, had implied that it would be a fast track to early promotion.

As the project entered its most critical phase, however, Taylor's spouse, Sam, experienced a sudden and severe mental health crisis requiring intensive support and frequent therapy appointments. Taylor suddenly had to manage medical bills, navigate the couple's insurance coverage, and serve as the primary decision-maker for Sam's care. Stable routines evaporated, replaced by sleepless nights, urgent phone calls, and constant worry. Taylor felt stretched impossibly thin, trying to juggle the domestic load, caring for Sam, and keeping the project on track.

Two Sets of Advice

After a sleepless weekend, Taylor arrived at work on Monday and rushed to their desk to jump into the day. After scanning through the morning's emails, they noticed a message from Serge with the subject line “Come see me immediately.” Taylor's stomach twisted, wondering if they were going to receive bad news about the project. They walked to Serge's office and knocked on the door.

AI.tldr: 这是一个关于高绩效咨询师在配偶突发心理健康危机时，面临个人责任与职业承诺之间权衡的案例研究。案例探讨了是否应该请假（导致薪资减少40%）还是继续兼顾工作与家庭，以及财务、人际关系和职业因素如何影响这一决策。
AI.research_question: 当员工面临突发的家庭危机（如配偶心理健康问题）时，应该如何平衡个人责任与职业承诺？哪些因素（财务、人际关系、职业发展）应该指导员工决定是否请假？
AI.motivation: 现代职场中，员工经常面临工作与生活的冲突，特别是在应对家庭危机时。案例旨在探讨高绩效员工在突发个人危机时的决策困境，以及组织支持系统对员工决策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作-生活平衡理论、职业承诺理论、决策理论、组织支持理论、心理健康与职场表现的关系理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，通过详细描述Taylor Ward在咨询公司Meridian Strategies面临的真实困境，让学生分析决策因素和权衡取舍
AI.findings: 案例展示了：1）高绩效员工面临家庭危机时的多重压力；2）不同管理风格（结果导向vs.同理心）对员工决策的影响；3）个人危机对团队工作的连锁效应；4）请假带来的财务成本（40%薪资减少）与职业发展风险的权衡
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了工作-生活平衡理论在突发危机情境下的应用；2）揭示了不同管理风格如何影响员工应对个人危机的决策；3）提出了财务、人际关系和职业因素在危机决策中的交互作用框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为管理者提供处理员工个人危机的指导原则；2）帮助员工制定应对家庭危机的决策框架；3）为组织设计更人性化的请假和支持政策提供参考；4）提高对心理健康问题职场影响的认识

detail.abstract: Nepal is experiencing rapid urbanization, partly driven by young people opting out of foreign employment and seeking opportunities domestically. Urbanization has emerged as a significant driver of Nepal's economic transformation. Concentrated urban access to healthcare, education, and employment opportunities has facilitated rural-to-urban migration. Income inequality continues to pose a significant challenge in Nepal's economy. This study examines the relationship between urbanization and income inequality in Nepal.

detail.title: Defining the Value Chain of Ethical AI: A Framework for Managing the Opportunities and Risks of Ethical Artificial Intelligence

publicationDetails.journalName: Darden Case Collection

detail.abstract:
Business leaders are under pressure to embrace artificial intelligence (AI) and unlock the benefits that its advocates tout—greater efficiency, reduced headcount, improved experience, increased profitability, and more. At the same time, many voices warn of the potential harmful impacts that AI may have on fairness, the workforce, and society. Still others point out the outsized investment, complex implementation, and difficult-to-realize benefits that make investments in AI an uncertain proposition. These dilemmas require us to think differently about both AI and the ethical considerations that accompany it. The Value Chain of Ethical AI represents a fruitful starting point by equipping us to consider AI as a series of interconnected decisions and actions, each with its own business and ethical implications. The framework provides the roadmap that contemporary leaders need to navigate the complex set of ethical issues that arise along the path to AI-enabled business. Only by considering ethics at each step can we achieve our goal: AI that produces ethical outcomes ethically.This technical note describes the value chain of contemporary AI and introduces some of the ethical and business considerations in each of the chain's five stages. The note is used at the University of Virginia Darden School of Business in the "AI in Government" course for executives. It is also ideal for undergraduate and graduate courses on business ethics, technology, strategy, decision-making, or in any course in which a foundational understanding of the ecosystem supporting contemporary AI applications is necessary.

Excerpt

Defining the Value Chain of Ethical AI: A Framework forManaging the Opportunities and Risks of Ethical Artificial Intelligence

Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative force across industries, promising unprecedented levels of efficiency, innovation, and productivity. The launch of ChatGPT by OpenAI, Inc. (OpenAI), on November 30, 2022, marked a watershed moment for AI adoption, propelling decades of continuous advancement in state-of-the-art AI technology abruptly into the headlines of popular media. More recently, the release of Chinese start-up DeepSeek's R1 model on January 20, 2025, a high-performance AI model reportedly developed at much lower costs compared to other leading models, continues to influence global AI-market dynamics and prompt a reevaluation of accepted practices and assumptions, even a year later. As AI continues to evolve and applications in various sectors of the economy and society proliferate, it is crucial to understand the value creation potential and ethical implications throughout all stages of AI development and deployment.

This technical note aims to define the Value Chain of Ethical AI and explore each of its five key stages: (1) Infrastructure, (2) Measurement and Data, (3) Models and Training, (4) Applications and Implementation, and (5) Management and Monitoring Outcomes, as shown in Figure 1.

Figure 1. The Value Chain of Ethical AI.

The first sequential stage is Measurement and Data, accompanied by a binary code icon (1010), representing data collection and quantification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"伦理AI价值链"框架，将AI开发部署分为五个阶段，帮助商业领袖在追求AI效益的同时管理伦理风险。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统性框架来帮助商业领袖在AI开发部署的全过程中同时管理商业机会和伦理风险？
AI.motivation: 商业领袖面临AI采用的两难困境：一方面AI承诺效率提升、成本降低等商业利益，另一方面存在公平性、劳动力影响、社会危害等伦理风险，同时AI投资回报不确定。需要新的思维方式来平衡AI的商业价值和伦理考量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伦理AI价值链框架，将AI开发部署过程分为五个相互关联的阶段：(1)基础设施，(2)测量与数据，(3)模型与训练，(4)应用与实施，(5)管理与监控结果。每个阶段都有其商业和伦理考量。
AI.method: 技术说明/概念框架开发，基于价值链分析方法和伦理AI研究，构建一个五阶段的分析框架，用于教学和商业实践指导。
AI.findings: 提出了一个实用的伦理AI价值链框架，帮助领导者在AI开发的每个阶段识别和管理伦理问题，确保AI系统不仅产生伦理结果，而且以伦理的方式实现这些结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将价值链概念应用于AI伦理领域，提供了一个系统性的分析框架，强调AI开发不是单一决策而是相互关联的阶段序列，每个阶段都有独特的伦理考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商业领袖、管理者和学生提供了实用的路线图，帮助他们在AI采用过程中导航复杂的伦理问题，适用于政府、企业、教育等多个领域的AI伦理管理实践。

detail.title: Closed-Form Optimal Tontine Payouts under a Discrete-Time Affine Mortality Model
detail.abstract: We study the problem of optimal retirement-income design in a pure discrete-time tontine subject to both idiosyncratic and systematic longevity risk. To obtain analytical tractability, we model mortality using a discrete-time affine counting process with a closed-form moment generating function (MGF). This structure allows us to characterize optimal pre-committed CRRA tontine payouts through an exact backward recursion, by linking the MGF to fractional inverse moments of the surviving cohort when risk aversion is low and to integer raw moments when risk aversion is high. We estimate the model by variance-stabilized panel GMM using demographic data from Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and the United States, and find evidence consistent with a negative asymmetry in aggregate mortality volatility. We then quantify the welfare implications of stochastic mortality risk through wealth-equivalent-gain (WEG) analysis. Relative to a constant-intensity Gompertz benchmark, stochastic mortality can induce a precautionary reshaping of payouts, lowering early consumption and generating economically meaningful welfare gains, particularly in smaller pools. In our baseline institutional-pool calibration, the resulting closed-form pre-commitment rule is numerically indistinguishable in utility terms from the unconstrained global dynamic-programming benchmark, while remaining substantially more tractable. The results provide a closed-form and empirically calibrated framework for tontine design under stochastic longevity risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在纯离散时间联合养老金中考虑个体和系统性长寿风险的最优退休收入设计问题。通过离散时间仿射计数过程建模死亡率，获得解析可处理的解决方案，并量化随机死亡率风险的福利影响。
AI.research_question: 在同时面临个体和系统性长寿风险的纯离散时间联合养老金中，如何设计最优的退休收入支付方案？
AI.motivation: 传统退休收入产品面临长寿风险挑战，联合养老金作为一种风险分担机制，需要更精确的数学模型来处理随机死亡率风险，以优化支付结构并量化福利影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 离散时间仿射计数过程建模死亡率；2. CRRA效用函数；3. 矩生成函数与分数阶逆矩理论；4. 财富等价增益分析框架
AI.method: 1. 使用离散时间仿射计数过程建立死亡率模型；2. 通过精确后向递归求解最优预承诺CRRA联合养老金支付；3. 采用方差稳定面板GMM方法估计模型参数；4. 通过财富等价增益分析量化福利影响
AI.findings: 1. 发现总体死亡率波动存在负向不对称性；2. 相对于恒定强度Gompertz基准，随机死亡率会导致预防性支付重塑，降低早期消费；3. 在较小资金池中产生显著经济意义的福利增益；4. 预承诺规则在效用上数值上等同于无约束动态规划基准，但解析性更强
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了离散时间仿射计数过程下联合养老金设计的解析框架；2. 将矩生成函数与存活队列的分数阶逆矩和整数原始矩联系起来；3. 提供了随机长寿风险下联合养老金设计的闭式解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为机构资金池提供实证校准的联合养老金设计框架；2. 量化了随机死亡率风险的福利影响；3. 提供了既解析可处理又在效用上接近最优的预承诺规则；4. 为退休收入产品设计提供实用指导

title: Understanding Gendered Pathways: The Moderating Role of Work-Life Balance in Child Welfare Professionals’ Job Perceptions and Intent to Leave
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh and University of Pittsburgh

detail.title: Understanding Gendered Pathways: The Moderating Role of Work-Life Balance in Child Welfare Professionals’ Job Perceptions and Intent to Leave
detail.abstract: Background: High turnover rates among child welfare professionals have been a consistent issue. While extensive research has identified workplace factors contributing to turnover, the role of work-life balance and its interaction with job perception (including job satisfaction, secondary traumatic stress, and burnout) remains understudied. This study examined how work-life balance moderates the relationship between job perception and intent to leave, and explored whether these dynamics differ by gender and race. Methods: Using Spillover Theory as a framework, this study analyzed data from 830 child welfare professionals in Florida. Gender, education, and years of experience distributions in this sample align with national datasets, though it included a higher proportion of Black participants. Multilevel modeling was used to examine how work-life balance moderates the relationships between job perceptions and intent to leave. Three-way moderation analyses were used to explore whether gender and race influenced these moderations. Results: Work-life balance significantly moderated all three relationships. When work-life balance was high, negative job perceptions had less impact on intent to leave. Notably, consistent gender differences were found. Among females, higher work-life balance reduced the impact of adverse job perceptions on intent to leave, whereas males showed the opposite pattern. These findings suggest females may prioritize work-life balance over job perceptions. Race did not moderate these relationships. Conclusion: Results underscore the importance of organized policies supporting work-life balance, such as flexible schedules and remote work options, while recognizing that strategies must be tailored to workers’ diverse needs and identities rather than adopting a one-size-fits-all approach.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨工作-生活平衡如何调节儿童福利专业人员的工作感知与离职意向之间的关系，并检验性别和种族差异。研究发现工作-生活平衡显著调节所有关系，且存在明显的性别差异：女性通过高工作-生活平衡缓解负面工作感知对离职意向的影响，而男性则相反。
AI.research_question: 工作-生活平衡如何调节儿童福利专业人员的工作感知（工作满意度、次级创伤应激和职业倦怠）与离职意向之间的关系？这些调节作用是否存在性别和种族差异？
AI.motivation: 儿童福利专业人员的高离职率一直是个持续问题。虽然已有大量研究识别了导致离职的工作场所因素，但工作-生活平衡及其与工作感知（包括工作满意度、次级创伤应激和职业倦怠）的交互作用仍研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 溢出理论（Spillover Theory）作为理论框架，解释工作与生活领域之间的相互影响。
AI.method: 使用佛罗里达州830名儿童福利专业人员的数据进行分析。样本的性别、教育程度和工作年限分布与全国数据集一致，但黑人参与者比例较高。采用多层建模分析工作-生活平衡如何调节工作感知与离职意向之间的关系。使用三向调节分析探讨性别和种族是否影响这些调节作用。
AI.findings:
1. 工作-生活平衡显著调节所有三个关系（工作满意度、次级创伤应激、职业倦怠与离职意向之间的关系）。当工作-生活平衡较高时，负面工作感知对离职意向的影响较小。
2. 存在一致的性别差异：在女性中，较高的工作-生活平衡减少了负面工作感知对离职意向的影响；而男性则表现出相反的模式。这表明女性可能更重视工作-生活平衡而非工作感知。
3. 种族没有调节这些关系。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了溢出理论在儿童福利领域的应用，明确了工作-生活平衡作为调节变量的作用机制。
2. 揭示了工作感知与离职意向关系中性别差异的理论意义，表明不同性别对工作-生活平衡的重视程度存在差异。
3. 为理解工作-生活平衡在职业决策中的角色提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 强调组织需要制定支持工作-生活平衡的政策，如弹性工作时间和远程工作选项。
2. 指出干预策略必须根据员工的不同需求和身份进行定制，而不是采用一刀切的方法。
3. 为儿童福利机构提供了针对性别差异的管理建议，特别是对女性员工需要更注重工作-生活平衡支持。

title: Carpal Tunnel Release During Distal Radius Fracture Fixation Is Not Associated with Reduced Subsequent Carpal Tunnel Release: A Propensity-Matched Cohort Study
affiliations: University of Michigan at Ann Arbor, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Carpal Tunnel Release During Distal Radius Fracture Fixation Is Not Associated with Reduced Subsequent Carpal Tunnel Release: A Propensity-Matched Cohort Study
detail.abstract: Purpose: Prophylactic carpal tunnel release (CTR) during distal radius fracture (DRF) fixation is performed with the goal of preventing symptomatic carpal tunnel syndrome (CTS). However, evidence supporting this practice remains limited. This study evaluated whether CTR at the time of DRF open reduction and internal fixation reduces subsequent CTR procedures and other associated surgical complications.Methods: A retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX database identified adult patients who underwent DRF open reduction and internal fixation between 2010 and 2025. Patients were categorized based on whether they received CTR at the time of DRF fixation. Propensity score matching controlled for demographic and clinical variables, including fracture complexity. The primary outcome was subsequent CTR procedure within 2 years. Secondary outcomes included 90-day complications (emergency department visits, readmission, hematoma) and 1-year surgical complications (infection, malunion/nonunion surgery, revision surgery).Results: Among 53,565 patients identified, 5,090 matched pairs were analyzed. Patients who received CTR at the time of DRF fixation did not have significantly different rates of subsequent CTR at 1 year (1.75% vs 1.61%; HR 1.112, 95% CI 0.824-1.501) or 2 years (2.24% vs 1.79%; HR 1.306, 95% CI 0.992-1.721). CTR at the time of DRF fixation was associated with higher rates of revision DRF surgery at both 1 year (2.97% vs 2.10%) and 2 years (3.32% vs 2.36%), malunion/nonunion surgery at both 1 year (0.92% vs 0.53%) and 2 years (0.98% vs 0.63%), and 90-day emergency department visits (7.62% vs 6.03%). Infection rates were not significantly different at 1 year or 2 years.Conclusions: CTR at the time of DRF fixation was not associated with reduced subsequent CTR procedures. These findings do not support routine CTR during DRF fixation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过回顾性队列分析发现，在桡骨远端骨折固定术中同时进行腕管松解术并不能显著降低后续腕管松解手术的需求，反而增加了桡骨远端骨折翻修手术、畸形愈合/不愈合手术以及90天内急诊就诊的风险。
AI.research_question: 在桡骨远端骨折切开复位内固定术中同时进行腕管松解术是否能减少后续腕管松解手术及其他相关手术并发症？
AI.motivation: 临床上常在桡骨远端骨折固定术中预防性进行腕管松解术，旨在预防症状性腕管综合征，但支持这一做法的证据有限。需要评估这一常规做法是否真正有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于临床实践中的预防性干预理论，探讨预防性腕管松解术在桡骨远端骨折治疗中的有效性和安全性。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，使用TriNetX数据库，纳入2010-2025年间接受桡骨远端骨折切开复位内固定的成年患者。通过倾向评分匹配控制人口统计学和临床变量，包括骨折复杂性。主要结局是2年内后续腕管松解手术，次要结局包括90天并发症和1年手术并发症。
AI.findings:
1. 同时进行腕管松解术的患者在1年(1.75% vs 1.61%)和2年(2.24% vs 1.79%)内后续腕管松解手术率无显著差异
2. 同时进行腕管松解术的患者在1年(2.97% vs 2.10%)和2年(3.32% vs 2.36%)内桡骨远端骨折翻修手术率更高
3. 畸形愈合/不愈合手术率在1年(0.92% vs 0.53%)和2年(0.98% vs 0.63%)均更高
4. 90天内急诊就诊率更高(7.62% vs 6.03%)
5. 感染率无显著差异
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了预防性腕管松解术在桡骨远端骨折治疗中的理论基础，表明这一预防性干预可能不必要且可能增加其他并发症风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床实践提供重要指导：不建议在桡骨远端骨折固定术中常规进行腕管松解术，应重新评估这一临床常规做法，避免不必要的干预和相关并发症风险。

title: Who Can Afford to Stay Home After Childbirth: Socioeconomic Disparities in the Child Penalty in China
affiliations: Wuhan University and Peking University

detail.title: Who Can Afford to Stay Home After Childbirth: Socioeconomic Disparities in the Child Penalty in China
detail.abstract: Using CFPS data and an event-study design around first births, we document that all mothers experience a sharp decline in labor force participation at childbirth, but postbirth trajectories diverge substantially. Low-socioeconomic-position (SEP) mothers recover their pre-birth participation within four years, whereas high-SEP mothers remain out of the labor force for extended periods. This divergence is explained by the disadvantages faced by low-SEP mothers in terms of financial resources and access to grandparental care. Consequently, low-SEP mothers either incur a double burden when they must juggle work and childcare or suffer from parent-child separation when children are sent to live with non-coresident grandparents. Our study suggests that measurements of child penalty should go beyond pecuniary outcomes and affordable childcare is important for reducing child penalties.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用CFPS数据和事件研究法发现，所有母亲在生育后劳动力参与率都会急剧下降，但不同社会经济地位母亲的恢复轨迹差异显著。低社会经济地位母亲在四年内恢复生育前参与率，而高社会经济地位母亲长期退出劳动力市场。这种差异源于低社会经济地位母亲在财务资源和祖辈照料获取方面的劣势。
AI.research_question: 生育后不同社会经济地位母亲的劳动力参与恢复轨迹有何差异？这些差异背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注生育对母亲收入的惩罚效应，但对劳动力参与恢复轨迹的差异及其机制了解不足。理解不同社会经济地位母亲在生育后的不同恢复模式，有助于制定更精准的政策来减轻生育惩罚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生育惩罚理论、社会经济地位差异理论、家庭资源约束理论、代际照料支持理论
AI.method: 使用中国家庭追踪调查(CFPS)数据，采用事件研究法围绕首次生育事件进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 所有母亲在生育时劳动力参与率都急剧下降；2. 低社会经济地位母亲在四年内恢复生育前参与率，而高社会经济地位母亲长期退出劳动力市场；3. 这种差异源于低社会经济地位母亲在财务资源和祖辈照料获取方面的劣势；4. 低社会经济地位母亲面临工作与育儿双重负担或亲子分离困境
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了生育惩罚理论，从收入惩罚延伸到劳动力参与恢复轨迹差异；2. 揭示了社会经济地位通过财务资源和代际照料渠道影响生育后劳动力市场行为的机制；3. 提出了"双重负担"和"亲子分离"作为低社会经济地位母亲面临的具体困境
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者应超越货币化指标，全面衡量生育惩罚；2. 强调可负担的儿童照料服务对减轻生育惩罚的重要性；3. 为针对不同社会经济地位群体的差异化家庭政策提供依据

title: Continuing Crisis in Strait of Hormuz: Why Iran's Hold is Illegal and U.S. Military Force Alone Fails

detail.title: Continuing Crisis in Strait of Hormuz: Why Iran's Hold is Illegal and U.S. Military Force Alone Fails

publicationDetails.detailsText: Just Security - Emory Law Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: Emory University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Over a month into the conflict between Israel, Iran, and the United States, Iran has shown no sign of losing its capacity to control the Strait of Hormuz. Although the United States has agreed to a two-week suspension of strikes against Iran, Tehran continues to exercise de facto control over the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Foreign Minister has declared that vessels seeking to transit the Strait must coordinate directly with Iranian armed forces, subject to unspecified "technical limitations" -- a posture that amounts to a unilateral assertion of sovereign authority over one of the world's most critical maritime chokepoints. Meanwhile, President Trump has pledged that the United States "will be helping with traffic buildup in the Strait," but that commitment remains undefined, and it is far from certain whether U.S. naval forces will play any role. 

Since the conflict started, Iran has rerouted commercial shipping through Iranian territorial waters and imposed a $2 million transit fee, an illegal "Tehran toll booth." The fragile ceasefire does not appear to dismantle that arrangement. The United States must define the operational scope of its naval commitment in the Strait. And Iran's self-declared "technical limitations" must be rejected outright by the international community and not be made permanent. Limiting transit passage through the Strait of Hormuz is inconsistent with the freedom of navigation guaranteed under international law. At the outset of the conflict, I analyzed the key legal and operational issues in the Strait of Hormuz, assessing that the Strait's closure would provide Iran with enormous strategic leverage. One month in, that assessment has grown considerably darker.

AI.tldr: 本文分析伊朗在以色列、伊朗和美国冲突期间对霍尔木兹海峡的实际控制情况，包括伊朗单方面宣布主权、征收非法过境费、重新规划航线等行为，以及美国未明确的海军承诺，强调这些做法违反国际法航行自由原则。
AI.research_question: 在以色列、伊朗和美国冲突背景下，伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡的实际控制如何影响国际航运自由和国际法规范？
AI.motivation: 霍尔木兹海峡作为全球关键海上咽喉要道，伊朗单方面宣布主权控制、征收非法过境费并重新规划航线，严重威胁国际航运自由和国际法规范，需要分析其战略影响和法律后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际海洋法（特别是航行自由原则）、地缘政治理论（战略杠杆）、主权控制与国际法冲突理论。
AI.method: 基于冲突一个月来的实际观察和事件分析，结合法律评估和战略分析，采用案例研究方法。
AI.findings: 1. 伊朗维持对霍尔木兹海峡的实际控制能力；2. 伊朗单方面宣布主权要求，要求船只与伊朗武装部队协调；3. 征收200万美元非法"德黑兰收费站"过境费；4. 重新规划商业航运通过伊朗领海；5. 美国海军承诺不明确；6. 脆弱停火未改变现有安排。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了国家在冲突期间如何利用地理咽喉要道作为战略杠杆；2. 分析了单方面主权主张与国际法规范的冲突机制；3. 提出了"技术限制"作为控制手段的新概念框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 呼吁美国明确海军承诺的操作范围；2. 建议国际社会拒绝伊朗的"技术限制"主张；3. 强调必须维护霍尔木兹海峡的航行自由；4. 警示伊朗控制海峡带来的战略风险升级。

title: Same Underlying, Different Markets: How Convertible Bond Trading Drives Risk Spillovers
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics, Capital University of Economics and Business and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Same Underlying, Different Markets: How Convertible Bond Trading Drives Risk Spillovers
detail.abstract: This paper examines how trading in securities with the same underlying asset but different market structures generate risk spillovers. Using intraday high-frequency and order-level data for A-share stocks and convertible bonds in China, we find trading shocks in convertible bonds significantly increase the risk of the corresponding stocks and strengthen intraday tail dependence between convertible bonds and their underlying stocks. Active convertible bond trading does not enhance stock price discovery; instead, it intensifies quantitative and speculative trading in the underlying stocks, particularly for micro-cap and Shenzhen-listed stocks. Risk mitigation measures, such as limiting convertible bond trading to qualified investors or increasing transaction costs to restrain trading frequency, can substantially dampen these spillover effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用中国A股和可转债的高频数据，发现可转债交易冲击会显著增加对应股票的风险并加强两者间的尾部依赖，且活跃的可转债交易不会促进股票价格发现，反而会加剧股票的量化投机交易，特别是对小盘股和深市股票影响更大。
AI.research_question: 具有相同基础资产但不同市场结构的证券交易如何产生风险溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 理解不同市场结构下相同基础资产证券之间的风险传导机制，特别是可转债市场对股票市场的风险溢出效应，对于市场稳定和监管政策制定具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险溢出理论、市场微观结构理论、尾部依赖理论、价格发现理论
AI.method: 使用中国A股股票和可转债的日内高频数据和订单级数据进行分析
AI.findings: 1. 可转债交易冲击显著增加对应股票风险；2. 加强可转债与基础股票间的日内尾部依赖；3. 活跃的可转债交易不促进股票价格发现；4. 反而加剧基础股票的量化投机交易；5. 对小盘股和深市股票影响更显著

title: Institutional Investor Attention Shift and Insider Trading in Financial Sector
affiliations: California State University Dominguez Hills and Pepperdine University - Pepperdine Graziadio Business School (PGBS)

detail.title: Institutional Investor Attention Shift and Insider Trading in Financial Sector
detail.abstract: We examine whether institutional investor attention shift weakens investor monitoring and creates opportunities for insider sales in financial firms and profit from those sales. Using U.S. financial firms from 2002 to 2019, we measure attention shift with Kempf et al. (2017) portfolio-based institutional investor distraction. We find that greater institutional investor distraction is associated with more intensive insider selling. Distraction is also positively related to higher profitability of opportunistic insider sales measured by buy-and-hold abnormal returns and Fama-French four-factor alphas. The effects are stronger for directors and non-finance officers, under higher quasi-indexer ownership, and around negative earnings surprises. The results from alterative measure of attention shift using Bartik-style instrument on earnings announcement congestion in non-financial industries reaffirm both greater insider selling and greater profitability. We raise concerns that institutional investor attention shift could cause lapses in institutional oversight leading to greater insider sale and profitable opportunistic sale in financial firms.

AI.tldr: 机构投资者注意力转移会削弱投资者监督，为金融公司内部人创造出售机会并从中获利

title: The Negative Beta Pricing Puzzle: A Rational Inattention Solution

detail.title: The Negative Beta Pricing Puzzle: A Rational Inattention Solution
detail.abstract: Recent empirical evidence reveals a striking cross-sectional puzzle: when CAPM beta is decomposed via the covariance network into positive (β +) and negative (β-) components, only β-commands a significant risk premium (Doshi and Jacobs, 2026). This letter provides a parsimonious microfoundation grounded in rational inattention. When investors face a fixed cognitive budget K to process O(N 2) pairwise covariances, the optimal attention allocation follows a water-filling solution. Positive covariances cluster near the default prior and are endogenously ignored (m + ij = 0), whereas negative covariances represent salient deviations that absorb all cognitive resources (m-ij > 0). As N → ∞, the curse of dimensionality forces a strict corner solution that makes the asymmetric pricing of β-versus β + a mathematical necessity, not a behavioral anomaly.

AI.tldr: 该论文为CAPM beta分解中β-获得显著风险溢价而β+不显著的实证发现提供了基于理性疏忽的微观基础解释。当投资者面临固定认知预算处理大量协方差时，最优注意力分配导致负协方差获得关注而正协方差被忽略，从而解释了β-与β+的非对称定价。
AI.research_question: 为什么在CAPM beta分解为正负两部分时，只有负beta部分（β-）获得显著风险溢价，而正beta部分（β+）不显著？
AI.motivation: 近期实证研究发现了一个令人困惑的横截面谜题：当通过协方差网络将CAPM beta分解为正负两部分时，只有负beta部分（β-）获得显著风险溢价，而正beta部分（β+）不显著。这一发现挑战了传统资产定价理论，需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性疏忽理论（Rational Inattention），投资者面临固定认知预算约束，需要优化分配注意力处理大量协方差信息。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，基于理性疏忽框架构建数学模型，分析投资者在固定认知预算下处理O(N²)协方差矩阵的最优注意力分配问题，采用"注水算法"求解。
AI.findings: 当投资者面临固定认知预算K处理大量协方差时，最优注意力分配导致正协方差因接近先验默认值而被忽略（m+ij=0），而负协方差作为显著偏离吸收所有认知资源（m-ij>0）。随着资产数量N→∞，维度诅咒迫使严格角点解，使得β-与β+的非对称定价成为数学必然。
AI.theory_contributions: 为CAPM beta分解的非对称定价现象提供了基于理性疏忽的微观基础解释，将实证发现从行为异常重新解释为认知约束下的数学必然，扩展了理性疏忽理论在资产定价中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助投资者理解市场定价机制，认识到负beta资产的风险溢价来源，为投资组合构建和风险管理提供理论指导，解释了为何某些风险因素在市场中获得定价而其他因素不显著。

title: Getting To Guardianship: Impacts of Kinship Guardianship Subsidies on Guardianship Permanency for Foster Care-Involved Youth
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Getting To Guardianship: Impacts of Kinship Guardianship Subsidies on Guardianship Permanency for Foster Care-Involved Youth
detail.abstract: Federal child welfare policies increasingly aim to support kinship guardianship, reflecting evidence that children placed with relatives experience better outcomes. However, estimates on the effects of kinship placement vary considerably by data quality, measurement choices, and approaches to selection bias. This study examines the impact of Title IV-E KinGAP, which offers federal financial assistance to relatives who assume legal guardianship of foster children in their care. Using linked administrative data and exploiting variation in the timing of state KinGAP enactments across the United States from 2009 to 2018, I employ event study methods to examine impacts on exit to guardianship. Results indicate that Title IV-E KinGAP did not significantly influence the likelihood of exiting foster care or exiting to a guardianship placement. These findings suggest that financial support alone may be insufficient to encourage kinship permanency and identifies complementary policy opportunities to more effectively promote kinship placement and permanency for children in foster care.,The Kinship Guardianship Assistance Program (KinGAP) was authorized through the Fostering Connections to Success and Increasing Adoptions Act of 2008 and incentivizes relative guardianship for children in foster care through subsidization with the goal of increasing permanent placement with kin. KinGAP guarantees that children continue receiving financial support once they leave foster care through a kinship guardianship arrangement (HHS, 2021). As of 2021, 37 states and the District of Columbia have enacted Title IV-E federally subsidized guardianship assistance for youth in kinship care. The remaining 13 states did not adopt the Fostering Connections to Success and Increasing Adoptions Act of 2008, but may offer kinship care through expanding state programs, which is controlled for in this study. I use child-level data from national administrative records, state-level child welfare policies, and an original database of effective dates of federally-subsidized Title IV-E KinGAP legislation with quasi-experimental methods to examine the effect of Title IV-E subsidized KinGAP on the probability of exiting to guardianship as a permanency outcome.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了联邦Title IV-E KinGAP项目对寄养儿童永久安置效果的影响，发现该项目并未显著提高儿童离开寄养系统或进入亲属监护的可能性，表明单纯的经济支持可能不足以促进亲属永久安置。
AI.research_question: Title IV-E KinGAP项目（提供联邦经济援助支持亲属监护寄养儿童）对儿童离开寄养系统并进入亲属监护的可能性有何影响？
AI.motivation: 联邦儿童福利政策日益重视支持亲属监护，因为有证据表明亲属安置能带来更好的儿童发展结果。然而，现有关于亲属安置效果的研究因数据质量、测量方法和选择偏差处理方式不同而存在显著差异，需要更严谨的评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于儿童福利政策评估理论，特别是关于经济激励对亲属监护决策影响的理论框架，以及政策实施效果评估的准实验设计理论。
AI.method: 使用2009-2018年美国各州KinGAP实施时间差异，采用事件研究法（event study methods）进行准实验分析。数据包括儿童层面的全国行政记录、州级儿童福利政策数据，以及自行编制的联邦Title IV-E KinGAP立法生效日期数据库。
AI.findings: Title IV-E KinGAP并未显著影响儿童离开寄养系统的可能性，也未显著提高进入亲属监护安置的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了单纯经济激励足以促进亲属永久安置的理论假设，表明儿童福利政策需要更全面的理论框架来解释亲属监护决策的复杂性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，表明单纯的经济支持可能不足以鼓励亲属永久安置，需要探索补充性政策机会来更有效地促进寄养儿童的亲属安置和永久性。

title: From the North Sea to Vaca Muerta: Lessons from the Norwegian Model for Developing a World-Class Hydrocarbon Industry in Argentina

detail.title: From the North Sea to Vaca Muerta: Lessons from the Norwegian Model for Developing a World-Class Hydrocarbon Industry in Argentina

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the development of the Norwegian oil industry as one of the most successful cases of transforming natural resources into sustained economic development. Based on a historical-institutional analysis of the Norwegian model, it examines the public policies that enabled the construction of a highly competitive hydrocarbon industry, including institutional design, fiscal regime, local content strategies, and research and development policies. On this basis, the article identifies relevant lessons for the development of Vaca Muerta in Argentina, evaluating both the opportunities and limits of the transferability of the Norwegian model. It argues that Norway's success is not explained solely by geological factors but by the deliberate construction of institutions and productive capacities that articulated the State, international companies, and local actors into a long-term development project.

title: How Automatic Adjustment Mechanism Works in Practice a VECM Analysis of Monetary Transmission Mechanism in Bosnia and Herzegovina
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How Automatic Adjustment Mechanism Works in Practice a VECM Analysis of Monetary Transmission Mechanism in Bosnia and Herzegovina

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human subjects or individual-level identifiable data and therefore does not require ethics approval.

detail.abstract: This paper takes stock of the literature on the monetary transmission mechanism in currency boards and analyzes the process of monetary transmission in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The transmission of monetary signals through the economy is based on the automatic adjustment mechanism of the currency board. Three channels of monetary transmission are discussed in this paper: the interest rate channel, the narrow credit channel and the exchange rate channel. The empirical analysis shows how exogenous monetary shocks are transmitted through different channels and how long it takes for the automatic adjustment mechanism to restore equilibrium in the economy.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了货币局制度下的货币政策传导机制文献，并以波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那为例分析了货币传导过程。研究发现，在货币局制度下，货币信号通过自动调节机制传导，主要有利率渠道、狭义信贷渠道和汇率渠道三种传导途径。实证分析揭示了外生货币冲击如何通过这些渠道传导，以及自动调节机制恢复经济均衡所需的时间。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币局制度的自动调节机制理论，以及货币政策传导的三个主要渠道：利率渠道、狭义信贷渠道和汇率渠道。
AI.method: 文献综述与实证分析相结合的方法。首先综述货币局制度下货币政策传导机制的现有文献，然后以波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那为案例进行实证分析。

detail.abstract:
This is an amicus brief in support of a petition for rehearing (and rehearing en banc) in Syneren Technologies Corp., et al, v. United States (No. 2024-1424). Amici are law professors interested in ensuring that bedrock principles of administrative law, including Administrative Procedure Act (“APA”) standards, are applied to ensure that federal agencies act with integrity, accountability, and engage in fair and regular processes that do not subject contractors to arbitrary and capricious government action.

The brief advocates for U.S. Federal Circuit en banc rehearing on the issue of whether a federal agency can unilaterally, and without leave of the U.S. Court of Federal Claims (“COFC”), change the administrative record during ongoing bid protest litigation over that record. The brief also encourages the Court to revisit unnecessarily broad pronouncements made by the panel as to the inapplicability of foundational principles of administrative law to government procurement decisions. Among other things, the brief discusses the Federal Circuit's embrace of the relevant aspects of Chenery and Regents in bid protest litigation for the important administrative law principle that judicial review of agency action is limited to the grounds that the agency invoked at the time it took the action.

The brief was prepared by Travis Mullaney.

AI.tldr: 这是一份支持Syneren Technologies Corp.诉美国案重审请求的法庭之友意见书，主张联邦机构不应在投标抗议诉讼期间单方面更改行政记录，并强调行政程序法原则应适用于政府采购决策。
AI.research_question: 联邦机构是否可以在未经美国联邦索赔法院许可的情况下，在投标抗议诉讼期间单方面更改行政记录？行政程序法的基本原则是否适用于政府采购决策？
AI.motivation: 确保行政法的基本原则（包括行政程序法标准）得到适用，以保证联邦机构以诚信、问责的方式行事，并参与公平、规范的流程，避免承包商受到任意和反复无常的政府行为影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政程序法（APA）原则，包括Chenery原则和Regents原则，这些原则确立了司法审查应限于机构在采取行动时所依据的理由。
AI.method: 法庭之友意见书分析，通过法律论证和判例引用（特别是Chenery和Regents案），探讨行政法原则在政府采购背景下的适用性。
AI.findings: 联邦巡回法院应重新审议其关于行政法原则不适用于政府采购决策的过于宽泛的声明；机构不应在诉讼期间单方面更改行政记录；司法审查应限于机构在决策时提出的理由。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行政法的基本原则（特别是Chenery原则）明确应用于政府采购背景，强化了行政问责和程序公正的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为承包商提供法律保护，防止政府机构在诉讼期间单方面更改记录；促进政府采购决策的透明度和问责制；为法院审理类似案件提供法律依据。

title: The Professionalization Paradox: Why Law-Firm Hiring Unravels

detail.title: The Professionalization Paradox: Why Law-Firm Hiring Unravels
detail.abstract:
Law firms' recruiting timeline has accelerated sharply since the pandemic, with recruitment now moving into the first semester of law school. This acceleration has disrupted legal education, burdened students, and forced firms to make hiring decisions on increasingly limited information. Economists have long recognized this pattern, known as unraveling, as a recurring feature of entry-level professional markets; recent legal commentary has also begun to examine its effects on market participants. Yet these accounts have not fully explained why professional labor markets are especially susceptible to unraveling. As a result, existing responses tend to target surface symptoms of the acceleration without confronting the structural conditions that produce it. 

This Essay offers an institutional account of unraveling in the law-firm hiring market. It argues that pressure toward earlier contracting is an endogenous consequence of law's professionalization. The same historical developments that standardized legal education and organized modern law firms also generated the conditions that make preemptive hiring both feasible and attractive. It then shows why the leading reform strategies are constrained: controlling timing depends on control of the cheapest distribution channel for evaluative signals, while weakening those signals invites firms to substitute their own assessments. Left unchecked, that substitution threatens to displace legal education from the gatekeeping role on which law's professional status depends. Resolving this paradox will require the profession to reconsider the design of legal education so that it can sustain law's claim to professional status while giving employers a reason to wait.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了律师事务所招聘时间线加速（称为"解绑"现象）的根本原因，认为这是法律职业化的内生结果，而非表面现象。作者分析了法律教育标准化和现代律所组织如何创造了提前招聘的条件，并指出现有改革策略的局限性。
AI.research_question: 为什么专业劳动力市场（特别是法律市场）特别容易受到"解绑"（提前招聘）现象的影响？其结构性原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 疫情后律师事务所招聘时间线急剧加速，已提前到法学院第一学期，这扰乱了法律教育，增加了学生负担，并迫使律所在信息有限的情况下做出招聘决定。现有研究未能充分解释专业劳动力市场为何特别容易受到这种"解绑"现象的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 劳动力市场"解绑"理论（unraveling theory）
2. 职业化理论（professionalization theory）
3. 信号理论（signaling theory）
4. 制度理论（institutional theory）
AI.method: 理论分析/制度分析：通过历史制度分析，探讨法律职业化过程如何创造了提前招聘的结构性条件。
AI.findings:
1. 提前招聘的压力是法律职业化的内生结果

3. 现有改革策略受限于对评估信号最廉价传播渠道的控制
4. 削弱这些信号会导致律所用自己的评估替代，威胁法律教育的把关角色
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 为专业劳动力市场的"解绑"现象提供了制度解释
2. 将提前招聘与法律职业化的历史发展联系起来

4. 提出了法律教育在维护职业地位中的核心矛盾

2. 建议重新设计法律教育，使其既能维持法律的职业地位，又能给雇主等待的理由
