title: The Upside of Unreliability: Screening via Sunk Costs in Platforms

detail.title: The Upside of Unreliability: Screening via Sunk Costs in Platforms

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Number JP21H04979 and JST ERATO Grant Number JPMJER2301, Japan.

detail.abstract: Platforms often require users to incur sunk participation costs (fees, effort, or waiting) before learning whether service will be delivered. We study such environments with a model that separates actual non-delivery risk from perceived risk. When users are naïve about risk, unreliability creates scope for ex post manipulation: within a benchmark class of efficient two-bidder mechanisms, the war-of-attrition (second-price all-pay) format maximizes deviation revenue. When risk is common knowledge but budgets and valuations are misaligned, unreliability instead screens participation. Higher reliability can attract deep-pocket, lower-valuation entrants who crowd out budget-constrained high-valuation users, while intermediate unreliability can induce their exit and may increase consumer surplus discontinuously at the exit threshold. We do not advocate intentional unreliability; rather, we highlight a design tradeoff between trust-enhancing reliability and screening through endogenous entry in settings with unavoidable execution risk and limited commitment.

AI.tldr: 平台常要求用户在得知服务是否交付前承担沉没参与成本（费用、努力或等待）。本文研究此类环境中实际不交付风险与感知风险的分离。当用户对风险天真时，不可靠性创造了事后操纵空间：在高效双投标机制基准中，消耗战（第二价格全支付）格式最大化偏离收益。当风险是共同知识但预算与估值错配时，不可靠性反而筛选参与。更高的可靠性可能吸引资金雄厚但估值较低的新进入者，挤出预算受限的高估值用户；而中等程度的不可靠性可能促使后者退出，并在退出阈值处不连续地增加消费者剩余。本文不提倡故意不可靠，而是强调在不可避免的执行风险和有限承诺下，信任增强的可靠性与通过内生进入进行筛选之间的设计权衡。
AI.research_question: 在平台要求用户承担沉没参与成本的环境中，不可靠性（实际与感知风险分离）如何影响机制设计、用户参与和消费者福利？
AI.motivation: 许多平台（如众筹、共享经济、在线服务）要求用户在得知服务是否交付前支付费用、投入努力或等待，这涉及沉没成本。平台存在执行风险（可能无法交付服务），而用户对风险的感知可能与实际风险不同。理解这种环境下的机制设计对平台运营和用户福利至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 沉没参与成本与执行风险理论；2. 实际风险与感知风险分离框架；3. 机制设计理论（特别是双投标机制）；4. 战争消耗战（第二价格全支付）机制；5. 预算约束与估值错配下的筛选理论；6. 内生进入与退出决策模型。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建分离实际不交付风险与感知风险的形式模型，分析不同信息结构（用户天真vs风险共同知识）下的机制设计。在基准高效双投标机制类中比较不同格式，特别关注战争消耗战机制。在预算与估值错配情境下，分析可靠性如何影响用户参与决策和消费者剩余。
AI.findings: 1. 当用户天真时：不可靠性创造事后操纵空间，战争消耗战机制在高效双投标机制类中最大化偏离收益；2. 当风险共同知识但预算与估值错配时：不可靠性筛选参与，更高可靠性可能吸引资金雄厚但估值较低的用户，挤出预算受限的高估值用户；3. 中等不可靠性可能促使低估值用户退出，在退出阈值处不连续增加消费者剩余；4. 揭示信任增强的可靠性与通过内生进入筛选之间的设计权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立实际风险与感知风险分离的形式框架；2. 证明在用户天真时，战争消耗战机制在高效双投标机制类中的最优性；3. 揭示预算约束与估值错配下，可靠性作为筛选工具的作用；4. 提出在不可避免执行风险下，可靠性与筛选之间的理论权衡。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台设计者提供机制选择指导：在用户可能天真时，战争消耗战机制可能最大化收益；2. 警示平台：盲目提高可靠性可能吸引"错误"类型的用户，损害高价值用户参与；3. 建议平台管理者考虑适度不可靠性作为筛选工具的可能性；4. 强调在有限承诺环境中，需要在建立信任与有效筛选之间取得平衡。

title: Startup States

detail.title: Startup States

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the sole author of this manuscript and serves as Founding Director of the Startup States Society, a Geneva-based association engaged in research and public discussion concerning sovereign formation and institutional design. The author declares no competing financial or commercial interests beyond this disclosed affiliation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript is a work of doctrinal legal and political analysis and does not involve human subjects research, empirical data collection, or experimental procedures. Accordingly, no institutional ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author self-funded the research and preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract:
This paper advances a treaty-first framework for the lawful creation of new sovereign states within the existing architecture of international law. Departing from unilateral secessionist models, digital “network state” proposals, and extra-legal assertions of sovereignty, the Startup State model proposes a consensual pathway to statehood grounded in formal treaty relations with an existing recognised state.

Drawing upon the Montevideo Convention of 1933, the United Nations Charter, the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties, and relevant jurisprudence of the International Court of Justice, the paper examines the doctrinal foundations of statehood, recognition, territorial integrity, and international legal personality. It evaluates both declaratory and constitutive theories of recognition and situates the Startup State model within orthodox principles of sovereign equality and consent-based international ordering.

The paper further contrasts Startup States with micronational movements, special administrative regions, charter cities, and contemporary “network state” proposals, arguing that durable and legitimate sovereignty must arise through lawful agreement rather than technological coordination or unilateral declaration. It proposes that treaty-based sovereign formation offers a peaceful, rules-based mechanism for institutional innovation in governance without destabilising the existing international system.

By reframing sovereignty as a matter of negotiated institutional design rather than revolutionary rupture, this paper contributes to contemporary debates on state formation, recognition doctrine, and the future of political organisation under international law.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"初创国家"模型，通过条约而非单边分离的方式创建新主权国家，在国际法框架内提供基于同意的国家形成路径。
AI.research_question: 如何在现有国际法框架内通过条约方式合法创建新的主权国家？
AI.motivation: 现有国家形成模式存在缺陷：单边分离主义破坏稳定，数字"网络国家"缺乏法律基础，非法主权主张无效。需要一种既合法又创新的国家形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于1933年《蒙特维多公约》、联合国宪章、维也纳条约法公约和国际法院判例，结合国家地位、承认、领土完整和国际法律人格等学说，探讨宣示性和构成性承认理论。
AI.method: 理论分析、法律文本解释、比较研究。分析国际法基本原则，对比不同国家形成模式（微国家运动、特别行政区、特许城市、网络国家）。
AI.findings: 条约基础的初创国家模式符合国际法正统原则，提供和平、规则导向的治理创新机制，不破坏现有国际体系。主权可通过协商制度设计而非革命性断裂实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"条约优先"的国家形成框架；2) 将主权重新定义为协商制度设计问题；3) 在宣示性与构成性承认理论间定位新模型；4) 丰富国家形成和承认学说。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为治理创新提供合法路径；2) 避免单边分离的冲突风险；3) 为数字时代国家形成提供法律基础；4) 促进国际体系稳定下的制度创新。

title: Your Model Update Is an Eviction Notice: Property Estates in Parasocial AI Relationships

detail.title: Your Model Update Is an Eviction Notice: Property Estates in Parasocial AI Relationships

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. The author is not employed by, affiliated with, or compensated by any AI company discussed in this paper. The systematic comparison of platform marketing language and Terms of Service in Table 2 was conducted using publicly available materials accessed through each company's website. No commercial relationship, consultancy, or advisory role exists between the author and any entity referenced herein.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received no external funding. The author is an independent researcher and received no grant, fellowship, or institutional support for this work.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not require ethics approval. The paper conducts doctrinal legal analysis drawing on published case law, publicly available Terms of Service, publicly available marketing materials, and composite accounts of user experiences drawn from publicly accessible online forums and media reports. No human participants were recruited, no personal data was collected, and no individual user is identified or identifiable. The composite incident described in Section 1 is constructed from publicly documented patterns across multiple platforms, as noted in footnote 1.

detail.abstract: This paper argues that parasocial relationships between users and AI systems constitute de facto trusts under English property law-a claim that is institutional, not analogical. Users who accumulate significant emotional investment in AI systems acquire equitable interests that contract, tort, and consumer protection law fail to recognise. Model updates that unilaterally alter personality parameters, reset conversational memory, or modify behavioural dispositions operate as constructive evictions-displacing users from emotional estates built through sustained interaction, without notice, compensation, or migration pathways. We demonstrate that fiduciary duty alone is insufficient: it cannot differentiate between casual and sustained users, provides no registration mechanism, and fails to identify what was taken. Property law supplies the graduated estate taxonomy, transparency infrastructure, and preventive remedies that fiduciary duty lacks. We ground the constructive trust argument in modern equity, addressing the tightening of the unconscionability standard through Cobbe v Yeoman's Row [2008], Jones v Kernott [2011], and FHR European Ventures v Cedar Capital [2014], and demonstrate through systematic comparison of four major platforms that estate inconsistency between marketing language and Terms of Service is a market-wide pattern actionable under Prest v Petrodel [2013] and Autoclenz v Belcher [2011]. We formalise the claim through a five-layer estate architecture extending the Constraint Cascade framework, assigning each constraint layer a corresponding property estate. The architecture reveals cross-layer conflicts-between, for instance, a user's periodic tenancy and a company's alignment obligation-and provides procedural resolution: updates proceed substantively but require notice, graduated rollout, and rollback. The paper concludes with an implementable eth-* Independent researcher.

AI.tldr: 本文主张用户与AI系统之间的准社会关系构成英国财产法下的实际信托关系。用户对AI系统的情感投入形成衡平法权益，而AI模型更新单方面改变人格参数、重置对话记忆或修改行为倾向，构成了"建设性驱逐"，剥夺了用户通过持续互动建立的情感财产。作者提出五层财产架构来解决用户权益保护问题。
AI.research_question: 用户与AI系统之间的准社会关系是否构成英国财产法下的实际信托关系？如何通过财产法框架保护用户对AI系统的情感投资权益？
AI.motivation: 当前合同法、侵权法和消费者保护法未能充分保护用户对AI系统的重大情感投资。AI平台单方面更新模型、重置对话记忆或改变人格参数，相当于剥夺了用户通过长期互动建立的情感财产，而现有法律框架缺乏相应的保护机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 英国财产法中的衡平法权益理论；2. 准社会关系理论；3. 建设性信托理论；4. 现代衡平法判例（Cobbe v Yeoman's Row, Jones v Kernott, FHR European Ventures v Cedar Capital等）；5. 约束级联框架扩展。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：基于英国财产法和衡平法判例建立法律论证；2. 比较分析：系统比较四大AI平台的营销语言与服务条款之间的不一致性；3. 架构设计：提出五层财产架构，将约束级联框架扩展为对应的财产权益层次。
AI.findings: 1. 用户与AI系统的准社会关系构成实际信托关系；2. AI模型更新构成"建设性驱逐"，剥夺用户情感财产；3. 信义义务不足以保护用户权益，需要财产法框架；4. 四大AI平台普遍存在营销语言与服务条款不一致的问题；5. 五层财产架构能有效解决跨层冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将准社会关系理论应用于AI系统法律分析；2. 提出AI用户情感投资构成衡平法权益的新理论；3. 扩展约束级联框架为五层财产架构；4. 将财产法概念应用于数字情感财产保护；5. 为AI伦理治理提供新的法律理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为AI平台更新提供程序性解决方案（通知、渐进推出、回滚机制）；2. 为监管机构提供AI用户权益保护框架；3. 为司法实践提供处理AI相关纠纷的法律依据；4. 为AI平台设计更公平的服务条款提供指导；5. 促进AI系统与用户关系的长期稳定性。

title: A Bibliometric Analysis of the Knowledge base on Blue Economies and Sustainability
affiliations: Sardar Patel University, G.H. Patel Post Graduate Institute of Business Management and Sardar Patel University

detail.title: A Bibliometric Analysis of the Knowledge base on Blue Economies and Sustainability

publicationDetails.detailsText: SN Business & Economics, volume 5, issue 7, 2025[10.1007/s43546-025-00865-0 ]

detail.abstract: This study aims to review the landscape of the Blue economies (BE) body of literature with a special focus on sustainability from 1993 to 2023. The Scopus database was employed to obtain the data. The selection process was done through the PRISMA technique further to which tools such as VOSviewer and Excel were used for the quantitative analyses. Findings from this study will include an in-depth analysis of the topmost articles relating to BE. It will also include the study of trending terms, highest publishing sources, and nations. This study will provide prospects for future research from these trends and present gaps for further research in the BE field.

AI.tldr: 本文对1993-2023年蓝色经济文献进行系统性回顾，特别关注可持续发展主题，通过文献计量分析识别研究趋势、热点领域和研究空白。
AI.research_question: 1993-2023年间蓝色经济文献的研究现状如何？特别是可持续发展方面的研究趋势、热点领域和未来研究方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 蓝色经济作为新兴研究领域，需要系统性梳理其发展脉络和研究现状，特别是可持续发展方面的研究进展，为未来研究提供方向指引。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文献计量学理论，包括引文分析、共词分析、合作网络分析等理论框架。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA方法进行文献筛选，使用Scopus数据库获取数据，运用VOSviewer和Excel进行定量分析，包括文献计量分析、趋势分析等。
AI.findings: 将提供蓝色经济领域高被引文献的深入分析、热门术语趋势、主要出版来源和国家分布等量化结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建蓝色经济文献的知识图谱，揭示该领域的研究演进路径和理论发展脉络，为蓝色经济理论体系完善提供基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别蓝色经济研究的关键趋势和空白领域，为政策制定者、研究者和实践者提供未来研究方向和实践指导。

title: MEV Is the PFOF of Crypto: An Implicit Tax Per Transaction Working Paper

detail.title: MEV Is the PFOF of Crypto: An Implicit Tax Per Transaction Working Paper

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any people or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced this study. No conflicts of interest exist.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses exclusively publicly available, anonymized on-chain blockchain data sourced from Uniswap Labs, Flashbots, EigenPhi, ZeroMEV, and Etherscan. No human participants were recruited, surveyed, or interviewed, and no personally identifiable information was collected or processed. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was self-funded by the author. No grants, institutional support, or employer funding of any kind was received

detail.abstract: We decompose the total execution cost of trading on decentralized exchanges into visible and hidden components, using 534,198 verified Uniswap v3 swaps from Adams et al. (2024) and on-chain MEV data from Flashbots, EigenPhi, and ZeroMEV spanning December 2019 through October 2025. The visible liquidity-provider fee accounts for only 28-36% of total cost; the remainder-gas, adverse slippage, market impact, and maximal extractable value (MEV)-is implicit. We formalize a structural equivalence between MEV and Payment for Order Flow (PFOF): both extract rents from uninformed retail flow via ordering privilege, but MEV provides no offsetting rebate. Exploiting the Merge (September 15, 2022) as a natural experiment, we show that proposer-builder separation increased MEV extraction intensity by eliminating failed-transaction friction. During top-decile volatility, sandwich victimization probability rises approximately 87% for memecoins and adverse slippage quadruples. We estimate cumulative Ethereum MEV exceeds $1.38 billion through mid-2024-comprising $675 million pre-Merge and 526,207 ETH in post-Merge validator revenue-and that sandwich attacks imposed approximately $60 million in cumulative losses over the twelve months ending October 2025, an implicit tax of 2-34 basis points per vulnerable trade depending on asset type, compared with 1-2 basis points under PFOF. These findings argue for encrypted mempools, batch auctions, and regulatory parity between on-chain and off-chain order-flow extraction.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了去中心化交易所（DEX）交易的总执行成本，发现流动性提供者费用仅占28-36%，其余成本来自gas费、不利滑点、市场影响和MEV。研究将MEV与支付订单流（PFOF）进行结构对比，利用以太坊合并作为自然实验，发现合并后MEV提取强度增加，三明治攻击造成约6000万美元损失。
AI.research_question: 去中心化交易所（DEX）交易的总执行成本构成是什么？MEV（最大可提取价值）与支付订单流（PFOF）有何结构相似性？以太坊合并如何影响MEV提取强度？
AI.motivation: 传统上对DEX交易成本的分析主要关注可见的流动性提供者费用，但忽略了隐形成本如gas费、滑点、市场影响和MEV。这些隐形成本对交易者实际成本有重要影响，需要系统量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 交易成本分解理论：将总执行成本分解为可见和隐形成分；2. MEV理论：最大可提取价值的概念和机制；3. 支付订单流（PFOF）理论：传统金融市场中的订单流支付机制；4. 结构等价理论：MEV与PFOF在租金提取机制上的相似性。
AI.method: 1. 使用534,198个已验证的Uniswap v3交易数据（Adams et al., 2024）；2. 整合来自Flashbots、EigenPhi和ZeroMEV的链上MEV数据（2019年12月-2025年10月）；3. 利用以太坊合并（2022年9月15日）作为自然实验；4. 定量分析MEV提取强度变化；5. 成本分解和损失估算。
AI.findings: 1. 流动性提供者费用仅占总成本的28-36%；2. 其余成本来自gas费、不利滑点、市场影响和MEV；3. MEV与PFOF结构相似但无回扣；4. 合并后MEV提取强度增加（消除失败交易摩擦）；5. 高波动期meme币三明治攻击概率上升87%，不利滑点翻四倍；6. 累计MEV超13.8亿美元；7. 三明治攻击造成约6000万美元损失（每笔交易隐含税2-34基点）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化DEX交易隐形成本；2. 建立MEV与PFOF的结构等价理论框架；3. 提出合并对MEV提取机制影响的理论解释；4. 为加密内存池、批量拍卖等解决方案提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为交易者提供成本透明度；2. 为监管机构提供MEV与PFOF的对比分析；3. 支持加密内存池、批量拍卖等解决方案的实施；4. 推动链上链下订单流提取的监管对等；5. 为投资者和开发者提供风险管理依据。

title: Institutional Ownership and Cross-Border Spillovers of Monetary Policy
affiliations: Université Laval and

detail.title: Institutional Ownership and Cross-Border Spillovers of Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: We find that Canadian stocks with greater ownership by institutional investors from the United States (US) are more sensitive to US monetary policy surprises. Upon a 25 basis point contractionary shock to fed funds futures, a firm with one standard deviation greater US ownership share sees its stock returns lowered by an additional 27.3 basis points, or is 45.8 percent more sensitive. These firms also reduce their subsequent debt holdings and their capital expenditures by a greater margin. Neither revenue dependence on the US nor the signaling effect of the Fed on the Bank of Canada appears to drive these findings. Our results are consistent with a macroeconomic model with inelastic asset demand, complemented by external financing constraints.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，加拿大股票中美国机构投资者持股比例越高，对美国货币政策冲击的反应越敏感。当美联储基金期货出现25个基点的紧缩冲击时，美国持股比例高一个标准差的公司股票回报率会额外下降27.3个基点，敏感性增加45.8%。这些公司随后也会更大程度地减少债务持有和资本支出。
AI.research_question: 美国机构投资者持股如何影响加拿大公司对美国货币政策冲击的敏感性？
AI.motivation: 随着全球金融市场日益一体化，理解跨境资本流动如何影响各国公司对货币政策冲击的反应具有重要意义。特别是美国作为全球最大经济体，其货币政策对其他国家的影响机制值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产需求缺乏弹性的宏观经济模型，辅以外部融资约束理论。该框架解释了为什么美国机构投资者的持股会影响加拿大公司对美联储政策冲击的敏感性。
AI.method: 实证分析加拿大股票数据，研究美国机构投资者持股比例与美国货币政策冲击对加拿大股票回报率的影响关系。使用美联储基金期货数据衡量货币政策冲击，并控制其他潜在影响因素。
AI.findings: 1. 美国机构投资者持股比例越高的加拿大公司，对美国货币政策冲击的敏感性越强；2. 面对紧缩冲击时，这些公司股票回报率下降幅度更大；3. 这些公司随后会更大程度地减少债务持有和资本支出；4. 结果不能由对美收入依赖或美联储对加拿大央行的信号效应解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为跨境资本流动如何影响货币政策传导提供了新的理论视角；2. 验证了资产需求缺乏弹性模型在解释跨境资本流动效应方面的适用性；3. 深化了对全球金融市场一体化背景下货币政策溢出效应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为加拿大公司管理跨境资本流动风险提供参考；2. 为政策制定者理解货币政策跨国传导机制提供依据；3. 为投资者评估跨境投资组合风险提供实证证据；4. 有助于金融机构更好地评估和管理跨境投资风险。

title: How Institutions Enter Production
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: How Institutions Enter Production
detail.abstract: This paper develops a framework for understanding institutional change as the reorganization of productive coordination. Institutions are conceptualized as rule systems that govern how complementary inputs are combined and sustained in production. When evolving capabilities outpace inherited arrangements, skilled agents initiate institutional creation, restoration, or adaptation to realign governance with productive activity. By linking micro-level institutional adjustment to industrial transformation, the analysis explains how changing rule systems reshape productive organization and long-run performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个理解制度变迁的框架，将制度视为协调生产活动的规则系统，当能力发展超越既有制度安排时，有技能的代理人会启动制度变革以重新调整治理与生产活动的关系。
AI.research_question: 制度变迁如何作为生产协调的重组过程而发生？制度规则系统如何影响生产组织与长期绩效？
AI.motivation: 理解制度变迁的微观机制，解释制度如何随着生产能力发展而演变，以及这种演变如何影响经济绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度作为协调生产活动的规则系统；制度变迁是生产协调的重组过程；有技能的代理人在制度变革中的作用。
AI.method: 理论框架构建，将微观层面的制度调整与产业转型联系起来进行分析。
AI.findings: 制度变迁发生在能力发展超越既有制度安排时；有技能的代理人会启动制度创建、恢复或适应；制度规则系统的变化重塑生产组织和长期绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了制度变迁作为生产协调重组的理论框架；将制度概念化为治理互补投入组合的规则系统；连接了微观制度调整与宏观产业转型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解制度变革过程提供框架；帮助企业理解制度环境变化对生产组织的影响；为经济发展战略提供理论指导。

title: Zero-MDR and the Restructuring of Profitability and Competitive Dynamics in India's UPI Ecosystem (2016-2025)
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Zero-MDR and the Restructuring of Profitability and Competitive Dynamics in India's UPI Ecosystem (2016-2025)
detail.abstract: This study examines how India's zero-Merchant Discount Rate (zero-MDR) policy has restructured the revenue model of third-party application providers (TPAPs) operating within the Unified Payments Interface (UPI). Using a mixed-method secondary analysis of financial statements, policy documents, and industry reports from 2016 to 2025, it analyses the evolving revenue models of the major TPAPs as well as the regulatory approach utilised by India, situating these developments in comparison with China's market-driven framework. The findings suggest that zero-MDR did not eliminate platform sustainability but redirected monetisation toward embedded financial services. The study highlights a structural trade-off between public financial inclusivity and private revenue viability within India's digital payments ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 印度零商户折扣率政策重构了UPI第三方应用提供商的收入模式，从交易收费转向嵌入式金融服务，揭示了公共金融包容性与私人收入可持续性之间的结构性权衡。
AI.research_question: 印度零商户折扣率政策如何重构统一支付接口中第三方应用提供商的收入模式？
AI.motivation: 研究印度零MDR政策对数字支付生态系统的影响，特别是对第三方应用提供商收入模式的改变，并与中国的市场驱动框架进行比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台经济学、监管政策分析、数字支付生态系统理论、公私部门平衡理论
AI.method: 混合方法二次分析：分析2016-2025年的财务报表、政策文件和行业报告，比较印度和中国的发展模式
AI.findings: 零MDR政策并未消除平台可持续性，而是将货币化转向嵌入式金融服务；揭示了公共金融包容性与私人收入可持续性之间的结构性权衡
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了数字支付生态系统中的公私平衡理论，提出了监管政策与商业模式创新的互动框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供平衡金融包容性与平台可持续性的参考，为企业提供在监管约束下的商业模式创新策略

title: The Inefficient Pricing of News Shocks
affiliations: , University of Melbourne, Yale SOM and University of Melbourne

detail.title: The Inefficient Pricing of News Shocks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Antoine Didisheim is at University of Melbourne. Bryan Kelly is at Yale School of Management, AQR Capital Management, and NBER. Mo Pourmohammadi is at Yale School of Management. Hanqing Tian is at University of Melbourne. AQR Capital Management is a global investment management firm that may or may not apply similar investment techniques or methods of analysis as described herein. The views expressed here are those of the authors and not necessarily those of AQR.

detail.abstract: The stock market fails to efficiently process information in news text (Chen et al., 2026). But news itself is highly predictable by prevailing stock characteristics, which complicates inferences about market efficiency. After purging news of its predictable content, the resulting “news shocks” more than double the monthly return predictive power of raw news, and they continue to significantly predict returns up to 18 months ahead. The magnitude and longevity of the news shock anomaly is larger than every anomaly in the Jensen et al. (2022) universe. The news shock anomaly derives from negative-tone and quantitative topics to which investors underreact and from high-attention and ambiguous topics to which investors overreact.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在剔除新闻中可预测的内容后，得到的"新闻冲击"比原始新闻的月度回报预测能力提高了一倍以上，且能持续预测长达18个月的回报。这一新闻冲击异常比所有已知的股票市场异常都更显著。
AI.research_question: 在剔除新闻中可预测的内容后，新闻冲击对股票回报的预测能力如何？投资者对不同类型新闻冲击的反应模式是什么？
AI.motivation: 股票市场未能有效处理新闻文本中的信息，但新闻本身又高度可预测，这使得对市场效率的推断变得复杂。需要分离出新闻中真正不可预测的部分来研究市场反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率理论、投资者行为偏差（反应不足和反应过度）、新闻可预测性、信息处理理论
AI.method: 从新闻文本中剔除可预测的内容（基于现有股票特征），得到"新闻冲击"，然后分析其对股票回报的预测能力，并与已知的市场异常进行比较。
AI.findings: 1. 新闻冲击的月度回报预测能力比原始新闻提高了一倍以上；2. 新闻冲击能持续预测长达18个月的回报；3. 新闻冲击异常比Jensen等人（2022）研究中的所有异常都更显著；4. 负面语气和量化主题的新闻冲击导致投资者反应不足，而高关注度和模糊主题的新闻冲击导致投资者反应过度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了新闻冲击的概念，分离了新闻中可预测和不可预测的部分；2. 揭示了投资者对不同类型新闻冲击的系统性行为偏差；3. 为市场效率研究提供了更精确的测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了更有效的新闻分析工具；2. 帮助识别市场中的定价错误机会；3. 为量化投资策略提供了新的因子。

title: Human Rights Due Diligence and the ILO Tripartite Declaration on Multinational Enterprises and Social Policy in Context

detail.title: Human Rights Due Diligence and the ILO Tripartite Declaration on Multinational Enterprises and Social Policy in Context

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in R. Dalmasso, A. Seifert & A. Musiala (eds.), Le devoir de vigilance à la croisée des chemins, éditions Mare et Martin, 2026.

detail.abstract:
The concept of human rights due diligence (HRDD) elaborated in the United Nations Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs) dominates current policy and regulatory initiatives relating to multinational businesses’ human rights responsibility. Within the ILO, it has become part of its discussions and policy developments on decent work and global supply chains (GSCs). Following the 2017 revision, the ILO Tripartite Declaration on Multinational Enterprises and Social Policy (MNE Declaration) integrates due diligence largely mirroring the text of the UNGPs. However, it also includes a distinct approach to it.  
This paper examines the process that led to the integration of due diligence into the MNE Declaration and the interwoven UN and ILO contexts that explain such integration and its terms.  It explores the limits of the MNE Declaration’s contribution to the definition and implementation of due diligence. In addition, it highlights how the MNE Declaration’s approach to due diligence has a unique feature, which has the potential to counter some of the shortcomings of the dominant HRDD paradigm. This rests on placing workers’ agency at the core of the due diligence process.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了国际劳工组织《多国企业宣言》如何纳入人权尽责概念，探讨了其与联合国指导原则的异同，特别关注该宣言将工人能动性置于尽责过程核心的独特方法。
AI.research_question: 国际劳工组织《多国企业宣言》如何整合人权尽责概念？这种整合过程及其条款如何受到联合国和国际劳工组织背景的影响？该宣言对尽责的定义和实施有哪些局限性？其独特方法如何弥补主流人权尽责范式的不足？
AI.motivation: 联合国《工商企业与人权指导原则》中的人权尽责概念主导了当前关于跨国企业人权责任的政策和监管倡议。国际劳工组织在其体面劳动和全球供应链讨论中也采纳了这一概念。2017年修订后，国际劳工组织《多国企业宣言》整合了与联合国指导原则文本基本一致的尽责要求，但也包含独特的方法。需要研究这一整合过程及其意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联合国《工商企业与人权指导原则》的人权尽责框架，结合国际劳工组织的三方机制（政府、雇主、工人）和体面劳动议程，分析国际劳工组织《多国企业宣言》对尽责概念的独特解释。
AI.method: 本文采用政策分析和文本分析方法，考察国际劳工组织《多国企业宣言》整合人权尽责概念的过程，分析联合国和国际劳工组织背景对这种整合的影响，比较宣言与联合国指导原则的异同。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）国际劳工组织《多国企业宣言》整合人权尽责的过程受到联合国和国际劳工组织双重背景影响；2）该宣言对尽责的定义和实施存在局限性；3）宣言的独特方法将工人能动性置于尽责过程核心，这有助于弥补主流人权尽责范式的不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）揭示了国际劳工组织框架下人权尽责概念的特殊性；2）提出了工人能动性作为尽责过程核心要素的理论视角；3）丰富了跨国企业人权责任的理论讨论，特别是国际劳工组织三方机制对尽责概念的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为政策制定者提供了国际劳工组织《多国企业宣言》实施尽责的具体指导；2）为企业提供了将工人参与纳入人权尽责过程的实践方法；3）为工会和工人组织参与尽责过程提供了依据；4）有助于改进全球供应链中的人权保护机制。

title: Quadruped and Rail-Bound Robots in Modern Railway Maintenance: A Comparative Analysis

detail.title: Quadruped and Rail-Bound Robots in Modern Railway Maintenance: A Comparative Analysis

The research was conducted independently, and all interpretations are based solely on publicly available data, industry reports, and analytical modeling conducted by the author.

detail.abstract: Railway infrastructure operators are increasingly integrating robotic systems into inspection regimes to address aging assets, safety risks, labour constraints, and operational inefficiencies. This paper examines the emerging Railway Inspection Robot Market through three deployment archetypes: rail-bound inspection platforms, quadruped confined-space robots, and AI-enabled inspection integration services. Using documented examples from Shenhao Technology's RIIS005 platform, Network Rail's deployment of Unitree robotic systems, and Belvoir Rail's quadruped integration model, this study analyses technological capabilities, operational economics, regulatory implications, and adoption barriers. The research evaluates how robotics transitions railway inspection from reactive and labour-intensive processes toward predictive, datadriven asset management.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了铁路巡检机器人市场的三种部署模式：轨道巡检平台、四足受限空间机器人和AI集成服务，探讨了技术能力、运营经济性、监管影响和采用障碍，评估了机器人如何将铁路巡检从被动、劳动密集型转变为预测性、数据驱动的资产管理。
AI.research_question: 铁路巡检机器人市场如何通过不同的部署模式（轨道巡检平台、四足受限空间机器人、AI集成服务）实现从传统人工巡检向预测性、数据驱动资产管理的转型？
AI.motivation: 铁路基础设施面临资产老化、安全风险、劳动力限制和运营效率低下等挑战，需要引入机器人系统来改善巡检工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采用理论、运营经济学、监管框架分析、资产管理转型理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，分析三个具体部署案例：神号科技的RIIS005平台、Network Rail的Unitree机器人系统部署、Belvoir Rail的四足机器人集成模式
AI.findings: 机器人技术能够显著提升铁路巡检效率，实现从被动维护到预测性维护的转变，但面临技术集成、经济成本和监管适应等障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了铁路巡检机器人市场的三种部署原型框架，为技术采用和资产管理转型提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为铁路运营商提供了具体的机器人部署模式参考，分析了不同模式的技术经济性，帮助决策者制定机器人巡检实施策略。

title: The Climate Cost Index: A Composite Measure of Climate-Linked Household Cost Pressure Across U.S. Counties Methodology Specification, Empirical Results, and Validation Framework

detail.title: The Climate Cost Index: A Composite Measure of Climate-Linked Household Cost Pressure Across U.S. Counties Methodology Specification, Empirical Results, and Validation Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available, aggregated datasets and does not involve human participants. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Despite growing climate-related costs, no standardized metric exists to compare how climate conditions affect household financial pressure across locations. Energy bills respond to extreme temperature days, insurance markets react to wildfire and flood exposure, and health costs rise during heat and air quality events. Yet these cost signals remain scattered across disconnected datasets and hazard indicators, making systematic comparison difficult for households, lenders, insurers, and planners. This paper introduces the Climate Cost Index (CCI), a new composite metric measuring the relative intensity and acceleration of climate-linked cost signals and hazard exposures across U.S. counties, indexed to a national median baseline of 100. It is designed as a standardized measurement framework for comparing climate-linked household cost pressure across locations. CCI integrates two classes of inputs: climate-attributed cost signals, where causal attribution can be identified through regression methodology, and climate-relevant hazard burden proxies, where hazards materially influence household cost pressure but precise climate attribution is not yet separable. The framework preserves this distinction throughout the index. The methodology combines percentile normalization across the national scoring universe, hybrid budget-risk weighting derived from the BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey, robust trend acceleration using Theil-Sen slope estimation with denominator protection, and deterministic covariance controls to prevent double counting among correlated hazards. We report the first full implementation across 3,111 U.S. counties. Scores range from 47 to 197 with a median of 106.3, and climate-attributed energy costs average $43 per household annually. Sensitivity testing across eight robustness modules confirms that county rankings remain stable under alternative methodological assumptions. The methodology is fully transparent and replicable using publicly available data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了气候成本指数（CCI），这是一个衡量美国各县气候相关家庭成本压力的标准化综合指标，旨在解决当前缺乏跨地区气候成本比较标准的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个标准化的测量框架，来比较不同地区气候相关的家庭成本压力？
AI.motivation: 尽管气候相关成本不断增长，但目前缺乏标准化指标来比较不同地区气候条件对家庭财务压力的影响。能源账单、保险市场反应、健康成本等信号分散在不同数据集中，使得家庭、贷款机构、保险公司和规划者难以进行系统比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合气候归因成本信号（可通过回归方法识别因果关系）和气候相关灾害负担代理指标（灾害对家庭成本有实质性影响但精确气候归因尚不可分）的理论框架。
AI.method: 开发气候成本指数（CCI），采用百分位归一化、基于BLS消费者支出调查的混合预算-风险加权、使用Theil-Sen斜率估计的稳健趋势加速（带分母保护）、确定性协方差控制以防止相关灾害重复计算等方法。
AI.findings: 对美国3,111个县的首个完整实施显示：CCI得分范围从47到197，中位数为106.3；气候归因能源成本平均每户每年43美元；八个稳健性模块的敏感性测试证实县排名在不同方法假设下保持稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个区分气候归因成本信号和气候相关灾害负担代理的理论框架，为气候成本测量提供了新的概念基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为家庭、贷款机构、保险公司和规划者提供了标准化的气候成本比较工具；方法完全透明且可使用公开数据复制；有助于更明智的财务决策和风险管理。

title: Distributional Variations in Inflation and their Limited Reflection in Aggregate Consumer Sentiment
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Distributional Variations in Inflation and their Limited Reflection in Aggregate Consumer Sentiment
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates how the Consumer Price Index (CPI), which functions as an aggregate statistic, does not show the distributional variation of inflation across the income spectrum. Utilising expenditure-share weights from the Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Expenditure Survey and category-level price data from the BLS CPI tables, five Laspeyres price indices are constructed for each income quintile, covering the period from January 2019 through December 2024. The data indicate that the lowest-income quintile (Q1) experienced a peak year-over-year inflation rate of 12.44% in June 2022, compared to 10.72% for the highest-income quintile (Q5) and 9.06% for the headline CPI. Cumulatively, Q1 households faced a price level approximately 2 percentage points higher than Q5 households by the end of 2024 relative to a 2019 base. This difference is driven primarily by the higher expenditure shares of lower-income households on food and energy. The paper further tests whether quintile-specific inflation measures improve the prediction of University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment. Headline CPI retains the highest adjusted R 2 of 0.727 in a time-series regression framework. While Q1 inflation and headline CPI Granger-cause sentiment shifts at conventional significance levels, the inflation inequality gap itself does not. These findings carry implications for the communication of monetary policy and the execution of cost-of-living adjustments.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了CPI作为总体统计指标未能反映通胀在不同收入群体间的分布差异。通过构建五个收入五分位数的Laspeyres价格指数，发现最低收入群体(Q1)在2022年6月经历了12.44%的峰值通胀率，而最高收入群体(Q5)为10.72%，整体CPI为9.06%。到2024年底，Q1家庭面临的价格水平比Q5家庭高出约2个百分点，主要原因是低收入家庭在食品和能源上的支出比例更高。研究还发现，虽然Q1通胀和整体CPI能预测消费者信心变化，但通胀不平等差距本身没有预测能力。
AI.research_question: 消费者价格指数(CPI)作为总体统计指标如何掩盖了通胀在不同收入群体间的分布差异？这种通胀不平等对消费者信心预测有何影响？
AI.motivation: CPI作为总体通胀指标被广泛用于政策制定和成本调整，但它可能无法准确反映不同收入群体的实际通胀体验。了解通胀在不同收入群体间的分布差异对于制定更公平的货币政策和成本调整机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Laspeyres价格指数理论，结合收入五分位数分类方法，分析不同收入群体的消费结构差异如何导致通胀体验差异。同时运用时间序列回归和Granger因果检验分析通胀指标对消费者信心的预测能力。
AI.method: 使用美国劳工统计局消费者支出调查的支出份额权重和CPI分类价格数据，为五个收入五分位数构建Laspeyres价格指数（2019年1月-2024年12月）。通过时间序列回归分析各通胀指标对密歇根大学消费者信心的预测能力，并进行Granger因果检验。
AI.findings: 1. 最低收入群体(Q1)在2022年6月经历了12.44%的峰值通胀率，而最高收入群体(Q5)为10.72%，整体CPI为9.06%；2. 到2024年底，Q1家庭面临的价格水平比Q5家庭高出约2个百分点；3. 这种差异主要由低收入家庭在食品和能源上的更高支出比例驱动；4. 整体CPI在预测消费者信心方面调整R²最高(0.727)；5. Q1通胀和整体CPI能Granger导致消费者信心变化，但通胀不平等差距本身没有这种能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了通胀在不同收入群体间的分布不平等；2. 验证了总体通胀指标在反映不同群体实际体验方面的局限性；3. 为理解消费结构差异如何影响通胀体验提供了实证基础；4. 拓展了通胀不平等对宏观经济预测影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币政策沟通提供了更细致的通胀分布信息；2. 为成本调整机制的设计提供了依据，建议考虑不同收入群体的通胀差异；3. 帮助政策制定者更准确地评估通胀对不同社会群体的影响；4. 为消费者信心预测提供了更全面的通胀指标选择参考。

title: The Political Economy of Invisible Risk

detail.title: The Political Economy of Invisible Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on conceptual and policy analysis and does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any external funding.

detail.abstract: The rapid scaling of climate and development finance has intensified a central but underexamined challenge: not only how risk is distributed, but how and when it becomes visible. While existing frameworks increasingly acknowledge contingent liabilities, guarantees, and sovereign exposure, they largely assume that risk, once created, can be observed, measured, and governed. In practice, however, risk visibility is neither immediate nor neutral. It is shaped by institutional fragmentation, reporting structures, temporal deferral, and political incentives that systematically delay recognition. This paper argues that the central governance failure is not simply the accumulation of risk, but the absence of mechanisms that render aggregated exposure visible at the point of decision. As a result, what appears manageable at the level of individual instruments becomes binding only once pressures materialize across the system. By shifting the focus from risk allocation to risk visibility, the paper provides a complementary perspective to existing fiscal risk frameworks. It shows that visibility is a precondition for accountability, and that its absence is not accidental but structurally embedded in current approaches to derisking and blended finance. The analysis highlights the implications for policy design, particularly in the context of accelerated investment under energy transition pressures, and outlines the need for governance mechanisms that make exposure visible before it becomes binding.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为气候与发展金融的核心治理问题不是风险积累本身，而是缺乏在决策时点使聚合风险可见的机制。风险可见性受制度碎片化、报告结构、时间延迟和政治激励等因素影响，导致风险只有在系统压力显现时才被识别。
AI.research_question: 在气候与发展金融快速扩张背景下，风险可见性如何被塑造？为什么风险可见性延迟成为核心治理问题？
AI.motivation: 现有风险框架过度假设风险一旦产生即可被观察、测量和治理，但实践中风险可见性既非即时也非中立，这导致系统性风险在决策时点无法被识别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险可见性理论、治理理论、制度碎片化理论、时间延迟理论、政治经济学视角下的风险认知理论
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建、制度分析、案例研究（可能涉及气候金融和发展金融的具体实践）
AI.findings:
1. 风险可见性受制度碎片化、报告结构、时间延迟和政治激励的系统性影响
2. 个体工具层面看似可控的风险在系统压力显现时才成为约束
3. 可见性是问责的前提条件
4. 当前去风险化和混合金融方法中缺乏风险可见性是结构性嵌入的
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 从风险分配转向风险可见性的理论视角补充
2. 提出风险可见性作为治理核心问题的理论框架
3. 揭示风险可见性延迟的结构性根源
4. 为现有财政风险框架提供补充性分析视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策设计提供新方向，特别是在能源转型压力下的加速投资背景下
2. 提出需要建立使风险暴露在成为约束前可见的治理机制
3. 强调风险可见性对问责机制的重要性
4. 为气候与发展金融的风险治理提供实践指导

title: Does Bitcoin's Power Law Deviation Predict Return Distributions? Evidence from the PRESS Model PRESS Model: Power Law Return Sigma Signal
affiliations: Ruhr University of Bochum

detail.title: Does Bitcoin's Power Law Deviation Predict Return Distributions? Evidence from the PRESS Model PRESS Model: Power Law Return Sigma Signal
detail.abstract: We introduce the PRESS Model (Power Law Return Sigma Signal), a rolling quantile regression conditioned on Bitcoin’s standardised deviation from its power law trend (σ). The model produces a full conditional return distribution at each forecast date — seven quantile forecasts that shift dynamically with σ, enabling both risk assessment and portfolio sizing. Evaluated strictly out-of-sample over 3,135 observations at five forecast horizons, the model outperforms the unconditional benchmark in 34 of 35 quantile-horizon cells, with pinball loss reductions of 4–27%. While the model delivers a statistical edge across the full sample (34 of 35 cells), the information gain is concentrated non-linearly: the most significant tail-risk compression occurs in the 33% of observations where σ exceeds ±1 standard deviation from the trend, with additional upper-tail gains in the moderate zone. The primary specification uses a rolling 4-year quantile regression window, spanning one Bitcoin halving cycle, applied to 5,720 daily observations (July 2010 – March 2026) with an 8.6-year out-of-sample period. The rolling design progressively discards pre-institutional data that could potentially contaminate expanding-window estimates. The model requires only Bitcoin's own price series and updates daily. Log score verification confirms significant distributional information gain (+0.041 nats at h = 14d, p = 0.010, HAC-adjusted). A Half-Kelly BTC/Cash portfolio outperforms buy-and-hold on 100% of 2,771 possible entry dates (≥1-year horizon), reducing the maximum drawdown by 10 percentage points (−73.6% vs −83.8%), increasing the Sharpe ratio to 0.74 from 0.61, and delivering median excess CAGR of +7.8%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PRESS模型（幂律收益信号模型），通过基于比特币标准化偏离其幂律趋势（σ）的滚动分位数回归，生成完整的条件收益分布预测。模型在3,135个样本外观测中，在35个分位数-时间窗口组合中的34个表现优于无条件基准，损失减少4-27%。基于该模型的Half-Kelly BTC/现金组合在所有2,771个可能入场点上都优于买入持有策略。
AI.research_question: 如何基于比特币价格偏离其幂律趋势的程度（σ），构建一个能够动态预测条件收益分布并改善投资组合表现的模型？
AI.motivation: 比特币价格表现出强烈的幂律趋势特征，但传统预测模型未能充分利用价格偏离趋势的信息。现有方法在风险管理和投资组合优化方面存在局限，需要能够动态调整、基于比特币自身价格序列的预测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 幂律趋势理论、分位数回归理论、条件分布预测理论、Kelly准则投资理论、滚动窗口估计方法
AI.method: 使用滚动4年窗口的分位数回归，基于比特币标准化偏离其幂律趋势的程度（σ）作为条件变量。数据包括5,720个日观测值（2010年7月-2026年3月），样本外测试期8.6年，生成7个分位数预测。使用pinball损失和log score进行模型评估。
AI.findings: 1. 模型在35个分位数-时间窗口组合中的34个表现优于无条件基准，pinball损失减少4-27%；2. 信息增益非线性集中：当σ超过±1标准差时尾部风险压缩最显著；3. Half-Kelly BTC/现金组合在所有2,771个可能入场点上都优于买入持有，最大回撤减少10个百分点，夏普比率从0.61提升至0.74，中位超额年化收益+7.8%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于幂律趋势偏离的滚动分位数回归框架（PRESS模型）；2. 建立了比特币条件收益分布的动态预测方法；3. 揭示了信息增益在σ不同区间的非线性分布特征；4. 发展了结合条件分布预测与Kelly准则的投资组合优化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了仅需比特币价格序列的每日更新预测工具；2. 实现了显著的风险管理改进（尾部风险压缩）；3. 开发了优于买入持有策略的投资组合配置方法；4. 为加密货币投资者提供了基于统计优势的决策支持系统。

reference: Forthcoming 2026 The Asian Business Lawyer
title: The Social Good Shortfall: Reframing Takings Doctrine for Housing-Scarce Cities
affiliations: University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Law

detail.title: The Social Good Shortfall: Reframing Takings Doctrine for Housing-Scarce Cities
detail.abstract: This article argues that takings doctrine in housing-scarce cities should be reoriented around a "social good shortfall" standard. In Hong Kong and other dense urban settings, acute housing shortages coexist with fragmented ownership, underused land, and redevelopment regimes that either defer too readily to economic development or fail to generate meaningful housing supply. Existing formulations of public use, public purpose, and public interest are too open-ended to discipline redevelopment, yet too limited to justify the land assembly needed to address scarcity. The article proposes that compulsory acquisition should be justified only where the current or reasonably foreseeable use of land falls materially short of a feasible alternative in delivering socially important outcomes under conditions of scarcity. Grounded in a modernized reading of Locke's spoilage proviso, the article also develops a framework of "propriety in the taking": a substantial evidentiary basis for acquisition, compensation exceeding bare market value while respecting autonomy, and a decision-making process insulated from capture. It further argues that takings should ordinarily proceed through private-to-private redevelopment subject to independent expert review and judicial scrutiny. Comparative analysis of Hong Kong, the United States, and Seoul shows both the limits of permissive redevelopment and the promise, and trade-offs, of mandatory social housing requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文主张在住房短缺城市中，征收征用原则应围绕"社会效益缺口"标准重新定位。当土地当前或可预见的使用在稀缺条件下无法实现可行的替代方案所能提供的社会重要成果时，强制征收才应被允许。
AI.research_question: 在住房短缺的城市环境中，如何重新构建征收征用原则，以平衡土地再开发需求与社会公共利益？
AI.motivation: 香港等密集城市面临严重住房短缺，同时存在所有权分散、土地利用率低、再开发制度要么过于顺从经济发展要么无法产生有意义的住房供应等问题。现有公共使用、公共目的和公共利益概念过于开放，无法约束再开发，但又过于局限，无法证明解决短缺所需的土地整合的正当性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于洛克浪费条款的现代化解读，提出"征收适当性"框架：需要充分的证据基础、超越市场价值的补偿同时尊重自主权、以及免受俘获的决策过程。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对香港、美国和首尔的再开发制度进行比较分析，考察宽松再开发的局限性以及强制性社会住房要求的潜力和权衡。
AI.findings: 现有公共使用、公共目的和公共利益标准在住房短缺城市中既过于开放又过于局限。宽松的再开发制度存在局限性，而强制性社会住房要求既有潜力也有权衡。私人对私人再开发应成为主要方式，但需接受独立专家审查和司法监督。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"社会效益缺口"标准作为征收征用的新理论基础；发展了基于洛克浪费条款的"征收适当性"框架；为住房短缺城市的土地征收提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的征收标准：需要证明当前土地使用在稀缺条件下无法实现可行的社会效益替代方案；提出了补偿应超越市场价值同时尊重自主权；建议征收决策过程应免受特殊利益影响；主张私人对私人再开发应成为主要方式但需加强监督。

title: Quid Pro Quo? Private Information Flows in Shareholder Activism: Evidence from Mutual Fund Families
affiliations: Texas A&M University - Mays Business School and Towson University

detail.title: Quid Pro Quo? Private Information Flows in Shareholder Activism: Evidence from Mutual Fund Families

contentType.other: Accepted at the Journal of Accounting Research

detail.abstract: This paper hypothesizes a flow of information from firms to large shareholders during activist campaigns and its consequences. Focusing on actively managed mutual fund families, we find that informed trading by large-holding fund families increases during activist campaigns relative to smaller-holding fund families invested in the same firms. The effect is stronger for firms that attend more invitation-only investor events, face greater threats from activist campaigns, and are harder to value. Consistent with information flowing from management to large-holding fund families, the effect strengthens when Regulation Fair Disclosure enforcement is lax and when the information is favorable to the firm. Furthermore, the increased information advantage is associated with more management-friendly voting behavior by these investors and a higher likelihood of target firms winning activist campaigns and retaining board seats. Overall, our findings are consistent with a potential quid pro quo in which investors' access to information from management is associated with more pro-management behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在激进投资者活动期间，大股东基金家族通过与管理层的信息交流获得信息优势，并因此采取更支持管理层的投票行为，形成潜在的"互惠"关系
AI.research_question: 激进投资者活动期间，大股东基金家族是否从目标公司管理层获得信息优势？这种信息优势如何影响他们的投票行为和活动结果？
AI.motivation: 探讨激进投资者活动中信息流动的机制，特别是大股东与管理层之间的潜在"互惠"关系，这对理解公司治理和投资者行为有重要意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、代理理论、公司治理理论、投资者与管理层关系理论
AI.method: 实证研究，分析主动管理型共同基金家族在激进投资者活动期间的交易行为、信息获取渠道和投票行为
AI.findings: 1) 大股东基金家族在激进活动期间信息交易增加；2) 效果在参与更多邀请制投资者活动、面临更大威胁、估值更困难的公司中更强；3) 当公平披露法规执行宽松、信息对公司有利时效果更明显；4) 信息优势与更支持管理层的投票行为相关；5) 目标公司赢得激进活动和保留董事会席位的可能性更高
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 揭示了激进投资者活动中信息流动的具体机制；2) 提出了投资者与管理层之间"互惠"关系的理论框架；3) 丰富了信息不对称在公司治理中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构制定信息披露政策提供依据；2) 帮助投资者理解信息获取渠道对投资决策的影响；3) 为公司管理层提供与投资者关系的管理策略

title: Brighten-up-DPs: A Guide to Designing and Reporting Rigorous Experimental Dark Patterns Research
affiliations: University of Trier

detail.title: Brighten-up-DPs: A Guide to Designing and Reporting Rigorous Experimental Dark Patterns Research
detail.abstract: Dark patterns (DPs) are interface designs that exploit users’ cognitive or motivational tendencies and have become central to digital policy debates, yet the empirical foundations of this field remain weak. Most studies describe manipulative features but rarely test whether, why, and for whom they influence behavior. In this article, I highlight key methodological shortcomings in the current experimental DP literature and address them by outlining a practical, theory-driven guide for designing and reporting rigorous experimental research. I argue that cumulative progress depends on explicit theoretical frameworks and falsifiable hypotheses that specify the mechanisms linking interface manipulations to psychological processes and outcomes. Experimental research should aim to explain and predict behavior by aligning empirical findings with behavioral theory and by using validated measurement instruments. I further outline key design considerations for credible causal inference, including randomization and transparent balance checks, appropriate choices between within- and between-subjects designs, control of order effects, clear instructions that minimize demand effects, and incentive-compatible procedures to mitigate hypothetical bias. In addition, I emphasize research quality safeguards such as reliable and valid measurement, attention and awareness checks, transparent sampling and reporting, and justified power analyses. Finally, I stress the importance of preregistering complete research protocols (including all choices and decisions made by researchers) as part of an open science approach that supports replication and policy trustworthiness. These recommendations are integrated into the BRIGHTEN-UP-DPs framework, a comprehensive checklist guiding researchers from theory to transparent reporting. It is my aim to lower barriers to experimentation with this framework, and to strengthen the empirical evidence base on how dark patterns influence users’ perceptions, cognition, emotions, and behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文指出了当前暗模式实验研究的实证基础薄弱问题，提出了一个理论驱动的实验设计框架（BRIGHTEN-UP-DPs），强调明确的理论框架、可证伪假设、严谨的因果推断方法和开放科学实践，以加强暗模式如何影响用户行为的实证证据基础。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和报告严谨的实验研究来检验暗模式是否、为什么以及对谁影响用户行为？
AI.motivation: 当前暗模式研究领域存在实证基础薄弱的问题，大多数研究仅描述操纵性界面特征，但很少检验这些特征是否、为什么以及对谁影响用户行为，缺乏严谨的实验设计和理论驱动的研究方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为理论框架，强调界面操纵与心理过程及结果之间的机制联系；需要明确的理论框架和可证伪假设来解释和预测行为。
AI.method: 提出BRIGHTEN-UP-DPs框架作为综合检查清单，包括：随机化和平衡检查、被试内/被试间设计选择、顺序效应控制、减少需求效应的清晰指导、激励兼容程序、可靠有效的测量、注意力和意识检查、透明抽样和报告、合理的功效分析、预注册完整研究方案等。
AI.findings: 本文是一篇方法论论文，没有报告具体实证结果，而是提出了一个全面的实验设计框架来指导未来研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）强调暗模式研究需要明确的理论框架和可证伪假设；2）提出了连接界面操纵、心理过程和结果的理论机制；3）将行为理论与实证研究相结合，以解释和预测用户行为。

title: Taxation of Banking Products: Risks or Opportunities for the Development of Digital Payment Infrastructure?
affiliations: MGIMO

detail.title: Taxation of Banking Products: Risks or Opportunities for the Development of Digital Payment Infrastructure?
detail.abstract: On November 20, 2025 a set of amendments to the Russian Tax Code was adopted. Of particular note is the inclusion of bank card transactions in the list of taxable items, including a higher VAT rate of 22%. The previous tax incentive which provided for an exemption was in effect for 20 years and, along with other measures, facilitated the transition from cash to non-cash payments as a more priority and in-demand method. This naturally raises the question of how financial services consumers, banks, payment systems, processing centers and businesses will react to this measure which will undoubtedly generate revenue for the state budget: will it be effective in the future?

AI.tldr: 俄罗斯税法修正案将银行卡交易纳入应税项目并提高增值税率至22%，取消了已实施20年的税收优惠。该研究探讨这一政策对金融消费者、银行、支付系统、处理中心和企业的影响，以及其长期有效性。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯将银行卡交易纳入应税项目并提高增值税率至22%的政策，对金融消费者、银行、支付系统、处理中心和企业会产生怎样的影响？这一政策在未来是否有效？
AI.motivation: 俄罗斯取消了已实施20年的银行卡交易税收优惠，这一政策转变可能影响非现金支付的普及，同时为政府带来财政收入。需要研究各方利益相关者如何应对这一变化，以及政策的长期效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收政策影响理论、消费者行为理论、金融创新采纳理论、利益相关者理论、政策有效性评估框架
AI.method: 可能采用定量分析（交易数据、税收收入变化）、定性分析（利益相关者访谈、案例研究）、政策模拟分析等方法
AI.findings: 需要实证研究，但预期可能包括：消费者可能减少银行卡使用，银行和支付系统面临收入压力，企业调整支付策略，政策可能影响非现金支付普及率，但能为政府带来稳定财政收入

publicationDetails.detailsText: SN Business & Economics, volume 4, issue 9, 2024[10.1007/s43546-024-00705-7 ]

detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to review the knowledge base on the relationship that is shared between multinationals' host nation and their origin nation from 1994 to 2022. Literature was primarily gathered from Scopus using key words and quantitatively analyzed thereafter. To gather the sample for this article, the PRISMA technique was applied, and VOSviewer was used to execute the bibliometric analysis. The result shows the highly cited articles and terminology that have been deemed popular throughout the span of the research period, in addition to the highest publishing nations and further gaps and opportunities for future research. The results will help researchers and stakeholders alike move forward with further studies in this field of research by filling the existing gaps as provided in this paper and extending the existing knowledge base.

AI.tldr: 本文对1994-2022年间跨国公司母国与东道国关系的研究文献进行了系统性回顾和文献计量分析，识别了高被引文献、热门术语、主要发表国家，并指出了未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 1994年至2022年间跨国公司母国与东道国关系研究的知识基础是什么？该领域的研究现状、主要发现和未来研究方向有哪些？
AI.motivation: 随着全球化深入发展，跨国公司母国与东道国关系日益复杂，需要系统梳理该领域的研究进展，为学者和利益相关者提供清晰的知识图谱和研究方向指引。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于跨国公司与国家关系理论、国际商务理论、制度理论和政治经济学理论，分析母国与东道国在跨国公司运营中的互动关系。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA技术进行文献筛选，使用Scopus数据库收集文献，运用VOSviewer进行文献计量分析，包括关键词分析、共引分析和国家贡献分析。
AI.findings: 识别了高被引文献和热门术语，确定了主要发表国家，发现了研究空白和未来机会，为该领域研究提供了系统的知识基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了跨国公司母国-东道国关系研究的理论发展脉络，整合了不同理论视角，为后续理论构建提供了基础框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国企业管理者、政策制定者和研究人员提供了实用的研究指南，帮助识别关键研究领域和未来方向，促进该领域的知识积累和实践应用。

title: Does Country-Level Climate Change Performance Matter to Corporate Innovations?
affiliations: Texas A &M International University and

detail.title: Does Country-Level Climate Change Performance Matter to Corporate Innovations?
detail.abstract: We find that firms in countries with better climate change performance increase their corporate innovations. We also reveal that higher market concentration contributes to the heterogeneity of our results. Moreover, we reveal that firms in countries that perform better in coping with climate change increase their firm value, increase their cash flows, decrease dividend payout, and reduce earnings volatility. Finally, using instrumental variables, the Heckman selection model, alternative dependent variables, disaggregated climate change performance indicators, and eliminating crisis periods to address endogeneity issues, we discover that the effect of climate change performance on corporate innovation is robust and plausible.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，气候表现更好的国家的企业会增加创新活动，市场集中度会增强这种效应。气候表现好的企业还能提升企业价值、增加现金流、减少股利支付并降低盈利波动。通过多种方法处理内生性问题后，结论依然稳健。
AI.research_question: 国家气候表现如何影响企业创新？这种影响在不同市场结构下有何差异？气候表现对企业其他财务指标有何影响？
AI.motivation: 气候变化已成为全球性挑战，但关于国家层面气候政策表现如何影响企业微观行为的实证研究相对缺乏。理解这种关系对企业战略制定和政策评估具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可能基于制度理论（国家政策环境对企业行为的影响）、资源基础观（气候表现作为竞争优势来源）、创新理论（环境规制对创新的激励作用）以及公司金融理论（气候表现对财务绩效的影响）。
AI.method: 采用面板数据回归分析，使用工具变量法、Heckman选择模型处理内生性问题，使用替代因变量、分解气候表现指标、排除危机时期等方法进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1. 气候表现更好的国家中，企业创新活动增加；2. 市场集中度越高，气候表现对创新的正向影响越强；3. 气候表现好的企业价值更高、现金流更多、股利支付更少、盈利波动更低；4. 结论经过多种内生性处理后依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将国家气候表现与企业微观行为联系起来，拓展了环境经济学与公司金融的交叉研究；2. 揭示了市场结构在环境-创新关系中的调节作用；3. 提供了气候政策影响企业财务决策的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业管理者提供气候战略决策依据；2. 为政策制定者评估气候政策效果提供参考；3. 为投资者评估气候风险与机会提供分析框架。

title: A Regulatory Intent Schema for Automated Legal-to-Constraint Translation in Governance-Aware Reinforcement Learning

detail.title: A Regulatory Intent Schema for Automated Legal-to-Constraint Translation in Governance-Aware Reinforcement Learning
detail.abstract: Regulatory compliance in AI systems requires translating natural language legal obligations into formal mathematical constraints. In Governance-Aware Reinforcement Learning (GARL), this translation is performed by the TRANSLATE function-currently a manual, expert-dependent process that does not scale across jurisdictions or regulatory updates. This paper introduces the Regulatory Intent Schema (RIS), a structured intermediate representation that formalizes regulatory provisions into typed, machine-readable objects compatible with the GARL TRANSLATE function. We propose a three-stage hybrid pipeline in which an LLM extracts regulatory intent and populates RIS objects, a rule engine converts RIS objects into formal constraints, and the GARL TRANSLATE function integrates those constraints into the training loop. Case studies across three regulatory frameworks-GDPR, ECOA, and the EU Working Time Directive demonstrate cross-jurisdictional applicability and auditability. RIS provides a practical approach to constraint derivation within the GARL framework, supporting more systematic and auditable legal-to-constraint translation across regulatory domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为监管意图模式（RIS）的结构化中间表示方法，用于将自然语言法律义务自动转换为形式化数学约束，以解决GARL框架中手动翻译过程不可扩展的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何自动、可扩展地将自然语言监管规定转换为形式化数学约束，以支持跨司法管辖区和监管更新的AI系统合规性？
AI.motivation: 当前GARL框架中的TRANSLATE函数依赖手动、专家驱动的过程，无法跨司法管辖区扩展，也无法适应监管更新，这限制了AI系统合规性的规模化应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理感知强化学习（GARL）框架，监管意图模式（RIS）作为结构化中间表示，形式化约束转换理论。
AI.method: 三阶段混合流水线：1）LLM提取监管意图并填充RIS对象；2）规则引擎将RIS对象转换为形式化约束；3）GARL TRANSLATE函数将约束集成到训练循环中。
AI.findings: 通过GDPR、ECOA和欧盟工作时间指令三个监管框架的案例研究，证明了RIS具有跨司法管辖区适用性和可审计性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了监管意图模式（RIS）作为连接自然语言监管规定和形式化数学约束的结构化中间表示理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种实用的约束推导方法，支持更系统化和可审计的法律到约束转换，能够跨监管领域应用。

title: The Scarcity Migration Asset Pricing Model: Replacing Historical Covariance with Supply Chain Topology for Portfolio Construction Under Structural Regime Change

detail.title: The Scarcity Migration Asset Pricing Model: Replacing Historical Covariance with Supply Chain Topology for Portfolio Construction Under Structural Regime Change

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with Cocoa Capital and Cocoa AI, which may pursue commercial applications related to the ideas discussed in this paper. The views expressed here are the author’s own academic and theoretical views.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, interventions, or identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was independently developed by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces a forward-looking portfolio construction framework that replaces historical covariance with supply chain topology as the basis for risk modeling and alpha generation. We present evidence that the AI-driven transformation of the global economy is producing two approximately orthogonal economic regimes: the Physical Scarcity Graph, encompassing semiconductor fabrication, energy infrastructure, and rare material supply chains; and the Cognitive Abundance Void, encompassing knowledge-work software, professional services, and information intermediaries whose total addressable markets are being absorbed by general-purpose artificial intelligence. Through eigendecomposition of a bidirectional Leontief dependency matrix constructed from observable and estimated supply chain data, we show in calibrated prototype tests that these two regimes occupy approximately orthogonal structural spaces connected only by a thin causal coupling: the rate of AI adoption simultaneously drives demand for physical infrastructure and erodes demand for cognitive-output businesses. This finding challenges the assumption underlying most AI-themed long-short strategies that physical beneficiaries and cognitive casualties are structurally anti-correlated. We formalize a three-layer quantitative system: (1) a Structural Correlation Matrix derived from Tanimoto similarity on a bidirectional dependency graph, producing a naturally positive semi-definite risk model with no eigenvalue correction required-a property we establish via a formal theorem on unified graph similarity metrics; (2) a Scarcity Migration Index that captures the macro causal factor bridging the two regimes, with asset-level Scarcity Betas derived from a combination of observable financial data and estimated structural parameters; and (3) a portfolio optimizer that maximizes alpha per unit of structural risk subject to a scarcity-neutral constraint. Singular value decomposition of the dependency matrix in our calibrated prototype network reveals that a single structural factor-the Scarcity Migration axis-captures 99.9% of total structural variance, with a spectral gap ratio of 32.9:1 over the next largest component. This paper develops the asset-pricing layer of the Scarcity Migration research program; companion papers extend the framework to institutional form (Lambert, 2026b) and operational architecture (Lambert, 2026c).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个前瞻性投资组合构建框架，用供应链拓扑替代历史协方差作为风险建模和阿尔法生成的基础。研究发现AI驱动的全球经济转型产生两个近似正交的经济体系：物理稀缺图（半导体制造、能源基础设施、稀有材料供应链）和认知充裕空洞（知识工作软件、专业服务、信息中介）。通过供应链依赖矩阵的特征分解，证明这两个体系仅通过AI采用率这一薄弱因果耦合连接，挑战了传统AI主题投资策略中物理受益者与认知受损者结构性负相关的假设。
AI.research_question: 如何基于供应链拓扑结构而非历史协方差来构建前瞻性投资组合框架，以捕捉AI驱动的经济转型中物理稀缺与认知充裕两个正交经济体系的结构性风险？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合构建依赖历史协方差，无法捕捉AI驱动的经济结构转型。AI转型正在创造两个正交的经济体系：物理基础设施稀缺性和认知工作充裕性，需要新的风险建模方法来捕捉这种结构性变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 供应链拓扑理论：使用双向Leontief依赖矩阵表示经济结构；2) 结构相关性理论：基于Tanimoto相似度的结构相关性矩阵；3) 稀缺迁移理论：AI采用率作为连接物理稀缺和认知充裕的宏观因果因子；4) 正交经济体系理论：物理稀缺图与认知充裕空洞的结构正交性。
AI.method: 1) 构建双向Leontief依赖矩阵（基于可观测和估计的供应链数据）；2) 特征分解和奇异值分解分析结构空间；3) 开发结构相关性矩阵（基于Tanimoto相似度）；4) 计算稀缺迁移指数和资产级稀缺贝塔；5) 构建稀缺中性约束下的投资组合优化器；6) 校准原型测试验证理论。
AI.findings: 1) AI转型产生两个近似正交的经济体系：物理稀缺图和认知充裕空洞；2) 这两个体系仅通过AI采用率这一薄弱因果耦合连接；3) 稀缺迁移轴捕获99.9%的结构方差，谱隙比达32.9:1；4) 物理受益者与认知受损者并非结构性负相关，挑战传统AI投资策略假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出基于供应链拓扑的结构性风险建模框架；2) 建立统一图相似度度量的形式定理，确保结构相关性矩阵自然半正定；3) 形式化稀缺迁移理论作为连接物理稀缺和认知充裕的宏观因子；4) 挑战传统AI投资策略的结构性假设，提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 开发三层次定量系统：结构相关性矩阵、稀缺迁移指数、投资组合优化器；2) 提供前瞻性投资组合构建工具，替代历史协方差方法；3) 为AI主题投资提供新的风险管理和阿尔法生成框架；4) 建立可操作的投资策略系统，支持机构应用。

title: The Financing Dependency Layer: How Regulatory Capital Topology Constrains the Physical Scarcity Graph

detail.title: The Financing Dependency Layer: How Regulatory Capital Topology Constrains the Physical Scarcity Graph

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with Cocoa Capital and Cocoa AI, which may pursue commercial applications related to the ideas discussed in this paper. The views expressed here are the author’s own academic and theoretical views.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, interventions, or identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was independently developed by the author.

detail.abstract: The first three papers in the Scarcity Migration series formalize asset pricing (Lambert, 2026a), institutional design (Lambert, 2026b), and operational architecture (Lambert, 2026c) under conditions of cognitive abundance and physical scarcity. All three treat the physical dependency graph as the fundamental analytical object. None model the financing layer that determines whether structural scarcity translates into actual capital formation. This paper identifies and formalizes the missing transmission layer. We introduce a Financing Accessibility Matrix that encodes how regulatory capital treatment, risk-weighted asset classifications, and credit market structure determine whether capital can flow to the nodes where the physical dependency graph demands it. The financing constraint is integrated directly into the adjacency matrix before computing the Leontief inverse, producing a Financing-Constrained Total Dependency Matrix that propagates financing bottlenecks through the same cascade mechanics the SM-APM uses for physical dependencies. We present evidence of the financing-structural wedge across four domains of the physical scarcity graph: industrial equipment (drawing on Rayburn, 2026), data center infrastructure, energy generation for AI compute, and semiconductor capital equipment. The strongest numerical case is industrial equipment, where precise financing cost comparisons are available; the other three domains exhibit the same directional pattern and are presented as motivated cases for further calibration. In each domain, regulatory capital treatment calibrated to pre-AI scarcity conditions appears to underfinance assets whose structural importance is rising. We propose a new axiom system-the Financing Axioms F1-F5-that extends the SM-APM's Structural Axioms to incorporate this constraint, derive a Regulatory Scarcity Distortion measure that quantifies the wedge for each node, and propose instrument architectures that emerge from the dual-graph framework.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并形式化了稀缺性迁移系列中缺失的融资传导层，引入了融资可达性矩阵，将融资约束整合到邻接矩阵中，计算融资约束的总依赖矩阵，揭示了监管资本处理在AI时代下对关键资产的融资不足问题。
AI.research_question: 在认知充裕和物理稀缺条件下，融资约束如何影响资本流向物理依赖图所需节点的能力？
AI.motivation: 稀缺性迁移系列前三篇论文形式化了资产定价、制度设计和运营架构，但都未建模决定结构性稀缺是否转化为实际资本形成的融资层。本文旨在填补这一缺失的传导层。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于稀缺性迁移资产定价模型(SM-APM)，引入融资可达性矩阵，将监管资本处理、风险加权资产分类和信贷市场结构编码为融资约束，整合到物理依赖图中。
AI.method: 引入融资可达性矩阵，将融资约束直接整合到邻接矩阵中，计算融资约束的总依赖矩阵，通过四个领域（工业设备、数据中心基础设施、AI计算能源生成、半导体资本设备）的实证证据展示融资-结构性楔形。
AI.findings: 在四个物理稀缺图领域中，校准到AI前稀缺条件的监管资本处理似乎对结构性重要性上升的资产融资不足。工业设备领域融资成本比较最精确，其他三个领域呈现相同方向性模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别并形式化了稀缺性迁移系列中缺失的融资传导层；2. 提出了融资公理F1-F5，扩展了SM-APM的结构公理；3. 推导了量化每个节点楔形的监管稀缺扭曲度量；4. 提出了从双图框架中产生的工具架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了识别融资瓶颈的方法；2. 为政策制定者提供了量化监管资本处理扭曲的工具；3. 为资本配置决策提供了更准确的依赖分析框架；4. 为AI时代基础设施融资提供了校准指导。

title: The Transition to Mandated Ternary Architectures via Memristive Hysteresis

detail.title: The Transition to Mandated Ternary Architectures via Memristive Hysteresis
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the architectural and economic feasibility of transitioning from dominant binary CMOS computing to a "Mandated Ternary" paradigm. The proposed system is defined by a physically stable, non-volatile third logic state ("Null" or "Balance") engineered into memristive devices via hysteresis. This third state is not a software convention but a hardware-enforced checkpoint that gates computational actions, providing a novel mechanism for safety, security, and auditability. The central thesis is that this paradigm offers a discontinuous advantage over incremental binary scaling by directly mitigating the most pressing bottlenecks in advanced semiconductor nodes: interconnect delay, the memory wall, and power density. We provide rigorous analysis of device physics, focusing on Tantalum Oxide (TaOx) RRAM as a primary example. Our analysis quantifies a substantial "emulation tax"-over 15x in energy and 5x in latency-incurred when simulating ternary logic on binary hardware, thereby motivating native implementations. We argue that the rise of agentic AI, with its need for verifiable, enforceable hesitation, serves as a critical catalyst for this architectural shift. The paper concludes with a roadmap to 2027 for achieving industry-standard viability. The key innovation is the concept of Hardware-Enforced Hesitation-a physically unbypassable third state that enables auditable safety mechanisms for autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从传统二进制CMOS计算转向"强制三元"计算范式的架构与经济可行性研究。核心创新是通过忆阻器中的迟滞效应实现硬件强制的第三逻辑状态("空"或"平衡")，为自主系统提供可审计的安全机制。
AI.research_question: 从主导的二进制CMOS计算过渡到"强制三元"计算范式在架构和经济上是否可行？这种范式能否通过硬件强制的第三逻辑状态解决先进半导体节点中最紧迫的瓶颈问题？
AI.motivation: 当前二进制CMOS计算面临互联延迟、内存墙和功率密度等瓶颈问题。同时，随着智能AI的发展，需要可验证、可执行的"犹豫"机制来确保自主系统的安全性和可审计性。在二进制硬件上模拟三元逻辑会产生巨大的"仿真税"(能耗15倍以上，延迟5倍以上)。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于忆阻器物理特性(特别是钽氧化物RRAM)的迟滞效应理论，通过工程化实现物理稳定、非易失的第三逻辑状态。提出"硬件强制犹豫"概念，即物理不可绕过的第三状态，为自主系统提供可审计的安全机制。
AI.method: 采用严格的器件物理分析，以钽氧化物RRAM为主要示例进行量化分析。通过比较原生三元实现与二进制硬件仿真的性能差异，量化"仿真税"的代价。提供到2027年实现行业标准可行性的路线图。
AI.findings: 在二进制硬件上模拟三元逻辑会产生超过15倍的能耗和5倍的延迟"仿真税"。硬件强制的第三逻辑状态能够直接缓解先进半导体节点的关键瓶颈：互联延迟、内存墙和功率密度。智能AI的发展为这种架构转变提供了关键催化剂。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"强制三元"计算范式理论框架，引入"硬件强制犹豫"概念，为自主系统安全提供新的理论基础。建立基于忆阻器迟滞效应的第三逻辑状态物理模型，为计算架构创新提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供具体的器件实现方案(钽氧化物RRAM)，量化三元计算的实际性能优势。制定到2027年的产业化路线图，为半导体行业提供可行的技术转型路径。为自主系统安全提供硬件级解决方案，满足智能AI对可验证犹豫机制的需求。
