detail.abstract:
תקציר בעברית: אם פחד הוא נגיף, מה קורה כשפוליטיקת ההפחדה פוגשת את הפוליטיקה של המגפה? מאמר זה מתחקה אחר תשובה מבעד לעדשה אקזיסטנציאליסטית, תיאורטית ואמפירית, איכותנית וכמותנית. כולנו יודעים שיום אחד נמות, אבל איננו יודעים מתי וכיצד. האם תודעת התמותה היא עניין פרטי, אישי, או שיש לה מקום במרחב הציבורי? מה קורה כשהכרת המוות הופכת פוליטית? במאמר זה אנו חוקרים כיצד השתמשה פוליטיקה נגיפית בחרדה קיומית המונית. אנו מצביעים על עלייה יוצאת דופן בשיח הגלובלי על מוות, ומסבירים את תפקיד הפוליטיקה בעידוד השיח הזה ובניצולו. אנו מציגים מודל חדשני, המסווג מדיניות ממשלתית ברחבי העולם לנוכח המגפה, על פני מנעד שבין התנגדות איתנה ("אלון") לחוסן גמיש ("קנה סוף"). אנו מוצאים כי אמון פוליטי, גיל חציוני גבוה וחרדה חברתית מנבאים את גישת קנה הסוף; וכי האלון, אשר בדרך כלל דוחף לאמצעים מחמירים יותר, מצמצם טוב יותר את התמותה. עם זאת, חומרת המדיניות כשלעצמה כמעט ואינה משפיעה על מקרי מחלה/מוות הקשורים לנגיף הקורונה. אנו מעשירים את המודל שלנו בהמחשות מחמש מדינות: סין וישראל (שתיהן אלונים), שוודיה וגרמניה (קני סוף) וארצות הברית (הכלאה בין אלון לקנה סוף).

English Abstract: >What are the implications of the intersection between the politics of fear and pandemic politics? This article investigates this dynamic through existentialist, theoretical, and empirical lenses, employing both qualitative and quantitative methodologies. While human mortality is a universal certainty, its timing and nature remain fundamentally unknown. This study questions whether the consciousness of death remains a private concern or if it possesses a distinct role within the public sphere. Specifically, we explore the consequences that arise when the awareness of mortality is politicized. We examine how pandemic politics have leveraged mass existential anxiety, identifying an unprecedented global surge in mortality discourse and analyzing the role of political actors in both fostering and exploiting this phenomenon. To conceptualize these dynamics, we propose an innovative model that categorizes governmental responses along a spectrum between the "Oak" (characterized by steadfast resistance) and the "Reed" (representing flexible resilience). We find that political trust, a higher median age, and social anxiety are primary predictors of the Reed approach; that the oak strategy – which typically favors more stringent measures – demonstrates greater efficacy in reducing overall mortality; and that policy severity in and of itself shows a negligible impact on COVID–19 morbidity and mortality rates. The model is grounded in the experiences of five nations: China and Israel (Oaks), Sweden and Germany (Reeds), and the United States (an Oak–Reed hybrid).

AI.tldr: 本文通过存在主义、理论和实证视角，研究恐惧政治与疫情政治的交叉影响，提出了"橡树"（坚定抵抗）和"芦苇"（灵活韧性）两种政府应对模型，发现政治信任、中位年龄和社会焦虑是芦苇策略的预测因素，而橡树策略更能有效降低死亡率。
AI.research_question: 恐惧政治与疫情政治交叉的后果是什么？死亡意识是私人问题还是具有公共领域的独特作用？当死亡意识被政治化时会发生什么？
AI.motivation: 人类死亡是普遍确定的，但其时间和性质本质上未知。研究死亡意识是保持私人关注还是在公共领域具有独特作用，特别是当死亡意识被政治化时的后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存在主义理论框架，探讨死亡意识、存在焦虑和政治化死亡的概念。
AI.method: 混合方法研究：定性和定量方法，包括理论分析、实证研究和案例研究（中国、以色列、瑞典、德国、美国）。
AI.findings: 1. 全球死亡话语显著增加；2. 政治信任、较高中位年龄和社会焦虑预测芦苇策略；3. 橡树策略（通常采取更严格措施）更能有效降低死亡率；4. 政策严重性本身对COVID-19发病率和死亡率影响微乎其微。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了创新的"橡树-芦苇"政府应对模型，将存在主义理论与公共卫生政策分析相结合，为理解政治化死亡意识提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对公共卫生危机的分类框架，帮助理解不同策略的优缺点，并为未来疫情应对提供实证依据。

title: Solar Length as a Predictor of Trauma Volume: A 10-Year Study on Seasonality, Pandemic Effects, and Machine Learning Applications
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Oregon Health and Science University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Solar Length as a Predictor of Trauma Volume: A 10-Year Study on Seasonality, Pandemic Effects, and Machine Learning Applications
detail.abstract: Introduction: Trauma is a leading cause of global mortality and has been influenced by the COVID-19 pandemic. The interaction between trauma seasonality and pandemic effects remains understudied. From an AI modeling perspective, understanding seasonal shifts over the last four years is critical to training reliable models. Methods: We performed a retrospective study of 33,945 trauma admissions from 2014–2024 at a single Level I trauma center. Demographics, injury characteristics, and transfusion data were analyzed alongside weather and environmental variables including temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind speed, dew point, visibility, barometric pressure, workday status, and solar length. Statistical analyses included Chi-square, Cragg-Uhler, McFadden, AIC, and BIC. Results: Solar length was the strongest predictor of admissions, with longer days associated with increased trauma volume. This effect intensified after 2020 and remained elevated post-pandemic. Ground-level falls and MVCs increased, while ISS decreased. XGBoost performed well on training data (R² = 0.66, MAE = 1.75). Discussion: Seasonality strengthened after 2020, and trauma admissions remain directly proportional to solar length. AI models using this metric accurately forecast admissions over 60-day intervals.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析2014-2024年创伤中心数据，发现日照时长是创伤入院的最强预测因子，且COVID-19大流行后季节性效应增强，AI模型可利用此指标进行60天入院预测。
AI.research_question: COVID-19大流行如何影响创伤季节性的模式变化？日照时长等环境因素与创伤入院率的关系如何？AI模型能否利用这些季节性因素准确预测创伤入院量？
AI.motivation: 创伤是全球主要死亡原因，COVID-19大流行影响了创伤模式，但创伤季节性与大流行效应的相互作用研究不足。从AI建模角度，理解过去四年的季节性变化对训练可靠模型至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境流行病学理论（日照时长、天气变量对创伤发生率的影响）、创伤流行病学、时间序列分析理论、机器学习预测理论。
AI.method: 回顾性研究分析2014-2024年33,945例创伤入院数据，收集人口统计学、损伤特征、输血数据，结合温度、湿度、降水、风速、露点、能见度、气压、工作日状态、日照时长等环境变量。使用卡方检验、Cragg-Uhler、McFadden、AIC、BIC等统计方法，并应用XGBoost机器学习模型。
AI.findings: 日照时长是创伤入院的最强预测因子，日照时间越长创伤量越大；2020年后季节性效应增强且持续；地面跌倒和机动车碰撞增加，但损伤严重程度评分下降；XGBoost模型在训练数据上表现良好（R²=0.66，MAE=1.75）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了创伤季节性的动态变化特征，特别是大流行后季节性效应增强的现象；建立了环境因素（尤其是日照时长）与创伤发生率的理论联系；为AI模型在创伤预测中的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创伤中心资源规划和调配提供预测工具；识别高风险时间段以加强预防措施；开发了基于日照时长的60天创伤入院预测AI模型；为公共卫生政策制定提供数据支持。

title: Unveiling the Nexus Between Economic Complexity and Environmental Sustainability: Evidence from BRICS-T Countries

detail.title: Unveiling the Nexus Between Economic Complexity and Environmental Sustainability: Evidence from BRICS-T Countries

publicationDetails.detailsText: Eskişehir Osmangazi Üniversitesi İktisadi ve İdari Bilimler Dergisi, volume 21, issue 1, 2026[10.17153/oguiibf.1582854]

detail.abstract: This study analyses the impacts of economic complexity on environmental performance in BRICS-T countries. Annual data for the period 1999-2021, Durbin-Hausman cointegration test and Augmented Mean Group (AMG) estimator are used in the analysis. The robustness of the Panel AMG results is tested with CCEMG and CS-ARDL methods. The results indicate that economic complexity has a positive impact on environmental performance. An increase of 1% in the economic complexity index increases environmental performance in BRICS-T countries between 0.020% and 1.243%. However, economic growth, energy intensity and population density were found to have a negative impact on environmental performance. Renewable energy use, in contrast, contributes positively to environmental performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了经济复杂性对BRICS-T国家环境绩效的影响，发现经济复杂性对环境绩效有正向影响，而经济增长、能源强度和人口密度则有负面影响，可再生能源使用则有积极贡献。
AI.research_question: 经济复杂性对BRICS-T国家的环境绩效有何影响？
AI.motivation: 随着全球环境问题日益严峻，理解经济发展模式（特别是经济复杂性）与环境绩效之间的关系对于制定可持续发展政策至关重要。BRICS-T国家作为新兴经济体，其经济发展与环境影响的平衡具有重要研究价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济复杂性理论、环境库兹涅茨曲线理论、可持续发展理论，探讨经济结构复杂性与环境绩效之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用1999-2021年的年度数据，采用Durbin-Hausman协整检验和增强均值组（AMG）估计器进行分析，并通过CCEMG和CS-ARDL方法检验面板AMG结果的稳健性。
AI.findings: 1. 经济复杂性对环境绩效有正向影响：经济复杂性指数每增加1%，BRICS-T国家的环境绩效提高0.020%-1.243%；2. 经济增长、能源强度和人口密度对环境绩效有负面影响；3. 可再生能源使用对环境绩效有积极贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了经济复杂性理论在环境领域的应用；2. 为环境库兹涅茨曲线理论提供了新的实证支持；3. 拓展了可持续发展理论中经济结构与环境关系的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为BRICS-T国家制定可持续发展政策提供实证依据；2. 建议通过提升经济复杂性来改善环境绩效；3. 强调可再生能源使用的重要性；4. 为其他新兴经济体提供可借鉴的政策启示。

title: Numeraire-Based Distributional Sensitivity Engine for European Options under Stochastic Interest Rates

detail.title: Numeraire-Based Distributional Sensitivity Engine for European Options under Stochastic Interest Rates
detail.abstract:
Distributional Sensitivity Engine (DSE) organizes European option prices and sensitivities for equity diffusions with deterministic term structures by rewriting the in-the-money event through a Doleans-Dade exponential. The price is expressed in the two-weight form V_t=w_1*a_1+w_2*a_2 , where (a_1, a_2) are F_t -measurable primitives and (w_1, w_2) are conditional digital quantities under two measures linked by a Girsanov tilt. A limitation of DSE is the assumption that discounting is F_t -measurable. 
This paper presents an extension of that representation to European options under stochastic interest rates. A central step normalizes the discount factor by the bond price B(t,T)=E_t^Q [DF_(t,T)]. This normalization yields an F_t -measurable exercise boundary for a modified Doleans-Dade log variable E_(t,T). The spot leg remains under the Doleans tilt measure Q^+ , while the strike leg is written through a digital weight under the T-forward measure, or more generally under a suitable numeraire measure. The resulting representation retains the basic engine structure. In particular, it retains a two-weight price representation and a four-input contraction form for first derivatives. The probabilistic core is therefore reduced to conditional distribution blocks under Q^+ and Q^T. Dirac-delta representations are then used to construct Monte Carlo estimators for CDF, PDF, and derivative blocks, and a mollified delta yields estimators with the standard bias-variance scaling associated with kernel smoothing.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了分布敏感引擎(DSE)方法，使其适用于随机利率环境下的欧式期权定价。通过将贴现因子用债券价格归一化，并利用T远期测度，保留了DSE的两权重价格表示和四输入导数收缩形式。
AI.research_question: 如何将分布敏感引擎(DSE)方法扩展到随机利率环境下的欧式期权定价？
AI.motivation: 原始DSE方法假设贴现因子是F_t可测的，这一限制使其无法处理随机利率环境。现实中利率是随机的，因此需要扩展DSE方法以处理更实际的金融模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Doleans-Dade指数、Girsanov变换、T远期测度、条件数字量理论，以及狄拉克δ函数表示法。
AI.method: 通过将贴现因子用债券价格B(t,T)归一化，获得F_t可测的执行边界。将现货部分置于Doleans倾斜测度Q^+下，执行价部分通过T远期测度下的数字权重表示。使用狄拉克δ表示构建蒙特卡洛估计器。
AI.findings: 成功将DSE扩展到随机利率环境，保留了原始的两权重价格表示形式和四输入导数收缩形式。概率核心简化为Q^+和Q^T测度下的条件分布块。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了DSE的理论框架到随机利率环境；2) 建立了归一化贴现因子的方法；3) 提出了在T远期测度下的数字权重表示；4) 保持了原始DSE的结构完整性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了随机利率下欧式期权定价的实用方法；2) 构建了蒙特卡洛估计器用于CDF、PDF和导数计算；3) 通过平滑化δ函数获得标准偏差-方差缩放特性；4) 增强了金融工程实践中的定价灵活性。

title: Does Street Lighting Deter Crime? High-Resolution Evidence from São Paulo's LED Modernization PPP
affiliations: Sao Paulo School of Economics FGV EESP, Sao Paulo School of Economics FGV EESP and Sao Paulo School of Economics FGV EESP

detail.title: Does Street Lighting Deter Crime? High-Resolution Evidence from São Paulo's LED Modernization PPP

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses secondary administrative and observational data and did not involve direct interaction with human participants. No ethics approval was required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by FGV Cidades.

detail.abstract: We estimate the effect of LED street-lighting modernization on crime in São Paulo, Brazil. Using administrative records on lighting infrastructure and geocoded police reports, we construct a high-resolution spatial panel of grid cells and define treatment by the first observed LED installation within each cell. The main empirical design compares cells first treated in 2018Q3 to cells that remain untreated through 2020Q1, using the Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) difference-indifferences framework. We find economically large declines in cellphone theft, especially at night, with the strongest evidence concentrated in outcomes for which event-study diagnostics do not reject parallel trends. Vehicle-related crime also tends to decline after treatment, although the corresponding pre-trend evidence is weaker. Daytime placebo results suggest that part of the estimated effect may reflect correlated neighborhood-level changes rather than lighting alone. Overall, the findings indicate that LED modernization is associated with meaningful reductions in some property-crime outcomes, while also highlighting the identification challenges involved in evaluating large-scale urban infrastructure interventions.

AI.tldr: 巴西圣保罗LED路灯现代化改造对犯罪率的影响研究：发现LED改造与手机盗窃（尤其是夜间）显著下降相关，车辆相关犯罪也有下降趋势，但识别挑战表明部分效应可能源于邻里层面的相关变化。
AI.research_question: LED路灯现代化改造对巴西圣保罗犯罪率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 评估大规模城市基础设施干预措施（如LED路灯现代化）对公共安全的影响，为城市政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于犯罪经济学和环境犯罪学理论，探讨照明改善对犯罪机会和威慑效应的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用行政记录构建高分辨率空间面板数据，采用Callaway和Sant'Anna（2021）的双重差分法，比较2018Q3首次接受LED改造的网格单元与截至2020Q1未改造的单元。
AI.findings: LED改造与手机盗窃（特别是夜间）显著下降相关，经济效应显著；车辆相关犯罪也有下降趋势；但日间安慰剂结果表明部分效应可能反映邻里层面的相关变化而非单纯照明效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为城市基础设施与犯罪关系的理论提供实证支持，同时揭示评估大规模城市干预措施时的识别挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市管理者提供LED路灯改造可能带来的公共安全效益证据，同时强调在政策评估中需要考虑邻里层面的混杂因素。

title: Recency Effect of Weather Shocks on Fertilizer Adoption: Evidence from Nigeria

detail.title: Recency Effect of Weather Shocks on Fertilizer Adoption: Evidence from Nigeria
detail.abstract: I examine whether recency bias-forming expectations from recent experiences-induced by recent rainfall shocks reduces fertilizer use among maize farmers in Nigeria. Economic theory predicts that a profit-maximizing farmer should not be influenced by recent weather shocks except through liquidity constraints. Using nationally representative panel data merged with historical rainfall data, I show that, conditional on past profit (proxied by livestock accumulation and prior season's maize price), recent rainfall shocks significantly influence current fertilizer use even though shocks are serially uncorrelated and transitory. Importantly, I find that this effect is negatively asymmetric: prior negative shocks depress fertilizer use more than prior positive shocks raise it, thereby lowering average fertilizer use. Back-of-the-envelope calculations imply that weather-induced recency bias is associated with about 5% reduction in the already low fertilizer use (56.2 kg/acre) in Nigeria. Improving access to accurate and timely weather forecasts could help households make more efficient input use decisions.

AI.tldr: 尼日利亚玉米农户因近期降雨冲击形成近因偏差，导致化肥使用量减少约5%。这种偏差具有负向不对称性：前期负面冲击比正面冲击影响更大。
AI.research_question: 近期降雨冲击引起的近因偏差是否会减少尼日利亚玉米农户的化肥使用？
AI.motivation: 理解行为偏差如何影响农户生产决策，特别是近因偏差是否导致次优投入决策，对提高农业生产效率有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的近因偏差理论，与经典经济学中利润最大化假设形成对比。经典理论认为农户只应受流动性约束影响，不应受近期天气冲击影响。
AI.method: 使用全国代表性面板数据与历史降雨数据结合，控制过去利润（通过牲畜积累和前期玉米价格代理），分析近期降雨冲击对当前化肥使用的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 近期降雨冲击显著影响当前化肥使用，尽管冲击是序列不相关且暂时的；2) 效应具有负向不对称性：前期负面冲击比正面冲击影响更大；3) 天气引起的近因偏差导致化肥使用量减少约5%（从56.2公斤/英亩基准）。
AI.theory_contributions: 为行为经济学在农业决策中的应用提供实证证据，挑战经典利润最大化假设，证明近因偏差在农户投入决策中的重要作用。

title: Local Projections Are VAR Predictions of Increasing Order
affiliations: Texas Tech University

detail.title: Local Projections Are VAR Predictions of Increasing Order

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial interests, personal relationships, or competing interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, contract, or other financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Local projections (LPs) are often viewed as a flexible alternative to vector autoregressions (VARs), while VARs are often seen as better suited to imposing additional structure. This paper shows that the two are linked by an exact finite-sample identity. Its main result shows that, for any dataset, the h-step forecast from an LP of order p is exactly what one obtains by iterating forward through h one-step VAR forecasts, beginning with a VAR of order p and increasing the lag order by one at each iteration. Conversely, a VAR can be recovered from a corresponding sequence of LPs of decreasing order. The result strengthens the earlier population equivalence literature by moving to an exact finite-sample identity and explains the familiar finite-sample patterns in LP-VAR comparisons. It also extends to settings often seen as specific to either LPs or VARs, including single-equation LPs, panels, different lag lengths across variables, deterministic trends, vector error-correction representations, and common nonlinear or state-dependent specifications. Thus, in these settings, LPs are not inherently more flexible, nor are VARs inherently better suited to imposing structure.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了局部投影(LP)和向量自回归(VAR)之间存在精确的有限样本恒等关系：p阶LP的h步预测等于从p阶VAR开始，每次迭代增加一阶滞后，通过h次一步VAR预测迭代得到的结果。反之，VAR也可以从一系列递减阶数的LP中恢复。
AI.research_question: 局部投影(LP)和向量自回归(VAR)在有限样本中是否存在精确的数学关系？这种关系如何解释LP和VAR在实证应用中的表现差异？
AI.motivation: 在时间序列分析中，LP通常被视为VAR的灵活替代方法，而VAR则被认为更适合施加结构约束。现有文献主要关注两者的渐近等价性，但缺乏对有限样本中精确关系的理解，这导致了对两种方法相对优势的误解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列分析理论，特别是向量自回归模型和局部投影方法；有限样本理论；预测理论；动态系统理论。
AI.method: 理论推导和数学证明，建立LP和VAR之间的精确恒等关系。通过代数推导展示两种方法在有限样本中的等价性，并扩展到各种常见设定。
AI.findings:
1. p阶LP的h步预测精确等于从p阶VAR开始，每次迭代增加一阶滞后，通过h次一步VAR预测迭代得到的结果
2. VAR可以从一系列递减阶数的LP中恢复
3. 这种关系解释了LP和VAR在有限样本比较中的常见模式
4. 该恒等关系适用于多种设定，包括单方程LP、面板数据、变量间不同滞后长度、确定性趋势、向量误差修正表示以及常见的非线性或状态依赖设定
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将先前的人口等价文献扩展到精确的有限样本恒等关系
2. 揭示了LP和VAR在有限样本中的深层数学联系
3. 挑战了"LP更灵活、VAR更适合施加结构"的传统观点
4. 为理解两种方法在实证应用中的表现提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 帮助研究人员更好地理解LP和VAR在实证应用中的关系
2. 澄清了两种方法在有限样本中的相对优势
3. 为选择合适的时间序列方法提供了理论指导
4. 表明在许多常见设定中，LP并不比VAR更灵活，VAR也不比LP更适合施加结构约束

title: Dynamic Wholesale Pricing under Censored-Demand Learning
affiliations: Luiss University of Rome, Luiss University Dipartimento di Economia e Finanza and Luiss University of Rome

detail.title: Dynamic Wholesale Pricing under Censored-Demand Learning
detail.abstract: We study a finite-horizon dynamic wholesale-price contract between a manufacturer and a retailer, both of whom observe only sales, rather than the true demand. When the retailer stocks out, unmet demand is unobserved, so both parties update a common posterior over the demand distribution from sales data. Each period, the manufacturer sets the wholesale price, the retailer chooses an order quantity, and the public belief state is updated. We characterize Markov perfect equilibria as functions of this public belief. Our main results are as follows: for Weibull demand, we extend the well-known scaling approach to this strategic learning setting, prove the existence of an equilibrium, and reduce computation to a standardized one-parameter recursion; for exponential demand, we show that the equilibrium is unique and computable via a simple backward recursion.

AI.tldr: 研究有限期动态批发价合约中制造商和零售商仅能观察销售而非真实需求时的战略学习问题，当缺货时未满足需求不可观察，双方基于销售数据更新需求分布的后验信念。
AI.research_question: 在仅能观察销售数据而非真实需求的动态批发价合约中，制造商和零售商如何通过战略学习更新需求信念并做出最优决策？
AI.motivation: 现实供应链中，制造商和零售商通常只能观察到实际销售数据，而非真实市场需求。当零售商缺货时，未满足的需求无法被观察，这导致双方对需求分布存在信息不对称和不确定性，需要通过销售数据不断学习更新信念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态博弈理论、贝叶斯学习理论和马尔可夫完美均衡框架，研究有限期动态批发价合约中的战略学习问题。
AI.method: 采用马尔可夫完美均衡分析，将公共信念状态作为状态变量，研究Weibull需求和指数需求两种情形下的均衡存在性、唯一性和计算方法。
AI.findings: 对于Weibull需求，将经典的缩放方法扩展到战略学习环境，证明了均衡存在性，并将计算简化为标准化单参数递归；对于指数需求，证明了均衡唯一性，并可通过简单后向递归计算。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将战略学习引入动态批发价合约分析；2) 扩展缩放方法到战略学习环境；3) 证明了Weibull需求下均衡存在性和指数需求下均衡唯一性；4) 提供了计算均衡的简化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为供应链管理者提供了在信息不完全环境下制定批发价和订货决策的理论框架，特别适用于只能观察销售数据的情况，有助于优化供应链协调和利润分配。

title: Shining a Light on Philippine Public Procurement: An Analysis Under the Open Contracting Framework

detail.title: Shining a Light on Philippine Public Procurement: An Analysis Under the Open Contracting Framework
detail.abstract: Corruption has long been woven into the fabric of Philippine governance, evolving from colonial-era patronage to modern, systemic graft that continues to erode public trust and institutional integrity. Despite repeated reform efforts, corruption remains entrenched, particularly within government procurement. Yet sustained public engagement has consistently emerged as a countervailing force, demanding transparency and accountability when official mechanisms falter. This paper argues that empowering this civic oversight through institutionalized transparency offers the most viable path toward lasting reform.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨菲律宾腐败问题，认为尽管腐败根深蒂固，但通过制度化透明机制赋能公民监督是推动持久改革的最可行路径。
AI.research_question: 在菲律宾腐败根深蒂固的背景下，如何通过制度化透明机制赋能公民监督来实现持久改革？

detail.title: A Regulatory Compliance Protocol for Asset Interoperability Between Traditional and Decentralized Finance in Tokenized Capital Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors are affiliated with Oraclizer and Horizen Korea, and have a research interest in the development of regulatory compliance protocols for tokenized assets. This paper presents the Regulatory Compliance Protocol (RCP) as a conceptual framework. The authors declare no direct financial conflicts of interest related to this research.
