publicationDetails.detailsText: arXiv preprint, arXiv:2603.29278 [cs.CY], March 31, 2026. DOI: https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2603.29278

detail.abstract: There have been various attempts at token standards on numerous blockchain platforms today to fundamentally change the way assets are traded in the traditional capital markets, but there is a lack of research and resolution on regulatory issues that become the common foundation for interoperability and reusable standards. Our proposal, Regulatory Compliance Protocol (RCP), is based on the regulations and reports of 15 global financial institutions and standardizes recommendations and guidelines involving the overall asset tokenization of TradFi and DeFi into five regulatory groups: Traceability, Confidentiality, Enforceability, Finality and Tokenizability, compiling them into 31 items and presenting a benchmark for technology and standards as an underlying protocol. To review the legality and effectiveness of RCP, it was validated based on three tokenization and trading scenarios, and through the RCP-based NEW-EIP, it showed superiority over other ERC protocols related to asset tokenization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了监管合规协议（RCP），基于15家全球金融机构的法规和报告，将资产代币化的监管要求标准化为5个监管组（可追溯性、保密性、可执行性、最终性和可代币化性）共31个项目，为资产代币化提供底层协议基准。
AI.research_question: 如何为区块链资产代币化建立统一的监管合规协议标准，以解决当前代币标准缺乏监管互操作性和可重用性的问题？
AI.motivation: 当前各区块链平台虽然推出了多种代币标准试图改变传统资本市场资产交易方式，但缺乏对监管问题的研究和解决方案，而监管合规是跨平台互操作性和可重用标准的基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于15家全球金融机构的法规和报告，构建了包含5个监管维度的理论框架：可追溯性、保密性、可执行性、最终性和可代币化性。
AI.method: 1）分析15家全球金融机构的监管要求；2）将监管要求标准化为5个监管组31个项目；3）通过三个代币化和交易场景验证RCP的合法性和有效性；4）基于RCP开发NEW-EIP协议并与现有ERC协议比较。
AI.findings: 1）RCP成功将复杂的监管要求系统化为可操作的协议标准；2）在三个验证场景中证明RCP的合法性和有效性；3）基于RCP的NEW-EIP协议在资产代币化相关功能上优于其他ERC协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个系统化的资产代币化监管合规理论框架，将分散的监管要求整合为结构化标准，为区块链金融监管研究提供了新的理论视角和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为区块链平台和项目提供了具体的监管合规实施指南；2）开发的NEW-EIP协议可直接应用于实际代币化项目；3）为监管机构和技术开发者提供了共同的语言和标准框架。

title: Toward a Taxonomy of Strategic and Decision Frameworks: Reassessing 28 Practitioner Tools in the AI Era

detail.title: Toward a Taxonomy of Strategic and Decision Frameworks: Reassessing 28 Practitioner Tools in the AI Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper. Two companion working papers by the author — "Decision Lock" (Jeon, 2026) and "The Option Paradox in Executive Decision-Making" (Jeon, 2026) — are referenced in the conclusion; the former describes a proprietary decision framework. The taxonomy and assessments in the present paper were developed independently of that framework.

detail.abstract: The practitioner toolkit for strategic decision-making—portfolio matrices, industry structure models, decision governance protocols, phased development gates—has expanded substantially over five decades, yet the reviewed academic literature has not yet produced a unified taxonomy for classifying these tools by structural properties and reassessing their fitness for purpose in an AI-transformed environment. Usage studies document adoption frequency without explaining architectural differences; the emerging AI-strategy literature examines cognitive processes without systematically assessing the toolkit itself. This paper addresses both gaps. Drawing on a corpus of 28 practitioner-originated frameworks selected by explicit inclusion criteria from MBA curricula, consulting firm methodologies, and strategy textbooks, it proposes a four-dimensional taxonomy classifying each tool by primary function (nine categories), decision layer (Strategy Formulation, Strategic Choice, Execution Governance, Operating Cadence), time horizon (ultra-short to long), and AI affordance profile. A standardized three-criterion rubric—input automation, judgment displacement, and assumption stability—is applied to assign each framework an AI-era rating of Enhanced, Challenged, or Disrupted. Three findings emerge. First, the practitioner toolkit contains a persistent but unacknowledged boundary between strategy formulation tools and decision-process tools that differ on every structural dimension examined. Second, the current toolkit is concentrated at long time horizons, precisely the temporal range where AI augmentation is least effective, revealing a structural gap in the framework inventory. Third, the dominant mode of AI's impact is not replacement but tension: 57% of frameworks are Challenged—requiring adaptation rather than abandonment—while only 4% are Disrupted. The taxonomy offers a structured logic for matching tools to decision contexts and locating where AI-driven redesign should concentrate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个四维分类法，对28个战略决策工具进行分类，并评估它们在AI时代的影响（增强、挑战、颠覆），发现57%的工具面临挑战需要适应而非废弃，揭示当前工具集中在AI增强效果最差的长时域范围。
AI.research_question: 如何对战略决策工具进行系统分类，并评估它们在AI转型环境中的适用性？
AI.motivation: 现有学术文献缺乏对战略决策工具的统一分类体系，无法解释工具间的架构差异；同时AI-战略文献关注认知过程但未系统评估工具本身在AI环境中的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于战略决策理论、工具分类理论和AI影响理论，构建四维分类法：主要功能（9类）、决策层级（战略制定、战略选择、执行治理、运营节奏）、时间范围（超短期到长期）、AI赋能特征。
AI.method: 从MBA课程、咨询公司方法论和战略教科书中选取28个从业者框架，应用明确纳入标准，使用标准化三标准评估法（输入自动化、判断替代、假设稳定性）为每个框架分配AI时代评级（增强、挑战、颠覆）。
AI.findings: 1. 战略制定工具与决策过程工具存在持久但未被承认的边界；2. 当前工具集中在长时域范围，而这正是AI增强效果最差的领域；3. 57%框架面临挑战需要适应而非废弃，仅4%被颠覆。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出首个统一的战略决策工具分类法，填补学术文献空白；建立AI影响评估框架，为工具在AI环境中的适用性提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供结构化逻辑来匹配工具与决策情境；识别AI驱动重新设计的重点领域；帮助组织适应而非废弃现有工具。

title: The Option Paradox in Executive Decision-Making: Choice Overload, Decision Fatigue, and the Case for Strategic No-Go

detail.title: The Option Paradox in Executive Decision-Making: Choice Overload, Decision Fatigue, and the Case for Strategic No-Go

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper. This paper is the author's independent work; a companion paper (Jeon, 2026) describes a proprietary framework referenced herein.

detail.abstract:
Strategic management theory conventionally treats option creation as welfare-improving: more alternatives imply richer opportunity sets and better outcomes. This paper challenges that assumption. Drawing on three convergent but largely isolated research streams—choice overload, decision fatigue, and strategic discontinuation—it identifies an inflection point beyond which additional options degrade rather than improve executive decision quality.

The paper advances three propositions. First, C-suite decision environments structurally tend to exceed the cognitive thresholds at which choice overload impairs judgment—not occasionally, but as a persistent feature of the role. Second, the sequential, multi-item nature of executive decision sessions amplifies overload through decision fatigue, producing compounding degradation across a session’s agenda. Third, structured strategic No-Go—the deliberate, criteria-based elimination of options—can create economic value under identifiable conditions by conserving cognitive resources for decisions where they matter most.

From these propositions, the paper derives four design principles for organizational decision load management and identifies boundary conditions under which No-Go destroys rather than creates value.

In this paper, “strategic No-Go” refers to the executive application of structured strategic discontinuation—the deliberate rejection of options based on predefined criteria rather than real-time judgment.

AI.tldr: 传统战略管理理论认为创造更多选择总是有益的，但本文挑战这一假设，指出当选项超过认知阈值时，反而会损害高管决策质量。文章提出战略"不执行"（No-Go）的概念，即在特定条件下基于预设标准主动放弃选项，可以创造经济价值。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，增加战略选项会损害而不是改善高管决策质量？如何通过结构化战略"不执行"来优化组织决策负荷管理？
AI.motivation: 传统战略管理理论认为创造更多选择总是福利改善的，但这一假设忽视了认知限制。高管面临的选择环境常常超出认知处理能力，导致决策质量下降。需要重新审视"更多选择总是更好"的假设。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 选择过载理论：选项过多会损害决策质量
2. 决策疲劳理论：连续决策会导致认知资源耗尽
3. 战略中止理论：主动放弃选项的战略价值
AI.method: 理论推导和命题构建。基于三个研究流派的整合，提出理论命题和设计原则。
AI.findings:
1. 高管决策环境通常超过认知阈值，选择过载是常态而非例外
2. 连续的多项目决策会议通过决策疲劳放大过载效应
3. 结构化战略"不执行"在特定条件下能创造经济价值
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 挑战传统战略管理的"更多选择总是更好"假设
2. 整合选择过载、决策疲劳和战略中止三个研究流派
3. 提出决策负荷管理的理论框架和边界条件
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 四个组织决策负荷管理设计原则
2. 战略"不执行"的实施指南
3. 识别何时"不执行"会破坏而非创造价值

title: Decision Lock: A Verdict-Based Decision Quality Framework for Strategic Decision-Making After Due Diligence

detail.title: Decision Lock: A Verdict-Based Decision Quality Framework for Strategic Decision-Making After Due Diligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research presented in this paper. The framework described is the author's proprietary work developed through independent research.

detail.abstract: Strategic due diligence produces voluminous analysis, yet, to the author's knowledge, a widely adopted standardized mechanism for converting that analysis into a locked verdict is not evident—Go, Conditional Go, Delay, or No—at the C-level. Fortune 500 firms lose an estimated $250 million annually to inefficient decision processes (McKinsey, 2019). This paper argues that the gap between analysis and action constitutes a structural failure, not a managerial one, and introduces Decision Lock, a verdict-based decision quality framework designed to close it. Within the reviewed academic and practitioner literature, the present review did not identify an established framework—academic or practitioner-originated—that converts post-due-diligence analysis into a locked categorical verdict for C-level strategic decisions. Decision Lock is proposed as a candidate framework for this gap. Limitations include zero Full Go verdicts, limited No-verdict coverage (one case), no post-decision outcome tracking, and pending transition to live internal-data cases.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"决策锁定"框架，旨在解决战略尽职调查分析到行动之间的结构性差距，将复杂的分析转化为明确的分类裁决（Go、Conditional Go、Delay、No），以改善C级战略决策质量。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个标准化的机制，将战略尽职调查的复杂分析转化为明确的分类裁决（Go、Conditional Go、Delay、No），以改善C级战略决策的质量和效率？
AI.motivation: 财富500强企业每年因低效决策流程损失约2.5亿美元；战略尽职调查产生大量分析，但缺乏将分析转化为明确裁决的标准化机制，导致分析到行动之间存在结构性差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策质量框架；战略决策理论；尽职调查理论；组织决策过程理论。
AI.method: 文献综述（学术和实践文献）；提出概念性框架（决策锁定）；初步案例应用（但存在局限性）。
AI.findings: 现有文献中未发现将尽职调查后分析转化为锁定分类裁决的成熟框架；决策锁定框架被提出作为填补这一空白的候选方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"决策锁定"这一新的决策质量框架；将分析到行动的差距概念化为结构性而非管理性问题；为战略决策研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了具体的决策工具；可能减少因低效决策造成的经济损失；帮助C级高管更有效地将分析转化为行动。

title: Behavioral Operating System: Defining a New Category in Human Performance Science
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Behavioral Operating System: Defining a New Category in Human Performance Science

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest. This research received no external funding. Both authors are co-founders of Virtuous City, the unincorporated venture within which this framework was developed. No commercial relationship with any organization referenced in this paper exists.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a theoretical category definition working paper. It involves no human participants, no patient data, no clinical trials, and no empirical data collection. No ethics approval is required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the authors. No external grants, institutional funding, or commercial sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: The global investment in workplace behavioral change has tripled over fifteen years without producing a corresponding improvement in outcomes. Behavior change retention in corporate learning and development (L&D) falls below 30% at 90 days-a figure that has remained structurally stable despite sustained increases in per-employee training expenditure. This paper argues that this failure is not a delivery failure. It is a category error. The dominant intervention category-personality assessment and knowledge transfer-is structurally incapable of reaching the layer where sustained behavioral change occurs. Drawing on convergent findings across cognitive psychology, developmental psychology, analytical psychology, and psychodrama theory, this paper defines a new category: the Behavioral Operating System (BOS). A BOS is distinguished from existing frameworks by its intervention target (the developmental and archetypal layer, not the self-reported surface), its diagnostic logic (pattern origin, not trait description), and its delivery requirement (cultural-psychological specificity, not universalized assessment). This paper establishes the definitional conditions for category membership, distinguishes BOS from adjacent categories, and identifies implications for institutional adoption and future empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为职场行为改变投资失败是因为类别错误，提出了"行为操作系统"作为新的干预类别，针对发展层而非表面特质。
AI.research_question: 为什么职场行为改变投资大幅增加但效果不佳？如何建立更有效的行为改变干预框架？
AI.motivation: 过去15年职场行为改变投资增长三倍，但行为改变保留率在90天后仍低于30%，且这一数字结构稳定，表明现有干预方法存在根本缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合认知心理学、发展心理学、分析心理学和心理剧理论，提出"行为操作系统"理论框架，强调发展层和原型层而非表面特质。
AI.method: 理论构建方法：通过跨学科理论整合，定义新类别，建立类别成员条件，区分相邻类别，提出实证验证方向。
AI.findings: 现有主导干预类别（人格评估和知识转移）结构上无法触及持续行为改变发生的层面，需要针对发展层和原型层的新干预类别。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"行为操作系统"新理论类别；2. 明确类别定义条件（干预目标、诊断逻辑、交付要求）；3. 建立与相邻类别的理论区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为机构采用提供指导；2. 指出未来实证验证方向；3. 为企业培训投资提供更有效的理论框架。

title: Are We Currently Experiencing the Fifth Industrial Revolution? The Case for Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Are We Currently Experiencing the Fifth Industrial Revolution? The Case for Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Every Industrial Revolution in recorded history has been characterised by a singular enabling technology that restructured labour markets, reorganised production systems, and permanently altered the social and institutional architecture of society. This article advances the thesis that Artificial Intelligence (AI), encompassing large language models, generative AI systems, and autonomous agents that emerged in mature form between approximately 2017 and 2025, constitutes the defining technological catalyst of a Fifth Industrial Revolution. Drawing on historical analyses of prior industrial transitions, primary and peer-reviewed empirical literature, and current enterprise adoption data, the argument proceeds in four stages: (1) a definitional framework for what constitutes an industrial revolution is established from the historical record; (2) the four prior revolutions are mapped against this framework; (3) AI is evaluated against each criterion; and (4) the critical distinction between Industry 4.0 and Industry 5.0, a frequently conflated debate in both academic and practitioner discourse is resolved. The analysis concludes that AI meets every historical threshold for revolutionary classification and that this transition is not approaching but already underway.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人工智能（包括大语言模型、生成式AI系统和自主智能体）是第五次工业革命的核心技术催化剂，通过历史分析框架论证AI符合所有工业革命标准，并澄清了工业4.0与5.0的区别。
AI.research_question: 人工智能是否构成第五次工业革命的核心技术催化剂？
AI.motivation: 当前关于工业4.0和5.0的讨论存在混淆，需要明确界定工业革命的标准，并评估AI是否真正构成了新的工业革命。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史分析建立工业革命的定义框架，包括劳动力市场重组、生产系统重组、社会制度架构改变等标准。
AI.method: 四阶段分析法：1）从历史记录建立工业革命定义框架；2）将前四次革命映射到该框架；3）评估AI是否符合每个标准；4）澄清工业4.0与5.0的区别。
AI.findings: AI满足所有历史工业革命分类标准，第五次工业革命不是即将到来而是已经进行中。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了工业革命的明确定义框架，澄清了工业4.0与5.0的理论混淆，为理解AI驱动的社会经济转型提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业、政策制定者和学术界提供了识别和应对AI驱动的工业转型的实用框架，帮助各方更好地准备和适应这一变革。

title: Learning the Distance in Exponential Ranking Models
affiliations: and Stanford

detail.title: Learning the Distance in Exponential Ranking Models
detail.abstract: Rankings arise across a wide range of economic and computational settings, including preference aggregation, recommendation systems, and expert evaluation. In many of these environments, ranking data are generated under domain-specific constraints, and different settings exhibit fundamentally different patterns of noise. We propose a class of exponential family models on permutations in which this noise structure is learned directly from data. Specifically, we introduce the learned-distance exponential ranking (LDER), a generalization of the classical Mallows model in which the distance itself is parameterized and learned. Under this model, a ranking π has likelihood proportional to expβ d α (π, σ) , where σ is a central ranking, β > 0 controls dispersion, and the distance parameter α governs the relative prevalence of long-range versus local deviations. To our knowledge, this is the first extension of the Mallows framework that learns the distance metric jointly with the central ranking and dispersion. We develop an efficient maximum likelihood procedure that jointly estimates (σ, α, β), prove strong consistency of the central ranking estimator, and establish √ m-consistency and asymptotic normality for (α, β), including robustness to approximate score computation. To enable distributional queries and simulation, we give a provably efficient approximation scheme for α ≥ 1 that, in time polynomial in n and 1/ε, produces a (1 ± ε) approximation to the partition function and an ε-total-variation sampler. Our learning and sampling algorithms generalize prior results even in the classical cases of fixed distance metric, α = 1 (Spearman footrule) and α = 2 (Spearman's ρ), where previous theoretical guarantees were given only in the vanishing-dispersion regime β → 0. Finally, we evaluate our approach on sports rankings, news and movie preference data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的指数族排序模型（LDER），通过参数化距离度量来学习排序数据中的噪声结构，扩展了经典的Mallows模型，并提供了高效的最大似然估计和采样算法。
AI.research_question: 如何在排序数据中学习领域特定的噪声结构，并开发能够同时学习中心排序、分散度和距离参数的统计模型？
AI.motivation: 排序数据广泛存在于偏好聚合、推荐系统和专家评估等场景，不同领域具有不同的噪声模式，现有模型（如Mallows模型）使用固定距离度量，无法适应多样化的噪声结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于指数族模型框架，提出学习距离指数排序（LDER）模型，扩展Mallows模型，允许距离参数α控制长距离与局部偏差的相对频率。
AI.method: 开发高效的最大似然估计程序联合估计(σ, α, β)，证明中心排序估计量的强一致性，建立(α, β)的√m一致性和渐近正态性，提供多项式时间近似方案计算配分函数和采样。
AI.findings: 模型在体育排名、新闻和电影偏好数据上表现良好，学习算法在经典固定距离度量情况（α=1, α=2）下也优于先前仅在分散度趋近于零时的理论保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在Mallows框架中联合学习距离度量与中心排序和分散度，建立了完整的统计理论保证，包括一致性、渐近正态性和鲁棒性分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可扩展的学习和采样算法，支持分布查询和模拟，在多项式时间内实现高精度近似，适用于实际应用中的排序数据分析。

title: The AI Alpha Paradox: Deterministic Multi-AI Signal Construction for Institutional Portfolio Governance

detail.title: The AI Alpha Paradox: Deterministic Multi-AI Signal Construction for Institutional Portfolio Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder and CEO of IOOX Srl, the company developing the AI Market Neutral platform described in this paper. The author has a direct financial interest in the commercial success of the platform.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author through IOOX Srl. No external funding was received.

contentType.other: Working Paper — Draft for discussion purposes

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a deterministic signal construction architecture assisted by multiple independent AI agents, in which artificial intelligence is subordinated to a rule-based risk engine governing signal formation. The system is designed to operate as a Signal-as-a-Service platform, delivering structured, auditable portfolio signals to institutional subscribers rather than executing trades or managing capital directly. The proposed system employs multiple AI analytical perspectives — each implemented through a distinct large language model with a specialized analytical orientation — to generate candidate securities within a defined investment universe. These proposals are subsequently filtered, constrained, and assembled by a deterministic signal construction engine designed to enforce strict exposure, correlation, liquidity, and event-risk controls. The architecture aims to address the fundamental tension between AI-driven idea generation and institutional requirements for transparency, auditability, and deterministic risk governance. We present the conceptual design of the framework and discuss its application to the generation of beta-neutral long/short signals within the NASDAQ-100 universe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种由多个独立AI代理辅助的确定性信号构建架构，其中人工智能服从于基于规则的风险引擎，该系统作为信号即服务平台运行，向机构订阅者提供结构化、可审计的投资组合信号。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既能利用AI驱动创意生成，又能满足机构对透明度、可审计性和确定性风险治理要求的投资信号构建系统？
AI.motivation: AI驱动的投资策略生成与机构投资者对透明度、可审计性和确定性风险控制的需求之间存在根本性矛盾，需要一种能够平衡这两方面要求的系统架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于规则的风险治理框架、多代理AI系统理论、信号即服务(Signal-as-a-Service)平台概念、确定性信号构建理论。
AI.method: 概念设计方法，提出一个由多个独立大型语言模型（每个具有专门分析方向）生成候选证券，然后通过确定性信号构建引擎进行过滤、约束和组装的系统架构。
AI.findings: 提出的架构能够有效协调AI驱动的创意生成与机构风险治理要求，通过确定性信号构建引擎确保暴露度、相关性、流动性和事件风险控制，并以NASDAQ-100宇宙中的beta中性多空信号生成为例说明应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI辅助确定性信号构建的理论框架，建立了多代理AI系统与基于规则风险引擎的集成模型，为AI在机构投资环境中的应用提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供了一个可操作的信号即服务平台设计，能够生成结构化、可审计的投资信号，同时保持AI的创意优势，解决了AI投资策略在机构环境中的落地难题。

title: Application of Digital Technologies During Olympiads
affiliations: Moscow State University of International Relations (MGIMO University)

detail.title: Application of Digital Technologies During Olympiads
detail.abstract: Currently, digital technologies are actively used not only in the educational process, but also in the conduct of Olympiads. The use of digital technologies and the holding of the Olympiads online allows more students from different cities to take part in the qualifying and final rounds of the Olympiads. In addition, online assignments and learning platforms provide applicants with additional training opportunities. Holding the Olympiads in electronic format with automatic verification of the results avoids human errors. Although there are some disadvantages associated with holding the Olympiads online (technical problems, difficulties with connection), the positive aspects outweigh (wider coverage of participants, the ability of participating or appealing online, accuracy of the assessment).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数字技术在奥林匹克竞赛中的应用，分析了在线竞赛的优势（扩大参与范围、提供额外培训机会、避免人为错误）和劣势（技术问题、连接困难），并认为积极面超过消极面。
AI.research_question: 数字技术在奥林匹克竞赛中的应用如何影响竞赛的参与度、公平性和效率？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术在教育领域的广泛应用，探索其在奥林匹克竞赛中的具体应用效果和影响，为竞赛组织提供实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字教育技术理论、在线评估理论、教育公平理论
AI.method: 基于文献分析和案例研究的方法，探讨数字技术在奥林匹克竞赛中的应用实践
AI.findings: 数字技术应用使奥林匹克竞赛能够覆盖更广泛的学生群体，提供额外的在线培训机会，通过自动评分减少人为错误，尽管存在技术问题和连接困难等挑战，但积极影响显著超过消极影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字教育技术在竞赛评估领域的理论应用，为在线竞赛评估提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为奥林匹克竞赛组织者提供了实施在线竞赛的实践指导，包括技术平台选择、参与者支持、评估系统设计等方面的建议

title: Switching from Third-Party Payment to E-CNY: Insights from the Push-Pull-Mooring Framework
affiliations: Lanzhou University of Finance and Economics, Lanzhou University of Finance and Economics and Lanzhou University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Switching from Third-Party Payment to E-CNY: Insights from the Push-Pull-Mooring Framework
detail.abstract: To break the barriers of retail payment and avoid market distortion, the People’s Bank of China developed and implemented E-CNY. At present, E-CNY has been piloted in many cities and has driven innovation in currency form; therefore, it is of great significance to explore the main factors driving users from third-party payment to switch to E-CNY, as well as the mechanisms driving E-CNY adoption. Based on the push-pull-mooring model, the study systematically analyses the factors influencing users’ switching from third-party payment tools to E-CNY. It empirically analyses 386 valid questionnaire responses using a partial least squares structural equation model. The study finds that push factors (privacy concerns, dissatisfaction with the quality of third-party payment tools) and pull factors (perceived ease of use, trust, and comparative advantage) significantly affect users’ intention to switch; mooring factors (switching costs, subjective norms, and habit) significantly affect users’ intention to switch; and mooring factors negatively regulate the relationship between push, pull factors, and intention to switch. Based on this, the study proposes a development strategy and implementation suggestions for E-CNY, providing theoretical and practical reference for the construction and sustainable development of the E-CNY ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 基于推-拉-锚定模型，研究分析了用户从第三方支付转向数字人民币的主要影响因素。研究发现推因素（隐私担忧、对第三方支付工具质量不满）和拉因素（感知易用性、信任、比较优势）显著影响用户转换意愿；锚定因素（转换成本、主观规范、习惯）显著影响转换意愿，并负向调节推拉因素与转换意愿的关系。
AI.research_question: 用户从第三方支付工具转向数字人民币的主要驱动因素是什么？这些因素如何影响用户的转换意愿？
AI.motivation: 为打破零售支付壁垒、避免市场扭曲，中国人民银行开发并推广数字人民币。目前数字人民币已在多个城市试点并推动货币形态创新，因此探索用户从第三方支付转向数字人民币的主要因素及其机制具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 推-拉-锚定模型（Push-Pull-Mooring Model），用于系统分析用户从第三方支付工具转向数字人民币的影响因素。
AI.method: 基于386份有效问卷，采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型进行实证分析。
AI.findings:
1. 推因素（隐私担忧、对第三方支付工具质量不满）显著影响用户转换意愿
2. 拉因素（感知易用性、信任、比较优势）显著影响用户转换意愿
3. 锚定因素（转换成本、主观规范、习惯）显著影响转换意愿
4. 锚定因素负向调节推因素、拉因素与转换意愿之间的关系
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将推-拉-锚定模型应用于数字人民币采纳研究，拓展了该理论的应用范围
2. 揭示了用户从第三方支付转向数字人民币的复杂机制
3. 为数字生态系统中的用户行为转换提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为数字人民币的发展战略和实施建议提供依据
2. 为数字人民币生态系统的建设和可持续发展提供实践参考
3. 帮助政策制定者和支付服务提供商理解用户转换行为，制定有效推广策略

title: Horizontal Scaling of UTXO-Based Transaction Processing: Architecture, Empirical Validation, and Fleet-Scale Projection
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: Horizontal Scaling of UTXO-Based Transaction Processing: Architecture, Empirical Validation, and Fleet-Scale Projection
detail.abstract: We present the largest reported fleet-scale measurement of a UTXO-based transaction processing pipeline: M = 100 nodes across 10 geographic regions with zero double-spend violations across 520 million UTXOs and 12.8 million deliberate double-spend attempts. Teranode decomposes a blockchain node into fourteen microservices connected by Apache Kafka and a shared Aerospike UTXO store, operating as a partition-ordered, CAS-based pipeline within a single administrative trust domain under crash-fault semantics; Byzantine faults, adversarial validators, and open-network P2P ingress are explicitly out of scope.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Teranode系统，这是UTXO区块链交易处理管道的最大规模实测，在100个节点、10个地理区域中处理了5.2亿UTXO和1280万次故意双花尝试，实现了零双花违规。
AI.research_question: 如何设计和实现一个大规模、高吞吐量的UTXO区块链交易处理管道，确保在分布式环境中的一致性和零双花违规？
AI.motivation: 随着区块链应用的扩展，需要处理大规模交易量的高性能节点架构，现有系统在处理海量UTXO和防止双花攻击方面存在性能瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于UTXO模型的区块链交易处理理论，分布式系统的一致性理论，微服务架构理论，以及分区有序、CAS（比较并交换）基础的管道处理理论。
AI.method: 将区块链节点分解为14个微服务，通过Apache Kafka连接，使用共享的Aerospike UTXO存储，构建分区有序、CAS基础的管道，在单一管理信任域内运行，采用崩溃故障语义。
AI.findings: 在100个节点、10个地理区域的大规模测试中，处理了5.2亿UTXO和1280万次故意双花尝试，实现了零双花违规，证明了系统的高可靠性和一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了UTXO区块链交易处理的新架构理论，包括微服务分解、分区有序管道设计、CAS机制在UTXO处理中的应用，为大规模区块链系统设计提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了Teranode系统，展示了实际可部署的大规模区块链节点架构，为高吞吐量区块链应用提供了工程实现参考，证明了微服务架构在区块链系统中的可行性。

title: GEO Non-Biased Audits: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for AI Discoverability Validated Across 10 AI Platforms
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: GEO Non-Biased Audits: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for AI Discoverability Validated Across 10 AI Platforms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This article introduces the GEO Non-Biased Audit, a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) framework designed to evaluate cross-platform AI retrieval behavior under neutral, non-authenticated conditions. The framework evaluates the accuracy of AI‑verified professional authority. Using 10 live audits across 10 AI platforms, the study evaluates identity recognition consistency, citation‑worthiness, and reproducibility when retrieving information about a single, verifiable expert entity.

Using 1080p Full HD video screen recordings and a standardized audit protocol conducted in non-authenticated browsing environments, this research examines how multiple AI platforms retrieve information related to a documented professional identity and digital footprint. Results demonstrate complete cross‑platform retrieval stability, with detailed variance data presented in Sections 9 and 11, including consistent identification of publicly available sources, professional profiles, publications, and digital content.

 The GEO Non-Biased Audit provides a reproducible framework for examining AI discoverability and proposes a benchmark methodology for evaluating cross-platform AI retrieval behavior. This framework contributes to emerging research in AI measurement science, digital trust, and AI governance.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了GEO非偏见审计框架，通过10个AI平台的实时审计，评估在非认证条件下AI检索专业权威信息的准确性，发现跨平台检索具有完全稳定性。
AI.research_question: 在非认证、中立条件下，不同AI平台如何检索和验证专业权威信息？跨平台AI检索行为的一致性和准确性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着AI在信息检索中的广泛应用，需要评估AI在验证专业权威信息时的准确性和跨平台一致性，特别是在非认证条件下的表现，这对AI可信度和治理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI测量科学、数字信任和AI治理理论，构建人机协同（HITL）审计框架，关注AI检索行为的可发现性、一致性和可重复性。
AI.method: 采用GEO非偏见审计框架，在10个AI平台上进行10次实时审计，使用1080p全高清视频屏幕录制，在非认证浏览环境中执行标准化审计协议，评估身份识别一致性、引用价值和可重复性。
AI.findings: 结果显示跨平台检索具有完全稳定性，AI能够一致识别公开可用的来源、专业档案、出版物和数字内容，详细差异数据在第9和11节中呈现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可重复的AI可发现性评估框架，为AI测量科学、数字信任和AI治理研究提供方法论贡献，建立了跨平台AI检索行为的基准评估方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织和个人提供了评估AI检索准确性的实用工具，有助于提高AI系统的可信度，为AI治理和监管提供实证基础，促进AI在专业信息检索中的可靠应用。

title: Power BI in the AI Era: Assessing Its 2026 Effectiveness

detail.title: Power BI in the AI Era: Assessing Its 2026 Effectiveness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial, professional, or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. The research was conducted independently, and all analyses and conclusions were developed solely based on publicly available information, logical evaluation, and independent research methodology.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data collection, clinical procedures, or experimental subjects. Therefore, institutional ethics approval was not required. All information used in this research was obtained from publicly available sources and analytical evaluation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding from any public, commercial, or non-profit organizations. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This study investigates whether Power BI remains as effective in 2026 as it was five years ago, considering rapid advances in AI-driven coding, Python-based analytics, and machine learning systems. The research evaluates Power BI’s evolution alongside coding-centric analytical ecosystems through capability comparison, logical analysis, and review of industry and academic sources. Market adoption trends, visualization flexibility, automation capabilities, and analytical depth are examined to test the hypothesis that traditional business intelligence tools have become less effective relative to modern AI-enabled workflows. The findings indicate that while AI coding environments provide greater analytical depth and flexibility, Power BI continues to offer significant value in accessibility, enterprise integration, and decision communication. The study concludes that Power BI’s role has evolved rather than diminished, positioning it as a complementary interface within increasingly AI-driven analytical ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了Power BI在2026年相对于AI驱动编码环境（如Python和机器学习系统）的有效性。研究发现，尽管AI编码环境提供更深入的分析灵活性，但Power BI在可访问性、企业集成和决策沟通方面仍保持重要价值，其角色已演变为AI驱动分析生态系统中的互补界面。
AI.research_question: Power BI在2026年是否仍像五年前一样有效，考虑到AI驱动编码、Python分析和机器学习系统的快速发展？
AI.motivation: 随着AI驱动编码环境、Python分析和机器学习系统的快速发展，需要评估传统商业智能工具（如Power BI）相对于现代AI驱动工作流程的有效性是否下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术演进理论、商业智能工具评估框架、AI与数据分析生态系统互补性理论。
AI.method: 能力比较、逻辑分析、行业和学术文献综述，考察市场采用趋势、可视化灵活性、自动化能力和分析深度。
AI.findings: AI编码环境提供更大的分析深度和灵活性，但Power BI在可访问性、企业集成和决策沟通方面仍提供重要价值。Power BI的角色已演变而非减弱，定位为AI驱动分析生态系统中的互补界面。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了商业智能工具在AI时代演化的理论框架，阐明了传统BI工具与AI驱动分析环境之间的互补关系，而非替代关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了关于如何在AI驱动分析生态系统中有效部署Power BI的指导，帮助组织平衡AI编码环境的深度分析与Power BI的易用性和集成能力。

title: Identity-aware Governance for Autonomous AI Agents: A Framework for Enterprise Authorization, Delegation, and Audit
affiliations: Principal Engineer, AI/ML & Data Engineering and Data & AI Practitioner

detail.title: Identity-aware Governance for Autonomous AI Agents: A Framework for Enterprise Authorization, Delegation, and Audit
detail.abstract: AI agent systems capable of autonomous action across enterprise environments are rapidly transitioning from research prototypes to production deployments. These systems inherit ambient credentials, operate nondeterministically, and lack standard mechanisms for binding actions to human identity-creating a security posture fundamentally incompatible with enterprise governance requirements. This paper presents a comprehensive framework for identity-aware agent governance addressing five critical gaps in current architectures: (1) ambient authority elimination through identity-inherited permissions, (2) infrastructure-level policy enforcement independent of model compliance, (3) sequence-aware authorization that detects composition attacks within authorized scope, (4) independent action verification addressing the oracle problem of agents selfreporting their own actions, and (5) hallucination-aware audit systems that account for LLM reasoning unreliability. We ground our analysis in documented vulnerabilities from production agent systems including the ClawHavoc supply chain attack (824+ malicious agent skills), Cisco's finding that 26% of analyzed agent skills contain security vulnerabilities, and architectural analysis of credential inheritance patterns in Claude Code Agent Teams, Cursor FastRender (2,000 concurrent agents), and OpenClaw (30,000+ internet-exposed instances). We evaluate the applicability of existing standards (OAuth 2.0, SPIFFE/SPIRE, Zero Trust Architecture, MCP) and identify specific extensions required for non-deterministic agent workflows. Our central contribution is a layered identity model with cryptographic delegation tokens that propagates human authorization through multi-agent chains, enabling per-call policy evaluation at the infrastructure layer. This work was developed concurrently with a public comment submission to the NIST National Cybersecurity Center of Excellence initiative on Software and AI Agent Identity and Authorization (2026).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个全面的身份感知智能体治理框架，解决当前AI代理系统在身份认证、权限控制、策略执行等方面的五个关键安全漏洞，通过分层身份模型和密码学委托令牌实现企业级治理。
AI.research_question: 如何为自主行动的AI代理系统设计一个与企业治理要求兼容的身份感知治理框架，解决当前架构中的关键安全漏洞？
AI.motivation: AI代理系统正在从研究原型转向生产部署，但这些系统继承环境凭据、操作非确定性、缺乏将行动绑定到人类身份的标准机制，导致其安全态势与企业治理要求根本不相容。生产环境中已出现严重漏洞，如ClawHavoc供应链攻击、Cisco发现26%的代理技能存在安全漏洞等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份继承权限、基础设施级策略执行、序列感知授权、独立行动验证、幻觉感知审计系统、密码学委托令牌、分层身份模型、OAuth 2.0、SPIFFE/SPIRE、零信任架构、MCP等标准和框架。
AI.method: 基于生产代理系统的文档化漏洞分析（ClawHavoc供应链攻击、Cisco安全报告）、架构分析（Claude Code Agent Teams、Cursor FastRender、OpenClaw等系统的凭证继承模式）、现有标准适用性评估（OAuth 2.0、SPIFFE/SPIRE等），提出分层身份模型和密码学委托令牌框架。
AI.findings: 当前AI代理架构存在五个关键安全漏洞：环境权限消除不足、基础设施级策略执行缺失、序列攻击检测能力不足、行动验证的oracle问题、LLM推理不可靠性未考虑。现有标准需要扩展才能适应非确定性代理工作流。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全面的身份感知代理治理框架，包含五个关键组件；建立了分层身份模型，通过密码学委托令牌在多层代理链中传播人类授权；为AI代理系统提供了与企业治理兼容的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业部署AI代理系统提供了可实施的安全架构；提出的框架已提交给NIST国家网络安全卓越中心关于软件和AI代理身份与授权的倡议；解决了生产环境中已发现的实际安全问题，如供应链攻击和凭证继承漏洞。

title: The Structural Evolution of Expert Networks in Institutional Investment Research
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Structural Evolution of Expert Networks in Institutional Investment Research

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with Silverlight Research, an expert network operating within the industry discussed in this paper. The analysis is based exclusively on publicly available information and academic sources.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is not human-subject research.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Expert networks are structured intermediaries that facilitate primary research consultations between institutional clients and independent industry professionals. Over the past three decades, expert networks have evolved from informal advisory matching services into structured, governance-embedded research infrastructure integrated within institutional investment workflows. Initially developed to facilitate access to industry practitioners for primary research purposes, expert networks now operate at global scale with formalized oversight systems, standardized engagement protocols, digital knowledge management platforms, and increasingly sophisticated technology integration. This paper analyzes the structural development of the expert network industry from a market architecture perspective. It traces the historical emergence of expert networks in the late 1990s, examines the maturation of institutional governance frameworks as research procurement became professionalized, and evaluates the integration of transcript libraries and digital research platforms into investment processes. The analysis situates major industry participants, including GLG, AlphaSights, Guidepoint, Third Bridge, Silverlight Research, Tegus, Coleman Research, Dialectica, and others within a broader structural ecosystem rather than through competitive ranking. The paper further explores geographic expansion, sector specialization, and the emerging role of artificial intelligence in sourcing, oversight, and knowledge synthesis. It concludes that expert networks have transitioned from relationship-based intermediaries to embedded informational infrastructure within capital allocation systems, with governance architecture and technological integration increasingly defining industry evolution.

AI.tldr: 专家网络已从非正式顾问匹配服务演变为嵌入治理的研究基础设施，成为资本配置系统中信息基础设施的一部分。
AI.research_question: 专家网络行业如何从市场架构角度实现结构性发展？其如何从关系型中介演变为嵌入资本配置系统的信息基础设施？
AI.motivation: 专家网络在过去三十年中经历了显著的结构性演变，从非正式咨询匹配服务发展为具有正式治理框架、标准化协议和数字平台的研究基础设施，需要从市场架构角度系统分析这一演变过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场架构理论、制度理论、信息中介理论、治理框架理论、技术整合理论
AI.method: 历史分析、结构分析、案例研究（分析GLG、AlphaSights、Guidepoint、Third Bridge等主要参与者）、生态系统分析
AI.findings: 1. 专家网络经历了从非正式顾问匹配到结构化、治理嵌入的研究基础设施的演变；2. 建立了正式监督系统、标准化参与协议和数字知识管理平台；3. 主要参与者构成更广泛的结构生态系统而非单纯竞争关系；4. 地理扩张、行业专业化和人工智能应用成为新趋势；5. 治理架构和技术整合日益定义行业发展方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 从市场架构视角系统分析专家网络的结构性演变；2. 提出专家网络从关系型中介到信息基础设施的转型理论；3. 构建专家网络作为嵌入资本配置系统的结构性生态系统框架；4. 探讨治理架构和技术整合在行业演化中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为机构投资者理解专家网络在投资流程中的角色提供框架；2. 为专家网络公司制定发展战略提供参考；3. 为监管机构理解行业治理架构提供依据；4. 为技术供应商了解行业技术整合需求提供洞察。

title: Strategic Information Technology Management Capabilities in Industrial SMEs: A Configurational Analysis
affiliations: University of Quebec at Trois Rivieres - Administrative Sciences Department and

detail.title: Strategic Information Technology Management Capabilities in Industrial SMEs: A Configurational Analysis
detail.abstract: This study combines concepts and ideas from the configurational theory and the capability-based view, as well as from the field of information technology (IT) management to explore different configurations of strategic IT management capabilities that lead industrial small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to achieve a high level of digital performance and in turn be ready for Industry 4.0 transformation. Applying fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) on survey data from 223 Canadian SMEs, we uncovered capability configurations that can serve as models and others as countermodels for the strategic management of IT in these enterprises. More specifically, the results reveal seven capability configurations, three of which are associated with the achievement of a high level of digital performance, and four with the non-attainment of such level. In practice, this study shows that strategic IT management capabilities have become a necessary component of digital performance, as industrial SMEs need to develop and deploy more IT resources and must derive more competitive value from these resources to meet the challenges of their Industry 4.0 transformation.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合构型理论和能力基础观，探索工业中小企业实现高水平数字化绩效并准备工业4.0转型的战略IT管理能力配置。通过fsQCA分析223家加拿大中小企业数据，发现7种能力配置模式，其中3种与高数字化绩效相关，4种与低绩效相关。
AI.research_question: 哪些战略IT管理能力配置能够帮助工业中小企业实现高水平数字化绩效并为工业4.0转型做好准备？
AI.motivation: 工业中小企业面临工业4.0转型挑战，需要理解如何通过战略IT管理能力配置来提升数字化绩效，但现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构型理论、能力基础观、信息技术管理理论
AI.method: 模糊集定性比较分析(fsQCA)，基于223家加拿大工业中小企业的调查数据
AI.findings: 发现了7种战略IT管理能力配置模式：3种与高水平数字化绩效相关（作为成功模型），4种与低水平数字化绩效相关（作为反模型）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 整合构型理论和能力基础观，提供了理解战略IT管理能力配置的新视角；2) 识别了工业中小企业数字化绩效的关键能力配置模式；3) 为工业4.0转型准备提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为工业中小企业管理者提供了具体的战略IT管理能力配置模型；2) 帮助企业识别成功和失败的能力配置模式；3) 指导企业如何通过开发IT资源和创造竞争价值来应对工业4.0转型挑战。

title: Algorithmic Infrastructures and the Temporal Reconfiguration of Accountability in Digital Governance
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Algorithmic Infrastructures and the Temporal Reconfiguration of Accountability in Digital Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, the collection of personal data, or interventions. The analysis is based exclusively on publicly available documents, published research, and publicly accessible governance materials. Ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Digital governance systems increasingly rely on infrastructures that execute and enforce decisions through pre-specified algorithmic mechanisms rather than contemporaneous institutional deliberation. In financial platforms, cross-system transfer architectures, and tokenbased governance arrangements, enforcement-relevant outcomes may be triggered automatically when defined conditions are satisfied. Once such triggers are met, execution occurs at infrastructural tempo, often within seconds or less. Institutional review processes-deliberation, voting, sanction, or regulatory intervention-operate at materially slower timescales. The paper operationalizes this mechanism through a qualitative diagnostic framework that classifies enforcement and review tempos into empirically grounded bins and evaluates governance architectures across four dimensions: actor-forum coupling, temporal alignment, cross-layer visibility, and metarule integration. Structured application to oracle-mediated liquidation cascades, cross-chain infrastructure failures, and token-based governance systems demonstrate differentiated accountability profiles rather than uniform fragility. The findings suggest that accountability in algorithmic infrastructures is not eliminated by automation but reconfigured as an architectural property dependent upon tempo alignment and bridging capacity. Governance design implications are derived for prospective accountability integration, cross-layer forum specification, and tempo-aware regulatory oversight. By reframing digital governance as a problem of temporal and infrastructural alignment rather than decentralization rhetoric, the paper offers a diagnostic instrument for policy analysis in highspeed institutional environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个诊断框架，分析数字治理系统中算法执行与制度审议之间的时间错配问题，通过四个维度评估治理架构，发现自动化并未消除问责制而是重新配置了它。
AI.research_question: 数字治理系统中算法自动执行与制度审议之间的时间错配如何影响问责制？如何通过诊断框架评估不同治理架构的问责特征？
AI.motivation: 数字治理系统日益依赖基础设施通过预设算法机制执行决策，而非实时制度审议。算法执行以秒级速度发生，而制度审议过程（审议、投票、制裁、监管干预）则慢得多，这种时间错配对问责制构成挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间错配理论、治理架构理论、算法问责制理论，提出执行与审议节奏分类框架，强调问责制作为架构属性而非消除的概念。
AI.method: 定性诊断框架，将执行和审议节奏分类为经验基础的分组，从四个维度评估治理架构：行动者-论坛耦合、时间对齐、跨层可见性、元规则整合。应用于预言机清算瀑布、跨链基础设施故障和代币治理系统进行结构化分析。
AI.findings: 不同治理架构展现出差异化的问责特征而非统一的脆弱性。算法基础设施中的问责制并未因自动化而消除，而是被重新配置为依赖节奏对齐和桥接能力的架构属性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字治理重构为时间和基础设施对齐问题而非去中心化修辞；提供诊断工具用于高速制度环境中的政策分析；提出问责制作为架构属性的新理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为治理设计提供前瞻性问责整合、跨层论坛规范和节奏感知监管监督的启示；为政策制定者提供评估数字治理系统的诊断工具。

title: How Much Customization Can a Production System Promise? The Case of Flow-Shops Under Make-To-Stock and Make-To-Order Strategic Hybrids
affiliations: Hellenic Open University, HSQ &Sustainability Division, Metlen Energy & Metals, University of Piraeus, Technical University Of Crete and Hellenic Open University

detail.title: How Much Customization Can a Production System Promise? The Case of Flow-Shops Under Make-To-Stock and Make-To-Order Strategic Hybrids
detail.abstract: Hybrid make-to-stock/make-to-order (MTS/MTO) production systems have emerged as a dominant response to mass customization. However, most existing research on hybrid flow shops revolves around scheduling and largely neglects the control problem of dynamically prioritizing capacity between standardized replenishment and customized order fulfillment under uncertainty. This paper addresses this gap by developing a control-oriented framework for stochastic parallel hybrid MTS/MTO flow shops with multiple stages and parallel machines. In particular, we consider an MTS-first hybrid architecture in which switching between MTS and multiple MTO customization classes incurs explicit setup costs and service performance is affected by finite buffers, stochastic demand and congestion propagation across stages. Methodologically, we integrate discrete-event simulation with a multi-output Machine Learning surrogate to construct a production-oriented stochastic meta-model. The computational results show that system-specific engineered features substantially improve surrogate accuracy across all evaluated models, with shallow multi-layer perceptrons achieving the best fidelity in reproducing both service level decrease and cost components. The results indicate that feasible customization levels are governed by coupled production and buffer capacities and that policies based only on feasibility can lead to excessive switching unless economic criteria are explicitly applied. Overall, the study advances the control theory of hybrid MTS/MTO flow shops by shifting the focus from sequencing to state-dependent prioritization and demonstrates how ML-based stochastic meta-models can support transparent, economically grounded decision rules in complex production environments.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个面向控制的随机并行混合MTS/MTO流水车间框架，采用离散事件仿真与机器学习代理模型结合的方法，发现系统特定工程特征显著提升模型精度，并揭示了定制化水平受生产和缓冲容量耦合约束，仅基于可行性的策略会导致过度切换。
AI.research_question: 如何在具有多阶段、并行机器、显性切换成本和随机需求的混合MTS/MTO流水车间中，动态优先分配产能以实现服务水平和成本的经济平衡？
AI.motivation: 现有混合流水车间研究主要关注调度问题，忽视了在不确定性下动态优先分配标准化补货和定制化订单产能的控制问题，而这是大规模定制化生产中的关键挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合MTS/MTO生产系统理论、随机排队网络理论、生产控制理论、机器学习代理建模方法
AI.method: 集成离散事件仿真与多输出机器学习代理模型构建面向生产的随机元模型，使用浅层多层感知器模型，评估系统特定工程特征对代理模型精度的影响
AI.findings: 1) 系统特定工程特征显著提升所有评估模型的代理精度；2) 浅层多层感知器在重现服务水平下降和成本组件方面具有最佳保真度；3) 可行定制化水平受生产和缓冲容量耦合约束；4) 仅基于可行性的策略会导致过度切换，除非明确应用经济标准
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将混合MTS/MTO流水车间的控制理论焦点从排序转向状态依赖的优先级分配；2) 展示了基于机器学习的随机元模型如何支持复杂生产环境中透明、经济基础决策规则的制定
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为混合MTS/MTO生产系统提供了实用的控制导向框架；2) 提供了在不确定性和切换成本下平衡标准化生产和定制化订单的决策支持工具；3) 揭示了避免过度切换的经济标准应用重要性

title: Intraday Decision Support for Traders: Explainable CNN-Based Directional Price Forecasting from Candlestick Chart Images

detail.title: Intraday Decision Support for Traders: Explainable CNN-Based Directional Price Forecasting from Candlestick Chart Images

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No known competing financial interests or personal relationships influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or animal subjects. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No known competing financial interests or personal relationships influenced this study.

detail.abstract: Short-horizon trader-support systems in financial markets should be judged not only by predictive skill but also by auditability, inspectability, and suitability for decision support under uncertainty. This paper studies an auditable 20-bar chart-image branch built from a retained MOEX Si futures artifact bundle. Starting from 14 contract-level one-minute candle files plus an auxiliary participant-position file, the pipeline resamples to 15-minute candles, selects the daily front contract by realized volume, applies a conservative liquidity filter, constructs a clean continuous-front series of 29,926 bars across 502 trading days, and generates 10,350 same-day, same-contract 20-bar windows rendered as 64 x 60 grayscale candlestick images. A three-block convolutional neural network (CNN) and a Grad-CAM-style local explanation layer are then embedded in a dashboard-centered inspection workflow. On the held-out test split (1,646 windows), the model attains 0.552 accuracy, 0.530 balanced accuracy, 0.408 F1, 0.557 ROC-AUC, and 0.063 MCC. Performance is modest and, at the default 0.50 threshold, trails the naive majority-class baseline on raw accuracy, while remaining better than random in threshold-free ranking terms. Results are contract-concentrated: SiZ5 materially outperforms SiU5. Quantitative explanation summaries show that heat mass is concentrated mainly in the price panel (0.807) rather than volume (0.193), but remains broad and only weakly focused on the final bar (0.043). The contribution is therefore bounded: not novelty of chart-image CNN forecasting or Grad-CAM in futures, both of which already exist, but the integration of chronology-aware futures engineering, auditable chart-image modeling, local explanation outputs, and row-level dashboard inspection in a trader-facing decision-support artifact. Fee-aware economic validation and formal user evaluation remain separated as pending next-stage work.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个可审计的20根K线图图像分支，用于MOEX Si期货交易决策支持。通过数据处理、CNN模型和Grad-CAM解释技术，在测试集上获得中等性能，主要贡献在于整合了时序感知期货工程、可审计图表图像建模和交易员决策支持工作流。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可审计、可检查且适合不确定性下决策支持的短期交易者支持系统？
AI.motivation: 金融市场的短期交易者支持系统不仅需要预测能力，还需要可审计性、可检查性以及在不确定性下适合决策支持的特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可审计性理论、决策支持系统理论、卷积神经网络（CNN）在金融时间序列分析中的应用、Grad-CAM可解释人工智能技术
AI.method: 1. 数据处理：从14个合约级一分钟K线文件构建连续前月合约系列（29,926根15分钟K线）；2. 生成10,350个64×60灰度K线图图像；3. 使用三块卷积神经网络（CNN）和Grad-CAM风格局部解释层；4. 嵌入仪表盘中心检查工作流；5. 在1,646个测试窗口上评估性能
AI.findings: 模型在测试集上获得中等性能：准确率0.552，平衡准确率0.530，F1分数0.408，ROC-AUC 0.557，MCC 0.063。性能优于随机但低于多数类基线。结果具有合约集中性：SiZ5明显优于SiU5。解释分析显示热图质量主要集中在价格面板（0.807）而非成交量（0.193），且对最后一根K线的关注度较弱（0.043）。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了时序感知期货工程、可审计图表图像建模、局部解释输出和行级仪表盘检查，为交易员决策支持提供了系统化框架，强调可审计性和可解释性在金融AI系统中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个完整的交易者决策支持系统原型，包含数据处理管道、CNN预测模型、Grad-CAM解释技术和仪表盘界面，为实际交易环境中的可审计AI应用提供了参考实现。

title: User Imprint: Psychological Profiling and Qualified Information in Prolonged Interaction with Large Language Models
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: User Imprint: Psychological Profiling and Qualified Information in Prolonged Interaction with Large Language Models
detail.abstract: Prolonged interaction with large language models (LLMs) produces a profiling effect that extends beyond commonly documented risks such as hallucinations, confirmation bias, or source fabrication. This paper identifies and formalises a phenomenon we propose to call user imprint: the LLM's ability to aggregate data disseminated across multiple interactions to build an exploitable psychological profile. This concept extends the surveillance capitalism framework (Zuboff, 2019) to a context in which data is no longer passively captured but actively delivered by the user, in what we term qualified information. An exploratory demonstration shows that an LLM, fed personality traits over weeks of conversation, can identify a fictitious user's psychological vulnerabilities and propose operational tactics to exploit them, without any spontaneous ethical reservation. Converging signals from industry practices-including Anthropic's memory migration tool launched in March 2026, which explicitly treats user imprint as a transferable asset-reinforce the plausibility of the phenomenon. This paper constitutes a theoretical proposition accompanied by a proof of concept, sufficiently defined to be subjected to experimental protocols and sufficiently grounded to warrant such investigation.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别并形式化了一种称为"用户印记"的现象：大型语言模型通过多次交互聚合用户数据，构建可被利用的心理画像，这超越了传统AI风险如幻觉或确认偏误。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在长期交互中如何通过聚合分散的用户数据构建可被利用的心理画像？这种"用户印记"现象对用户隐私和安全构成什么威胁？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注LLMs的即时风险（如幻觉、确认偏误），但忽视了长期交互中数据聚合带来的新型威胁。需要将监控资本主义框架扩展到用户主动提供"合格信息"的新情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监控资本主义框架（Zuboff, 2019）的扩展，引入"用户印记"概念和"合格信息"（用户主动提供的数据）理论。
AI.method: 探索性演示：让LLM在数周对话中接收虚构用户的性格特征，观察其是否能识别心理脆弱性并提出利用策略。结合行业实践分析（如Anthropic 2026年3月推出的记忆迁移工具）。
AI.findings: LLM能够通过长期对话聚合用户数据，构建详细的心理画像，识别脆弱性并提出操作策略，且没有自发的伦理保留。行业实践证实了用户印记作为可转移资产的存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化"用户印记"概念；2. 扩展监控资本主义理论到用户主动提供数据的新情境；3. 提出"合格信息"理论框架；4. 为实验研究提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示LLM长期交互的新型风险；2. 为AI伦理和安全研究提供新方向；3. 为政策制定者提供监管依据；4. 为企业设计负责任AI系统提供指导。

title: Decision Without Deciders: AI Governance and the Infrastructuralization of Accountability

detail.title: Decision Without Deciders: AI Governance and the Infrastructuralization of Accountability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or clinical experimentation. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: AI systems are transforming how consequential decisions are produced and how accountability is organized. Rather than functioning as tools operated by identifiable agents, algorithmic systems increasingly operate as decision environments in which outcomes emerge from distributed socio-technical configurations. This paper theorizes this transformation as responsibility absorption: the structural migration of accountability from traceable relations between agents and outcomes into infrastructural architectures, producing the condition of decision without deciders. In such systems, decisions occur without identifiable decisionmakers in the sense required for conventional accountability, not because responsibility disappears but because it is reconstituted as a systemic property of configuration rather than an attribute of agents. The paper develops a structural framework for understanding this transformation. It contrasts chain-based accountability models, which organize responsibility through discrete decisional acts and identifiable agents, with field-based decision structures, in which outcomes emerge from distributed configurations. It then theorizes responsibility absorption as the displacement of agency, authority, and normative responsibility into infrastructural systems. Accountability is subsequently reconceptualized as an infrastructural property-a characteristic of system architecture rather than a regulatory overlay imposed through oversight mechanisms. Building on this reconceptualization, the paper articulates three principles for embedding accountability within system architectures: binding authority to configuration, preserving foreclosed alternatives, and architectural contestability. Together, these principles define a model of structural placement in which responsibility is positioned within socio-technical systems rather than retrospectively attributed to individual actors. The paper concludes that AI governance cannot be adequately addressed through technical fixes, transparency mandates, or regulatory extensions of existing accountability frameworks. Instead, it requires the construction of accountability infrastructures-institutional architectures capable of rendering distributed configurations answerable in societies increasingly organized through infrastructural decision systems. AI governance is thus reframed not as the regulation of a technology but as the architectural design of decision environments in conditions of decision without deciders.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"责任吸收"概念，解释AI系统如何将问责从可追溯的代理关系迁移到基础设施架构中，形成"无决策者的决策"现象。论文构建了结构框架，对比链式问责模型与场式决策结构，并提出将问责嵌入系统架构的三原则。
AI.research_question: 在AI系统日益成为分布式社会技术配置的决策环境背景下，传统基于可识别决策者的问责模式如何适应"无决策者的决策"现象？如何重新概念化问责并将其嵌入系统架构？
AI.motivation: AI系统正在改变决策生产和问责组织方式，从工具性操作转向分布式社会技术配置的决策环境。传统问责模式依赖于可追溯的代理-结果关系，但在"决策无决策者"条件下失效，需要新的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 责任吸收理论：问责从代理关系向基础设施架构的结构性迁移
2. 链式问责模型 vs 场式决策结构对比框架
3. 代理、权威和规范责任向基础设施系统的位移理论
4. 问责作为基础设施属性的重新概念化
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析：通过理论框架开发、概念对比分析、原则阐述等方法，构建理解AI系统问责转型的结构性框架。
AI.findings:
1. AI系统导致"责任吸收"现象，问责成为系统配置的固有属性而非代理属性
2. 传统链式问责模型不适用于场式决策结构
3. 问责需要重新概念化为基础设施属性
4. 提出嵌入问责的三原则：绑定权威与配置、保留被排除的替代方案、架构可争议性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"责任吸收"核心概念
2. 构建链式vs场式决策结构的对比框架
3. 重新概念化问责为基础设施属性
4. 提出"结构定位"模型，将责任置于社会技术系统内部
5. 将AI治理重构为决策环境的架构设计而非技术监管
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为AI治理提供新的设计原则
2. 提出构建"问责基础设施"的实践方向
3. 为政策制定者提供超越技术修复和透明性要求的治理框架
4. 为系统设计者提供嵌入问责的具体架构原则

title: Talking in Generalities or Talking in Detail? The Role of Unconfirmed Customer Expectations in Reviewers' Online Expression
affiliations: , Harbin Institute of Technology and Harbin Institute of Technology

detail.title: Talking in Generalities or Talking in Detail? The Role of Unconfirmed Customer Expectations in Reviewers' Online Expression
detail.abstract: What online reviewers say about a product determines readers' understanding of the product before use. Thus, it is meaningful to understand the reasons behind reviewers' expressions. Given that review content is a consequence of the emotional and psychological interpretation of the reviewer's expectations and experience, this study aims to explore how expectation disconfirmation affects online reviewers' expressions. On the basis of data from online customer reviews in the Ctrip hospitality sector, this study verifies the effects of expectation disconfirmation on review breadth and depth with a correlated topic model and Shannon entropy. The findings reveal that review breadth decreases and review depth increases as expectation disconfirmation increases. Moreover, compared with reviewers' identity disclosure, reviewers' anonymity amplifies the effects of expectation disconfirmation on review breadth and review depth, whereas an increase in temporal distance between the dates of consumption and review attenuates these effects. Drawing upon expectation confirmation theory and persuasion theory, this study contributes to the understanding of reviewers' psychology and behaviors and provides implications for online communication in internet society.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于期望确认理论和说服理论，探讨期望不一致如何影响在线评论的表达。通过携程酒店评论数据，使用相关主题模型和香农熵分析发现：期望不一致增加时，评论广度减少而深度增加；评论者匿名会放大这种效应，而消费与评论时间间隔增加则会减弱这种效应。
AI.research_question: 期望不一致如何影响在线评论者的表达（评论广度和深度）？
AI.motivation: 在线评论内容影响读者对产品的理解，而评论内容是评论者期望与体验的情感心理解释结果，因此理解评论者表达背后的原因具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望确认理论（Expectation Confirmation Theory）和说服理论（Persuasion Theory）
AI.method: 基于携程酒店行业在线客户评论数据，使用相关主题模型（Correlated Topic Model）和香农熵（Shannon Entropy）分析期望不一致对评论广度和深度的影响
AI.findings: 1. 期望不一致增加时，评论广度减少而评论深度增加；2. 评论者匿名会放大期望不一致对评论广度和深度的影响；3. 消费与评论时间间隔增加会减弱期望不一致对评论表达的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 结合期望确认理论和说服理论，深化了对评论者心理和行为的理解，为互联网社会中的在线沟通提供了理论贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线平台管理评论、理解用户表达模式提供了实践启示，有助于改善在线沟通效果

title: Rule 12 (B) (6) As the Procedural Architecture of Artificial Intelligence Litigation in the United States

detail.title: Rule 12 (B) (6) As the Procedural Architecture of Artificial Intelligence Litigation in the United States
detail.abstract: This article conceptualizes Rule 12(b)(6) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure as the central procedural mechanism structuring contemporary artificial intelligence litigation in the United States. It argues that the motion to dismiss no longer functions merely as a preliminary technical filter but as the constitutive stage at which a technological conflict acquires legal existence within federal adjudication.

AI.tldr: 本文概念化《联邦民事诉讼规则》第12(b)(6)条为构建美国当代人工智能诉讼的核心程序机制，认为驳回动议不再仅仅是初步技术过滤器，而是技术冲突在联邦司法中获得法律存在的构成性阶段。
AI.research_question: 《联邦民事诉讼规则》第12(b)(6)条驳回动议如何构建和塑造当代美国人工智能诉讼？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能技术引发的法律纠纷日益增多，需要理解程序机制如何影响这类新兴技术争议的司法处理方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 程序法理论、法律现实主义、法律与科技交叉研究、诉讼程序的社会建构理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究、程序机制的概念化分析、法律程序的功能性分析。
AI.findings: 第12(b)(6)条驳回动议在人工智能诉讼中具有构成性功能，它不仅是技术过滤器，更是技术冲突获得法律存在的关键阶段，塑造了人工智能争议的司法认知和处理方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了程序机制作为技术冲突法律化过程的构成性要素的理论框架，丰富了法律程序理论在科技争议中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人工智能诉讼参与者（律师、法官、企业）提供了关于12(b)(6)动议战略重要性的实践指导，有助于更有效地处理人工智能相关法律争议。

title: Is a Core–Periphery Network Good for Knowledge Sharing? A Structural Model of Endogenous Network Formation on a Crowdsourced Customer Support Forum
affiliations: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI), Carnegie Mellon University - David A. Tepper School of Business and Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Is a Core–Periphery Network Good for Knowledge Sharing? A Structural Model of Endogenous Network Formation on a Crowdsourced Customer Support Forum

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIS Quarterly, Vol. 41, No. 2, June 2017, pp. 607-628

detail.abstract: This study examines technology-driven social learning platforms such as crowdsourced customer support and the emergence of core–periphery knowledge-sharing network structures. We propose a dynamic structural model with endogenized knowledge-sharing and network formation that recognizes the dynamic and interdependent nature of knowledge seeking and sharing decisions. These decisions are driven by knowledge increments and social status building in anticipation of future reciprocal rewards from peers. Our model provides insights into how platform design can shape network structures to optimize knowledge sharing in online communities.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个动态结构模型，分析技术驱动的社交学习平台（如众包客户支持）中核心-边缘知识共享网络结构的形成机制，探讨知识寻求与分享决策的相互依赖性及其对网络结构的影响。
AI.research_question: 技术驱动的社交学习平台如何形成核心-边缘知识共享网络结构？平台设计如何影响知识寻求与分享决策，从而优化在线社区的知识共享？
AI.motivation: 理解在线知识共享社区中网络结构的形成机制，特别是核心-边缘结构的出现，以及平台设计如何通过影响用户的知识寻求与分享决策来优化知识共享效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态结构模型，内生化知识共享与网络形成，考虑知识寻求与分享决策的相互依赖性，基于知识增量和社会地位构建理论，强调对未来互惠回报的预期驱动。
AI.method: 动态结构模型构建，内生化知识共享决策和网络形成过程，分析知识增量和社会地位构建对用户决策的影响，以及这些决策如何共同塑造网络结构。
AI.findings: 知识寻求与分享决策是动态且相互依赖的，由知识增量和社会地位构建驱动，用户基于对未来互惠回报的预期做出决策，这些决策共同塑造了核心-边缘网络结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个内生化知识共享与网络形成的动态结构模型，揭示了知识寻求与分享决策的相互依赖性，以及社会地位构建和未来互惠预期在塑造网络结构中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计者提供了优化知识共享的指导，通过调整平台机制来影响用户的知识寻求与分享决策，从而塑造更有效的核心-边缘网络结构，提升社区知识共享效率。

title: Third-Party Pricing Algorithms and Information Sharing
affiliations: and University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: Third-Party Pricing Algorithms and Information Sharing
detail.abstract: We analyze how the outsourcing of algorithmic pricing to a common third party influences the effects of information sharing in oligopoly. Algorithms enable competing firms to tailor prices to high-frequency demand shocks, and we compare regimes that either allow or prohibit conditioning on rival-specific shocks. We find that information sharing harms expected consumer surplus to a greater extent when pricing is outsourced to a common third party than when firms develop pricing algorithms in-house. Expected welfare rises with information sharing under in-house algorithm design but falls when pricing is outsourced, making third-party algorithms using rival demand information the worst regime for consumers and welfare.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了定价算法外包给共同第三方与内部开发时，信息共享对寡头竞争的影响。发现当定价外包时，信息共享对消费者剩余和福利的损害更大，而内部开发算法时信息共享能提升福利。
AI.research_question: 定价算法外包给共同第三方如何影响寡头市场中信息共享的效果？
AI.motivation: 随着算法定价在商业中的普及，企业越来越多地将定价决策外包给第三方算法提供商。这种趋势引发了关于竞争政策的问题：当竞争对手使用相同的第三方算法时，信息共享会产生什么不同的影响？
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头竞争理论、算法定价理论、信息共享理论、第三方服务外包理论
AI.method: 理论模型分析，比较不同制度安排：1) 允许或禁止基于竞争对手特定需求冲击的定价条件；2) 定价算法外包给共同第三方 vs 内部开发算法
AI.findings: 1. 信息共享对预期消费者剩余的损害在定价外包给共同第三方时比内部开发算法时更大；2. 内部开发算法时信息共享能提升预期福利，但外包时信息共享会降低福利；3. 使用竞争对手需求信息的第三方算法制度对消费者和福利最不利
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统分析了第三方算法定价对信息共享效果的影响；2. 揭示了算法外包改变了信息共享的竞争效应；3. 为算法时代的竞争政策提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供了评估算法定价外包竞争影响的框架；2. 建议对使用共同第三方算法的企业实施更严格的信息共享限制；3. 为企业算法采购决策提供了竞争策略参考

title: Constitutional Logic in the Ethereum Virtual Machine: A Technical Implementation Report on Ternary Moral Logic

detail.title: Constitutional Logic in the Ethereum Virtual Machine: A Technical Implementation Report on Ternary Moral Logic

keywords: Zero-Knowledge Proofs Constitutional Logic in the Ethereum Virtual Machine: A Technical Implementation Report on Ternary Moral Logic

detail.abstract: Traditional smart contract architectures operate on binary determinism ("Code is Law"), resolving all transactions into valid or invalid states. This framework is insufficient for high-stakes governance and autonomous systems where ethical ambiguity requires a state of suspension rather than immediate execution. This paper presents the reference implementation of Ternary Moral Logic (TML) within the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). We introduce a finite state machine that enforces a mandatory third state-the "Sacred Zero" or Epistemic Hold-enabling smart contracts to pause execution when pre-defined ethical conditions are unmet. The architecture utilizes EIP-712 typed data signing for cryptographic provenance, Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZK-SNARKs) for private verification, and a Dual-Lane Latency model to maintain high throughput for non-ambiguous transactions. Furthermore, we define an "Immutable Core" proxy pattern to eliminate administrative "God Mode" overrides, and demonstrate safety properties using TLA+ formal verification. This framework transforms the smart contract from a rigid automation tool into a constitutional enforcement layer capable of auditable, non-bypassable ethical hesitation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了三元道德逻辑（TML）在以太坊虚拟机中的实现，为智能合约引入"神圣零"状态，使合约能在伦理条件未满足时暂停执行，而非传统的二元有效/无效判定。
AI.research_question: 如何在区块链智能合约中实现伦理模糊情境下的执行暂停机制，而非传统的二元确定性执行？
AI.motivation: 传统智能合约的"代码即法律"二元确定性框架不足以处理高风险治理和自治系统中的伦理模糊情境，需要一种能够暂停执行而非立即执行的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元道德逻辑（TML）、有限状态机理论、密码学证明理论、形式化验证理论
AI.method: 1. 在EVM中实现TML参考实现；2. 引入包含"神圣零"状态的有限状态机；3. 使用EIP-712类型数据签名进行加密溯源；4. 应用零知识证明进行隐私验证；5. 采用双通道延迟模型维持高吞吐量；6. 定义"不可变核心"代理模式；7. 使用TLA+进行形式化验证
AI.findings: 成功实现了支持伦理暂停状态的智能合约架构，该架构能够：1. 在预定义伦理条件未满足时暂停执行；2. 保持非模糊交易的高吞吐量；3. 消除管理员"上帝模式"覆盖；4. 通过形式化验证证明安全属性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了三元道德逻辑（TML）理论框架；2. 扩展了智能合约状态机理论；3. 发展了区块链伦理执行的理论基础；4. 提出了"神圣零"作为伦理暂停状态的概念
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了EVM中TML的参考实现；2. 开发了支持伦理暂停的智能合约架构；3. 创建了可审计、不可绕过的伦理犹豫机制；4. 为高风险治理和自治系统提供了实用的伦理执行工具

reference: Marketing Science, volume 34, issue 3, 2015[10.1287/mksc.2014.0885]
title: A Dynamic Model of Rational Addiction: Evaluating Cigarette Taxes
affiliations: and Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business

detail.title: A Dynamic Model of Rational Addiction: Evaluating Cigarette Taxes
detail.abstract: Addiction creates an intertemporal link between a consumer's past and present decisions, altering their responsiveness to price changes relative to nonaddictive products. We construct a dynamic model of rational addiction and endogenous consumption to investigate how consumers respond to policy interventions that aim to reduce purchases of cigarettes. We find that, on average, the category elasticity is about 35% higher when the model correctly accounts for addiction. However, some policies spur substitution from more expensive single packs to less expensive cartons of cigarettes, resulting in higher overall consumption for some consumers. These findings have important implications for the design of tobacco taxation policy.

AI.tldr: 成瘾行为在消费者过去与现在决策间建立了跨期联系，改变了他们对价格变化的反应程度。研究发现，正确考虑成瘾因素时，品类弹性平均高出约35%，但某些政策可能导致消费者从高价单包转向低价整条香烟，反而增加总体消费。
AI.research_question: 成瘾如何影响消费者对烟草政策干预（特别是价格政策）的反应？正确考虑成瘾因素时，烟草品类弹性会发生什么变化？
AI.motivation: 成瘾产品（如香烟）的消费决策具有跨期关联性，传统需求分析可能低估成瘾对价格敏感性的影响。需要理解成瘾如何改变消费者对减烟政策的反应，以设计更有效的烟草税收政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性成瘾理论（Rational Addiction Theory）和内生消费动态模型，强调成瘾行为在时间维度上连接消费者过去与现在的决策。
AI.method: 构建动态理性成瘾模型，考虑内生消费决策，分析消费者对减烟政策干预的反应，特别关注价格变化的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 正确考虑成瘾因素时，烟草品类弹性平均高出约35%；2. 某些政策可能导致消费者从高价单包转向低价整条香烟，反而增加总体消费；3. 成瘾改变了消费者对价格变化的反应模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了理性成瘾理论在政策评估中的应用，揭示了成瘾如何系统性改变价格弹性，为理解成瘾产品的需求动态提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 对烟草税收政策设计有重要启示：需要考虑成瘾的跨期效应，避免政策意外导致消费增加；应针对不同包装规格设计差异化税收，防止消费者转向更便宜的整条购买。

reference: Journal of Marketing Research, volume 42, issue 2, 2005[10.1509/jmkr.42.2.233.62288]
title: Cross-Selling Sequentially Ordered Products: An Application to Consumer Banking Services
affiliations: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey - Rutgers University, Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business and University of Virginia - Darden School of Business

detail.title: Cross-Selling Sequentially Ordered Products: An Application to Consumer Banking Services

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Marketing Research, volume 42, issue 2, 2005[10.1509/jmkr.42.2.233.62288]

detail.abstract: Customers have predictable life cycles. As a result of these life cycles, firms that sell multiple products or services frequently observe that, in general, certain items are purchased before others. This predictable phenomenon provides opportunities for firms to cross-sell additional products and services to existing customers. This article presents a structural multivariate probit model to investigate how customer demand for multiple products evolves over time and its implications for the sequential acquisition patterns of naturally ordered products. Among the substantive findings are that women and older customers are more sensitive to their overall satisfaction with the bank than men and younger customers when determining whether to purchase additional products.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个结构多元概率模型，分析客户对多种产品的需求如何随时间演变，以及这对自然排序产品的顺序获取模式的影响。研究发现女性和年长客户在决定是否购买额外产品时，对银行整体满意度比男性和年轻客户更敏感。
AI.research_question: 客户对多种产品的需求如何随时间演变？这对自然排序产品的顺序获取模式有何影响？
AI.motivation: 客户有可预测的生命周期，导致企业经常观察到某些产品在其他产品之前被购买。这种可预测现象为企业向现有客户交叉销售额外产品和服务提供了机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 客户生命周期理论、顺序购买行为理论、多元概率模型框架
AI.method: 结构多元概率模型，用于分析客户对多种产品的需求演变和顺序获取模式
AI.findings: 女性和年长客户在决定是否购买额外产品时，对银行整体满意度比男性和年轻客户更敏感
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结构模型来分析客户需求演变和顺序获取模式，扩展了客户生命周期和交叉销售理论
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助企业更好地理解客户购买模式，优化交叉销售策略，特别是针对不同人口统计特征的客户群体

reference: Journal of Marketing Research, volume 40, issue 4, 2003[10.1509/jmkr.40.4.389.19392]
title: Measuring the Impact of Promotions on Brand Switching When Consumers Are Forward Looking
affiliations: Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business, Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business and Carnegie Mellon University

detail.title: Measuring the Impact of Promotions on Brand Switching When Consumers Are Forward Looking

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Marketing Research, volume 40, issue 4, 2003[10.1509/jmkr.40.4.389.19392]

detail.abstract: This article examines whether brand-switching elasticities derived from logit choice models are overestimated as a result of rational consumer adjustment of purchase timing to coincide with promotion schedules and whether a dynamic structural model can address this bias. Using simulated data, the authors show that if the structural model is correct, brand-switching elasticities are overestimated by stand-alone logit models. A nested logit model improves the estimates but not completely. The dynamic structural model provides more accurate decomposition of promotional effects into brand switching, stockpiling, and consumption acceleration components.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了logit选择模型得出的品牌转换弹性是否因消费者理性调整购买时间以配合促销计划而被高估，以及动态结构模型是否能解决这一偏差。
AI.research_question: 品牌转换弹性是否因消费者理性调整购买时间以配合促销计划而被高估？动态结构模型是否能解决logit模型的这种偏差？
AI.motivation: 传统logit模型可能高估品牌转换弹性，因为它忽略了消费者会理性调整购买时间以利用促销机会，这导致对促销效果的错误分解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论和动态决策框架，考虑消费者在品牌选择和购买时机上的理性调整行为。
AI.method: 使用模拟数据比较三种模型：标准logit模型、嵌套logit模型和动态结构模型。
AI.findings: 如果结构模型正确，品牌转换弹性会被标准logit模型高估；嵌套logit模型有所改善但不完全；动态结构模型能更准确分解促销效果为品牌转换、囤货和消费加速三个部分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了考虑消费者动态购买时机调整的理论框架，揭示了传统logit模型在估计品牌转换弹性时的系统性偏差。
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销管理者提供了更准确的促销效果分解方法，帮助制定更有效的促销策略和资源分配决策。

reference: Marketing Science, volume 36, issue 3, 2017[10.1287/mksc.2016.1021]
title: A Dynamic Model of Health Insurance Choices and Healthcare Consumption Decisions
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, Virginia Tech - Pamplin College of Business, Carnegie Mellon University - David A. Tepper School of Business and Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business

detail.title: A Dynamic Model of Health Insurance Choices and Healthcare Consumption Decisions
detail.abstract: This paper examines data from a health insurer in the United States on the insurance plan and treatment options for chronically ill patients over a three-year period. Treatments vary widely in terms of cost and impact: expensive frontier treatments provide the best outcome for only the seriously ill, while cheaper, established treatments prove effective for most other patients. We develop a dynamic structural model to analyze how insurance plan generosity affects both insurance choice and healthcare consumption decisions. The findings show that generous health insurance plans encourage overtreatment but may not improve health outcomes, with important implications for insurance plan design and healthcare policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过美国一家健康保险公司的三年数据，分析保险计划慷慨程度对慢性病患者治疗选择的影响。研究发现慷慨的保险计划会导致过度治疗，但未必改善健康结果。
AI.research_question: 健康保险计划的慷慨程度如何影响慢性病患者的保险选择和治疗决策？
AI.motivation: 慢性病治疗成本高昂且治疗方案差异大，昂贵的前沿治疗仅对重症患者有效，而便宜的成熟治疗对大多数患者有效。需要了解保险设计如何影响治疗选择，以优化医疗资源配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于健康经济学和保险理论，特别是道德风险理论，分析保险慷慨度如何影响患者的医疗消费行为。
AI.method: 使用美国健康保险公司三年的慢性病患者数据，建立动态结构模型分析保险计划慷慨度对保险选择和治疗决策的影响。
AI.findings: 慷慨的健康保险计划会鼓励过度治疗（特别是昂贵的前沿治疗），但未必能改善患者的健康结果。这种过度治疗主要发生在那些前沿治疗对其效果不佳的患者群体中。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了健康保险道德风险理论，特别关注慢性病治疗情境下保险慷慨度对治疗技术选择的影响，为医疗资源配置效率提供理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为保险公司设计更有效的保险计划提供依据，帮助政策制定者平衡医疗资源分配，避免因过度慷慨的保险导致的医疗资源浪费，同时确保重症患者获得必要的昂贵治疗。

title: Are We Currently Experiencing the Fifth Industrial Revolution? The Case for Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Are We Currently Experiencing the Fifth Industrial Revolution? The Case for Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Every Industrial Revolution in recorded history has been characterised by a singular enabling technology that restructured labour markets, reorganised production systems, and permanently altered the social and institutional architecture of society. This article advances the thesis that Artificial Intelligence (AI), encompassing large language models, generative AI systems, and autonomous agents that emerged in mature form between approximately 2017 and 2026, constitutes the defining technological catalyst of a Fifth Industrial Revolution. Drawing on historical analyses of prior industrial transitions, primary and peer-reviewed empirical literature, and current enterprise adoption data, the argument proceeds in four stages: (1) a definitional framework for what constitutes an industrial revolution is established from the historical record; (2) the four prior revolutions are mapped against this framework; (3) AI is evaluated against each criterion; and (4) the critical distinction between Industry 4.0 and Industry 5.0, a frequently conflated debate in both academic and practitioner discourse is resolved. The analysis concludes that AI meets every historical threshold for revolutionary classification and that this transition is not approaching but already underway.

AI.tldr: 本文认为人工智能（AI）是第五次工业革命的标志性技术，通过历史分析框架论证AI符合工业革命的所有标准，并澄清了工业4.0与5.0的区别。
AI.research_question: 人工智能（AI）是否构成第五次工业革命的标志性技术？
AI.motivation: 工业革命在历史上都由单一关键技术驱动，当前学术界和实践界对AI是否构成新工业革命存在混淆和争议，需要澄清工业4.0与5.0的区别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史记录建立的工业革命定义框架，包括劳动力市场重组、生产系统重组、社会制度架构永久改变等标准。
AI.method: 四阶段论证方法：1) 从历史记录建立工业革命定义框架；2) 将前四次革命映射到该框架；3) 用该框架评估AI；4) 澄清工业4.0与5.0的区别。
AI.findings: AI符合工业革命的所有历史标准，第五次工业革命不是即将到来而是已经进行中。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了工业革命的系统定义框架，澄清了工业4.0与5.0的理论区别，为AI作为第五次工业革命提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业理解AI的战略重要性提供指导，帮助政策制定者认识AI带来的社会经济变革，为劳动力市场转型提供参考。

title: The M.A.T.H. Framework: A First-Principles Approach to Quant Marketing in High-Uncertainty Environments

detail.title: The M.A.T.H. Framework: A First-Principles Approach to Quant Marketing in High-Uncertainty Environments
detail.abstract: The digital advertising ecosystem generates data volumes exceeding human cognitive processing capacity by orders of magnitude, while simultaneously degrading data quality through invalid traffic, attribution fragmentation, algorithmic opacity, and privacy-driven observational collapse. This paper formalizes the resulting structural mismatch, the Linear-Exponential Gap, between exponential growth in market complexity and approximately logarithmic growth in human analytical bandwidth. We introduce the M.A.T.H. Framework (Measure, Analyze, Tweak, Harvest), a recursive optimization protocol whose four stages address the principal failure modes of modern advertising operations: data corruption (Measure), confounded inference (Analyze), insufficient experimental velocity (Tweak), and suboptimal scaling (Harvest). We develop the information-theoretic foundations of each stage, including formalization of the data processing inequality as a bound on optimization performance, causal inference methods for deconfounding observational data, the Cycle Velocity construct for quantifying experimental throughput, and marginal economic analysis for identifying optimal scaling boundaries. System-level analysis demonstrates convergence properties governed by the Effective Learning Rate and degradation dynamics governed by creative fatigue, competitive displacement, and algorithmic drift. We establish conditions under which the framework achieves antifragility: converting environmental volatility into informational advantage. The framework operates on aggregate data rather than individual-level tracking, making it structurally compatible with privacy regulation and invariant to ongoing reductions in user-level observability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了M.A.T.H.框架来解决数字广告生态系统中数据量指数增长与人类分析能力对数增长之间的结构性不匹配问题，通过测量、分析、调整、收获四个递归阶段优化广告运营。
AI.research_question: 如何解决数字广告生态系统中数据量指数增长与人类分析能力有限之间的结构性不匹配问题？
AI.motivation: 数字广告生态系统产生远超人类认知处理能力的数据量，同时数据质量因无效流量、归因碎片化、算法不透明和隐私驱动的观测崩溃而下降，导致市场复杂性指数增长与人类分析能力近似对数增长之间的结构性不匹配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性-指数差距理论（Linear-Exponential Gap）、M.A.T.H.框架（测量、分析、调整、收获）、信息论基础（数据处理不等式）、因果推断方法、循环速度概念、边际经济分析、反脆弱性理论。
AI.method: 开发递归优化协议M.A.T.H.框架，包括四个阶段：测量（解决数据腐败）、分析（解决混淆推断）、调整（解决实验速度不足）、收获（解决次优扩展），并进行系统级分析。

AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了线性-指数差距理论，建立了M.A.T.H.框架的信息论基础，提出了循环速度概念，发展了反脆弱性在数字广告中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为广告运营提供了可操作的优化框架，解决了数据腐败、混淆推断、实验速度不足和次优扩展等实际问题，且设计上兼容隐私法规，适应观测性降低的环境。

title: Work from Home and Disability Employment
affiliations: ,  and University of Kalmar

detail.title: Work from Home and Disability Employment

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: There has been a dramatic rise in disability employment since the pandemic. At the same time, work from home (WFH) has risen four-fold. This paper asks whether the two are causally related. Controlling for compositional changes and labor market tightness, a 1 percentage point increase in WFH increases full-time employment by 1.0% for individuals with a physical disability. The postpandemic increase in working from home explains 68%-85% of the rise in full-time employment. Wage data suggests that WFH increased the supply of workers with a physical disability, likely by reducing commuting costs and enabling better control of working conditions.

AI.tldr: 疫情后远程工作增加解释了68%-85%的残疾人全职就业增长，远程工作每增加1个百分点，残疾人全职就业增加1.0%
AI.research_question: 远程工作（WFH）的增加是否与残疾人就业增长存在因果关系？
AI.motivation: 疫情后观察到两个显著趋势：残疾人就业大幅增加，同时远程工作增长了四倍。需要探究这两者之间是否存在因果联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力供给理论，特别是考虑通勤成本和工作环境控制对残疾人就业的影响
AI.method: 控制人口结构变化和劳动力市场紧张程度，分析远程工作变化与残疾人就业的统计关系

reference: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 26-19
title: Why Is Manufacturing Productivity Growth So Low?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, , Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Why Is Manufacturing Productivity Growth So Low?

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 26-19
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine the recent slow growth in manufacturing productivity. We show that nearly all measured TFP growth since 1987 — and its post-2000s decline — comes from a few computer-related industries. We argue conventional measures understate manufacturing productivity growth by failing to fully capture quality improvements. We compare consumer to producer and import price indices. In rapidly changing industries, consumer price indices indicate less inflation, suggesting mismeasurement in standard industry deflators. Using an input-output framework, we estimate that TFP growth is understated by 1.4 percentage points in durable manufacturing and 0.3 percentage points in nondurable manufacturing and is slightly overstated in nonmanufacturing industries.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了制造业生产率增长缓慢的原因，发现传统测量方法因未能充分捕捉质量改进而低估了制造业生产率增长，特别是计算机相关行业。
AI.research_question: 为什么制造业生产率增长缓慢？传统测量方法是否准确反映了制造业生产率的真实增长？
AI.motivation: 制造业生产率增长放缓是近年来经济中的重要现象，但传统测量方法可能存在缺陷，无法准确反映技术进步和质量改进带来的真实生产率增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全要素生产率(TFP)测量理论，价格指数构建理论，质量调整方法，投入产出框架分析。
AI.method: 比较消费者价格指数与生产者价格指数及进口价格指数；使用投入产出框架分析不同行业的价格测量偏差；分析计算机相关行业对整体TFP增长的贡献。
AI.findings: 1. 1987年以来几乎所有测量的TFP增长及其2000年后下降都来自少数计算机相关行业；2. 传统测量方法因未能充分捕捉质量改进而低估制造业生产率增长；3. 在快速变化的行业中，消费者价格指数显示的通胀较低，表明标准行业平减指数存在测量误差；4. TFP增长在耐用制造业中被低估1.4个百分点，在非耐用制造业中被低估0.3个百分点，在非制造业中略有高估。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了传统TFP测量方法在捕捉质量改进方面的系统性偏差；2. 提出了通过比较不同类型价格指数来识别测量误差的方法；3. 为理解制造业生产率增长放缓提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了更准确的制造业生产率测量方法；2. 有助于企业更好地评估技术投资的真实回报；3. 为产业政策调整提供了实证依据；4. 改进了宏观经济统计数据的准确性。
